examples.cn: 十九世纪列强瓜分[非洲]重塑了该大陆的政治边界。

examples.en: Many nations in [Africa] are experiencing rapid economic growth driven by technology investment.
examples.cn: [非洲]许多国家正经历由科技投资推动的快速经济增长。

examples.en: The oral storytelling traditions of [Africa] have preserved history across generations.
examples.cn: [非洲]的口述叙事传统跨越世代保存了历史。

words.translation: n. 非洲人\na. 非洲的, 非洲人的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Africa\na. of or relating to the nations of Africa or their peoples

examples.en: The exhibition showcased [African] art from over twenty different countries and traditions.
examples.cn: 展览展示了来自二十多个不同国家和传统的[非洲]艺术。

examples.en: Many [Africans] have made outstanding contributions to science, literature, and global culture.
examples.cn: 许多[非洲人]在科学、文学和全球文化方面作出了杰出贡献。

examples.sense: adj. 与非洲相关的（议题）
examples.en: [African] nations called for fairer representation in international financial institutions.
examples.cn: [非洲]国家呼吁在国际金融机构中获得更公平的代表权。

examples.en: The award-winning author drew on her [African] heritage to craft her celebrated novels.
examples.cn: 这位获奖作家从其[非洲]文化遗产中汲取灵感，创作了备受赞誉的小说。

examples.en: The [African] elephant is the largest land animal on Earth and an endangered species.
examples.cn: [非洲]象是地球上体型最大的陆地动物，也是濒危物种。

words.translation: prep. 在...之后, 由于\nconj. 在...之后\nadv. 后来
words.definition: s. located farther aft\nr. behind or in the rear

examples.en: Students should review their notes carefully [after] each lecture to reinforce their understanding.
examples.cn: 学生应在每次课[后]仔细回顾笔记，以巩固理解。

examples.en: [After] the experiment was completed, the team analysed the results for several weeks.
examples.cn: 实验完成[后]，团队花了数周时间分析结果。

examples.en: The detective suspected that the thieves were [after] the jewels stored in the museum vault.
examples.cn: 侦探怀疑窃贼是[图谋]存放在博物馆金库中的珠宝。

examples.en: The meeting was long and tedious; refreshments were served [after].
examples.cn: 会议漫长而乏味；[会后]提供了茶点。

examples.en: The building was named [after] a renowned scientist who had dedicated his life to research.
examples.cn: 这座建筑以一位献身研究的著名科学家[命名]。

words.translation: n. 午后, 下午
words.definition: n. the part of the day between noon and evening

examples.en: The committee is scheduled to meet [this afternoon] to discuss the revised proposal.
examples.cn: 委员会定于[今天下午]开会讨论修订后的提案。

examples.en: Spending a lazy [afternoon] at the botanical garden was her favourite weekend pastime.
examples.cn: 在植物园悠闲地度过一个[下午]是她最喜欢的周末消遣。

examples.en: The press conference will be held in the early [afternoon], following the morning session.
examples.cn: 新闻发布会将在上午会议结束后于[下午]早些时候举行。

examples.en: The café is usually quieter in the [afternoon] than during the busy morning rush hour.
examples.cn: 咖啡馆[下午]通常比繁忙的早高峰时段安静。

examples.sense: n. 黄金时代的晚期（比喻）
examples.en: Some scholars describe the late Renaissance as the [afternoon] of a great cultural era.
examples.cn: 一些学者将文艺复兴晚期描述为一个伟大文化时代的[下午]。

words.translation: adv. 然后, 后来
words.definition: r happening at a time subsequent to a reference time

examples.en: The delegates signed the agreement and posed for photographs [afterward].
examples.cn: 代表们签署协议后[随即]合影留念。

examples.en: Only [afterward] did they realise the full significance of the breakthrough they had made.
examples.cn: 只有在[事后]，他们才意识到所取得突破的全部意义。

examples.en: The lecture lasted two hours; [afterward], students gathered to debate the key ideas.
examples.cn: 讲座持续了两个小时；[随后]，学生们聚在一起讨论核心观点。

examples.en: She left the company and [afterward] founded her own highly successful technology startup.
examples.cn: 她离开了公司，[后来]创立了自己极为成功的科技创业公司。

examples.en: The negotiators reached a tentative agreement; the details were formalised [afterward].
examples.cn: 谈判者达成了初步协议；细节[其后]得到正式确认。

words.translation: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处
words.definition: r. anew

examples.en: The experiment failed the first time, but the team succeeded [again] on the second attempt.
examples.cn: 实验第一次失败了，但团队在第二次尝试中[再次]成功。

examples.en: After months of rehabilitation, the athlete was able to compete [again] at the highest level.
examples.cn: 经过几个月的康复训练，运动员能够[重新]在最高水平上参赛。

examples.sense: adv. 另一方面；而且（then again）
examples.en: The proposal has merit; then [again], the costs may outweigh the potential benefits.
examples.cn: 该提案有可取之处；但[另一方面]，成本可能超过潜在收益。

examples.en: Despite his illness, he was [again] at his desk by Monday morning.
examples.cn: 尽管生病，他[还是]在周一早上回到了办公桌前。

examples.en: The renovation cost as much [again] as the original estimate due to unforeseen complications.
examples.cn: 由于意外复杂情况，翻新费用[再次]超出原估算额同等数量。

words.translation: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠
words.definition:
prep. Abreast; opposite to; facing; towards; as, against the
   mouth of a river; -- in this sense often preceded by over.
prep. From an opposite direction so as to strike or come in
   contact with; in contact with; upon; as, hail beats against the roof.
prep. In opposition to, whether the opposition is of
   sentiment or of action; on the other side; counter to; in contrariety
   to; hence, adverse to; as, against reason; against law; to run a race
   against time.
prep. By of before the time that; in preparation for; so as
   to be ready for the time when.

examples.en: Many scientists spoke out [against] the proposed cuts to research funding.
examples.cn: 许多科学家公开反对[削减]研究经费的提案。

examples.en: She leaned [against] the wall and considered her options carefully.
examples.cn: 她[靠]着墙，仔细考虑自己的选择。

examples.en: The new data must be assessed [against] the background of existing research.
examples.cn: 新数据必须对照现有研究背景进行[比对]评估。

examples.en: The national team will compete [against] last year's champions in the semifinal.
examples.cn: 国家队将在半决赛中[对阵]去年的冠军。

examples.en: The community built flood barriers [against] the threat of rising river levels.
examples.cn: 社区修建了防洪堤坝，[以防]河流水位上涨。

words.translation: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期\nv. 变老, 成熟
words.definition:
n. how long something has existed
n. a time of life (usually defined in years) at which some particular qualification or power arises
v. begin to seem older; get older
v. make older

examples.en: Participation in the advanced programme is limited to students above the [age] of sixteen.
examples.cn: 参加高级课程的资格限于十六岁以上的学生。

examples.en: We are living in an [age] of rapid technological transformation and global connectivity.
examples.cn: 我们生活在一个快速技术变革和全球互联的[时代]。

examples.en: The monument had [aged] gracefully over the centuries, its grandeur undiminished.
examples.cn: 这座纪念碑历经数百年[岁月]沧桑，却风采依旧。

examples.en: With [age] comes wisdom, but also the need for greater health care and support.
examples.cn: 随着[年龄]的增长，人会变得更有智慧，但也需要更多的医疗保健和支持。

examples.en: Voting rights are granted to citizens who have reached the legal [age] of eighteen.
examples.cn: 公民达到法定[年龄]十八岁后即可享有投票权。

words.translation: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介\n[化] 办事处
words.definition: n. an administrative unit of government\nn. a business that serves other businesses\nn. the state of being in action or exerting power

examples.en: A government [agency] was set up to oversee the implementation of environmental regulations.
examples.cn: 一个政府[机构]被设立起来监督环境法规的执行。

examples.en: She acted through a literary [agency] to negotiate the publication of her debut novel.
examples.cn: 她通过一家文学[代理机构]谈判出版了她的处女作。

examples.sense: n. 自主性；能动性（哲学）
examples.en: Human [agency] is the capacity to make free choices and act independently in the world.
examples.cn: 人的[能动性]是在世界中自由做出选择并独立行动的能力。

examples.en: Social change is often achieved through the [agency] of determined individuals and grassroots movements.
examples.cn: 社会变革往往通过坚定个人和基层运动的[推动]来实现。

examples.en: The multinational hired a top advertising [agency] to rebrand its global product line.
examples.cn: 这家跨国公司聘请了一家顶尖广告[代理公司]为其全球产品线重新定位。

words.translation: pl. 议程, 日常工作事项\n[计] 待议事件
words.definition: n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to\nn. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)

examples.en: The [agenda] for tomorrow's board meeting covers five key items, including the budget review.
examples.cn: 明天董事会会议的[议程]涵盖五个关键事项，包括预算审查。

examples.en: The new administration's [agenda] focuses on healthcare reform and infrastructure development.
examples.cn: 新政府的[施政纲领]侧重于医疗改革和基础设施发展。

examples.sense: n. 隐藏意图；私心（hidden agenda）
examples.en: Critics suspected the proposal concealed a hidden [agenda] that served corporate rather than public interests.
examples.cn: 批评者怀疑该提案背后隐藏着服务企业而非公众利益的[私心]。

examples.sense: n. 优先事项；待办事项
examples.en: Tackling youth unemployment was at the top of the minister's [agenda] for the term.
examples.cn: 解决青年失业问题是部长本届任期[首要议题]。

examples.en: Climate change has risen to the top of the international scientific [agenda].
examples.cn: 气候变化已上升为国际科学[议程]的首要议题。

words.translation: n. 代理商, 政府代表, 动原, 媒介\n[计] 代理程序
words.definition:
n. an active and efficient cause; capable of producing a certain effect
n. a representative who acts on behalf of other persons or organizations
n. a substance that exerts some force or effect
n. a businessman who buys or sells for another in exchange for a commission

examples.en: The actor's [agent] negotiated a lucrative deal with the film studio on his behalf.
examples.cn: 演员的[经纪人]代其与电影公司谈妥了一笔丰厚的合约。

examples.en: The intelligence [agent] gathered critical information while operating undercover abroad.
examples.cn: 情报[特工]在海外卧底期间收集了关键信息。

examples.en: Bleach is an effective [agent] for disinfecting surfaces in medical environments.
examples.cn: 漂白剂是医疗环境中消毒表面的有效[制剂]。

examples.en: In this sentence, the subject is the [agent] that performs the action of the verb.
examples.cn: 在这个句子中，主语是执行动词动作的[施动者]。

examples.en: Education is one of the most powerful [agents] of social change in any society.
examples.cn: 教育是任何社会中最强大的社会变革[推动力]之一。

words.translation: n. 侵犯, 侵略\n[医] 攻击
words.definition:
n. a disposition to behave aggressively
n. a feeling of hostility that arouses thoughts of attack
n. violent action that is hostile and usually unprovoked
n. the act of initiating hostilities

examples.en: The international community condemned the act of military [aggression] against the sovereign state.
examples.cn: 国际社会谴责对主权国家的军事[侵略]行为。

examples.en: Research suggests that certain environmental factors can increase [aggression] in adolescents.
examples.cn: 研究表明，某些环境因素会增加青少年的[攻击性]。

examples.en: The security guard was trained to de-escalate situations involving [aggression] from customers.
examples.cn: 保安人员接受了训练，以缓和顾客[攻击性]行为引发的局势。

examples.en: In competitive sports, controlled [aggression] can be a decisive advantage.
examples.cn: 在竞技体育中，有控制的[进取心]可以成为决定性优势。

examples.en: The treaty prohibited any form of [aggression] between the two signatory nations.
examples.cn: 该条约禁止两个签约国之间的任何形式的[侵略]行为。

words.translation: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的\n[法] 侵略的, 爱挑衅的, 行为过火的
words.definition: a. having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends; positive in his convictions"\ns. tending to spread quickly\ns. characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight

examples.en: The guard dog became [aggressive] when strangers approached the property.
examples.cn: 陌生人靠近时，看门狗变得[好斗]起来。

examples.sense: adj. 积极进取的；大胆的
examples.en: The company adopted an [aggressive] marketing strategy to capture a larger market share.
examples.cn: 该公司采取了[积极进取]的营销策略以获取更大的市场份额。

examples.en: The doctors recommended [aggressive] treatment to halt the rapid progression of the disease.
examples.cn: 医生建议采取[强力]治疗以阻止疾病的快速进展。

examples.en: His [aggressive] tone during negotiations alienated potential partners and damaged the deal.
examples.cn: 他在谈判中的[挑衅]语气疏远了潜在合作伙伴，破坏了协议。

examples.en: The [aggressive] bidding war drove the auction price far above its estimated value.
examples.cn: [激烈]的竞价战将拍卖价格推高至远超估值。

words.translation: adv. 以前
words.definition: s. gone by; or in the past\nr. in the past

examples.en: The ancient ruins were built over two thousand years [ago] by a sophisticated civilisation.
examples.cn: 这些古遗址是[两千多年前]由一个高度文明的社会建造的。

examples.en: The technology that seems ordinary today was considered science fiction just thirty years [ago].
examples.cn: 如今看来普通的技术，仅仅在三十年[前]还被认为是科幻小说中的内容。

examples.sense: adv. 过去（强调时间距离）
examples.en: Not long [ago], communicating across continents required days rather than seconds.
examples.cn: 不[久前]，跨洲际通讯需要数天而非数秒。

examples.en: Years [ago], before urbanisation, most people in the region depended on farming for their livelihood.
examples.cn: [多年前]，在城镇化之前，该地区大多数人靠农业为生。

examples.en: Long [ago], before modern medicine, many common illnesses proved fatal.
examples.cn: [很久以前]，在现代医学出现之前，许多常见疾病都是致命的。

words.translation: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合\nvt. 承认, 认定, 同意
words.definition:
v. be in accord; be in agreement
v. consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something
v. show grammatical agreement
v. be agreeable or suitable

examples.en: Both parties finally [agreed] on the terms of the contract after weeks of negotiation.
examples.cn: 经过数周的谈判，双方终于就合同条款[达成了一致]。

examples.en: The witness's testimony did not [agree] with the evidence presented to the court.
examples.cn: 目击者的证词与提交给法院的证据[不一致]。

examples.en: The government [agreed] to review the controversial legislation following mass protests.
examples.cn: 在大规模抗议后，政府[同意]对争议性立法进行审查。

examples.sense: v. 适合；相宜（food agrees with）
examples.en: Rich, spicy food doesn't [agree] with her sensitive digestive system.
examples.cn: 油腻辛辣的食物[不适合]她敏感的消化系统。

examples.en: Scientists worldwide [agree] that immediate action is necessary to limit global warming.
examples.cn: 全球科学家[一致认为]，限制全球变暖需要立即采取行动。

words.translation: n. 同意, 合约, 协议\n[经] 契约, 协议, 协定
words.definition:
n. the statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
n. compatibility of observations
n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters
n. the thing arranged or agreed to

examples.en: The two nations signed a historic trade [agreement] that will benefit both economies.
examples.cn: 两国签署了一项历史性贸易[协议]，将使双方经济受益。

examples.en: There is broad [agreement] among experts that climate change poses an existential threat.
examples.cn: 专家们普遍[一致认为]气候变化构成生存威胁。

examples.en: Both parties are legally bound by the terms of the rental [agreement].
examples.cn: 双方在法律上均受租赁[协议]条款的约束。

examples.sense: n. 语法上的一致（语法学）
examples.en: In English, subject-verb [agreement] requires singular verbs with singular subjects.
examples.cn: 在英语中，主谓[一致]要求单数主语使用单数动词。

examples.en: She nodded in [agreement] when the chairperson summarised the committee's conclusions.
examples.cn: 当主席总结委员会结论时，她点头表示[赞同]。

words.translation: a. 农业的\n[法] 农业的, 耕作的
words.definition: a. relating to or used in or promoting agriculture or farming

examples.en: The region's [agricultural] output has declined sharply due to prolonged drought.
examples.cn: 由于长期干旱，该地区的[农业]产出急剧下降。

examples.en: [Agricultural] communities in rural areas often face challenges accessing modern healthcare.
examples.cn: 农村地区的[农业]社区通常面临获得现代医疗保障的挑战。

examples.en: The government introduced subsidies to support the country's [agricultural] sector.
examples.cn: 政府引入补贴以支持本国[农业]部门。

examples.sense: adj. 田园的；关于农耕的
examples.en: The museum's [agricultural] exhibits trace the history of farming from ancient to modern times.
examples.cn: 博物馆的[农业]展品追溯了从古代到现代的耕作历史。

examples.en: Advances in [agricultural] science have dramatically increased crop yields over the past century.
examples.cn: [农业]科学的进步在过去一个世纪中大幅提高了农作物产量。

words.translation: n. 农业\n[机] 农业, 农学
words.definition: n. the class of people engaged in growing food

examples.en: Modern [agriculture] relies heavily on technology to maximise efficiency and crop yields.
examples.cn: 现代[农业]严重依赖技术来最大化效率和农作物产量。

examples.en: [Agriculture] accounts for a significant proportion of the country's total exports.
examples.cn: [农业]占该国出口总额的相当大比例。

examples.en: The shift from [agriculture] to industry transformed the social structure of many societies.
examples.cn: 从[农业]到工业的转变改变了许多社会的社会结构。

examples.en: Students studying [agriculture] learn about soil science, crop management, and sustainable farming.
examples.cn: 学习[农学]的学生学习土壤科学、作物管理和可持续农业。

examples.en: Climate change poses the greatest long-term threat to global [agriculture] and food security.
examples.cn: 气候变化对全球[农业]和粮食安全构成最大的长期威胁。

words.translation: a. 领先的, 预先的, 向前的\nadv. 领先, 预先, 向前, 胜于, 在前面, 在将来
words.definition:
s. having the leading position or higher score in a contest
r. at or in the front
r. toward the future; forward in time
r. in a forward direction

examples.en: The expedition team forged [ahead] despite the deteriorating weather conditions.
examples.cn: 尽管天气条件不断恶化，探险队还是[向前]挺进。

examples.en: Planning [ahead] is essential when coordinating a project involving multiple teams.
examples.cn: [提前]规划对于协调涉及多个团队的项目至关重要。

examples.en: The research team was years [ahead] of competitors in developing the new technology.
examples.cn: 研究团队在开发新技术方面比竞争对手[领先]数年。

examples.en: The road [ahead] for economic recovery will require sustained effort and international cooperation.
examples.cn: 经济复苏的[前路]需要持续努力和国际合作。

examples.en: A sharp bend in the road [ahead] forced the driver to reduce speed immediately.
examples.cn: [前方]道路急转弯迫使司机立即减速。

words.translation:
n. 帮助, 外援, 助手
vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于
vi. 帮助
[计] 自动内部诊断
words.definition: n. a resource\nn. the activity of contributing to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose\nn. money to support a worthy person or cause

examples.en: International humanitarian [aid] was rushed to the region following the devastating earthquake.
examples.cn: 毁灭性地震发生后，国际人道主义[援助]迅速抵达该地区。

examples.en: The new diagnostic tools will [aid] doctors in identifying the disease at an earlier stage.
examples.cn: 新诊断工具将[帮助]医生在更早阶段识别疾病。

examples.en: A hearing [aid] allows people with partial hearing loss to participate fully in conversations.
examples.cn: 助[听器]使有部分听力损失的人能够充分参与对话。

examples.en: The laboratory [aid] prepared the samples before the lead researcher began the analysis.
examples.cn: 实验室[助手]在首席研究员开始分析之前准备好了样本。

examples.en: Careful note-taking during lectures significantly [aids] comprehension and long-term retention.
examples.cn: 课堂上认真记笔记大大[有助于]理解和长期记忆。

words.meaning: 爱滋病(获得性免疫缺陷综合征)
words.translation: n. 爱滋病(获得性免疫缺陷综合征)\n[计] 高级综合数据系统, 先进交互调试系统, 自动图解文档编制系统\n美国决策学学会, 信息自动显示系统, 自动综合调试系统
words.definition: n. a serious (often fatal) disease of the immune system transmitted through blood products especially by sexual contact or contaminated needles

examples.sense: n. 艾滋病（获得性免疫缺陷综合症）
examples.en: Global health organisations have invested heavily in research to develop an effective [AIDS] vaccine.
examples.cn: 全球卫生组织在研发有效的[艾滋病]疫苗方面投入了大量资源。

examples.sense: n. 艾滋病（传播与预防）
examples.en: Education campaigns significantly reduced the transmission rate of [AIDS] in several countries.
examples.cn: 教育宣传活动显著降低了多个国家的[艾滋病]传播率。

examples.en: The [AIDS] epidemic of the 1980s had a profound impact on public health policy worldwide.
examples.cn: 20世纪80年代的[艾滋病]流行对全球公共卫生政策产生了深远影响。

examples.en: Antiretroviral therapy has transformed [AIDS] from a death sentence into a manageable condition.
examples.cn: 抗逆转录病毒治疗已将[艾滋病]从死刑变为可控病症。

examples.en: Anonymous [AIDS] testing is available at community health centres to encourage early detection.
examples.cn: 社区卫生中心提供匿名[艾滋病]检测，以鼓励早期发现。

words.translation:
n. 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力
vi. 对准目标, 致力, 打算
vt. 瞄准
[计] 医学文摘索引, 存取隔离机构, 高级信息管理程序, 先进接口模块
应用接口模块, 医学人工智能, 相联索引法, 异步接口模块
自动化信息管理, 自动化综合制造, 自动化库存管理
words.definition:
n. the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)
n. the action of directing something at an object
v. point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards
v. propose or intend

examples.en: The primary [aim] of the research project is to develop a cheaper solar energy solution.
examples.cn: 该研究项目的主要[目标]是开发更便宜的太阳能解决方案。

examples.en: The archer [aimed] carefully at the distant target before releasing the arrow.
examples.cn: 射手在放箭前仔细[瞄准]了远处的靶子。

examples.en: The education reform [aims] to reduce the achievement gap between different socioeconomic groups.
examples.cn: 教育改革[旨在]缩小不同社会经济群体之间的成就差距。

examples.en: The campaign was [aimed] at raising awareness of mental health issues among young people.
examples.cn: 该活动[针对]提高年轻人对心理健康问题的认识。

examples.en: His [aim] improved significantly after weeks of consistent target practice.
examples.cn: 经过数周持续的靶训练，他的[准头]有了显著提高。

words.translation: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度\nvt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀
words.definition:
n. a mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of
n. the region above the ground
n. a distinctive but intangible quality surrounding a person or thing
n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles)

examples.en: The quality of the [air] in major industrial cities has improved following stricter regulations.
examples.cn: 在更严格的法规实施后，主要工业城市的[空气]质量有所改善。

examples.en: There was an [air] of anticipation in the lecture hall before the distinguished guest arrived.
examples.cn: 在杰出来宾到来之前，报告厅里弥漫着一股期待的[气氛]。

examples.en: The documentary will be [aired] on national television next Friday evening.
examples.cn: 该纪录片将于下周五晚在国家电视台[播出]。

examples.en: She hummed a familiar [air] as she walked through the gardens in the evening.
examples.cn: 她在傍晚漫步花园时哼唱着一首熟悉的[曲调]。

examples.en: He [aired] the blankets on the balcony before the approaching winter season.
examples.cn: 他在冬季来临之前把毯子拿到阳台上[晾晒]。

words.translation: n. 航空器, 飞机\n[机] 航空器
words.definition: n. a vehicle that can fly

examples.en: The military [aircraft] completed a surveillance mission over the disputed territory.
examples.cn: 军用[飞机]完成了对争议领土的侦察任务。

examples.en: Modern commercial [aircraft] are capable of flying non-stop for over sixteen hours.
examples.cn: 现代商用[飞机]能够不间断飞行超过十六小时。

examples.en: The exhibition featured [aircraft] ranging from early biplanes to modern supersonic jets.
examples.cn: 展览展出了从早期双翼机到现代超音速喷气机的各类[飞行器]。

examples.en: Several [aircraft] were scrambled in response to the unidentified radar signal.
examples.cn: 针对不明雷达信号，数架[战斗机]紧急升空。

examples.en: Unmanned [aircraft] are increasingly used for agricultural monitoring and logistics delivery.
examples.cn: 无人[飞行器]越来越多地用于农业监测和物流配送。

words.translation: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司
words.definition: n. a hose that carries air under pressure\nn. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers

examples.en: The budget [airline] offers competitive fares but charges extra for checked baggage.
examples.cn: 这家廉价[航空公司]提供有竞争力的票价，但对托运行李额外收费。

examples.en: New [airline] routes connecting the two cities have significantly boosted tourism.
examples.cn: 连接两座城市的新[航线]大幅促进了旅游业的发展。

examples.en: The flag [airline] announced plans to expand its fleet by twenty new long-haul aircraft.
examples.cn: 国家[航空公司]宣布计划扩充机队，增加二十架新的远程飞机。

examples.en: The growth of low-cost [airlines] has made international travel accessible to more people.
examples.cn: 低成本[航空公司]的增长使更多人能够负担得起国际旅行。

examples.en: The [airline] industry was among the hardest hit during the global pandemic.
examples.cn: [航空]行业是全球疫情中受打击最严重的行业之一。

words.translation: n. 航空邮件
words.definition: n. letters and packages that are transported by aircraft\nn. a system of conveying mail by aircraft\nv. send or transport by airmail

examples.en: Before the internet, [airmail] was the fastest way to send documents overseas.
examples.cn: 互联网出现之前，[航空邮件]是向海外发送文件的最快方式。

examples.en: She sent a birthday card by [airmail] to ensure it arrived in time for the celebration.
examples.cn: 她用[航空邮件]寄出了生日贺卡，以确保及时送达庆祝活动前。

examples.en: The publisher [airmailed] the manuscript corrections to the author in New York.
examples.cn: 出版商将手稿修改意见[航空邮寄]给了纽约的作者。

examples.en: The [airmail] envelope was stamped at the post office before being sent to Australia.
examples.cn: 这封[航空邮件]信封在邮局盖章后被寄往澳大利亚。

examples.en: The development of [airmail] in the early twentieth century revolutionised long-distance communication.
examples.cn: 二十世纪初[航空邮政]的发展彻底改变了远程通讯方式。

words.translation: n. 飞机\n[机] 飞机
words.definition: n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets

examples.en: The [airplane] took off into a clear blue sky and headed west towards the Pacific.
examples.cn: [飞机]腾空飞入晴朗的蓝天，向西驶向太平洋。

examples.en: The passengers boarded the [airplane] through the jet bridge at the departure gate.
examples.cn: 乘客通过登机廊桥在登机口登上了[飞机]。

examples.en: Modern [airplanes] are equipped with advanced navigation systems and autopilot technology.
examples.cn: 现代[飞机]配备了先进的导航系统和自动驾驶技术。

examples.sense: n. 折纸飞机（儿童活动）
examples.en: The children spent the afternoon folding paper [airplanes] and launching them across the classroom.
examples.cn: 孩子们花了一个下午折纸[飞机]，并把它们飞过教室。

examples.en: The [airplane] has dramatically shrunk the world by making distant destinations easily reachable.
examples.cn: [飞机]使遥远的目的地变得触手可及，大大缩短了世界的距离。

words.translation: n. 飞机场\n[机] 航空站, 机场
words.definition: n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo

examples.en: The international [airport] handles over fifty million passengers annually.
examples.cn: 该国际[机场]每年接待超过五千万名旅客。

examples.en: An entirely new city has grown up around the major hub [airport] over the past two decades.
examples.cn: 在过去二十年里，一座全新的城市在主要枢纽[机场]周围发展起来。

examples.en: The [airport] connects the region to over one hundred international destinations.
examples.cn: 该[机场]将该地区与一百多个国际目的地相连接。

examples.en: A temporary [airport] was constructed to facilitate the delivery of relief supplies.
examples.cn: 为便利救援物资的运输，建造了一个临时[机场]。

examples.sense: n. 安检、通关区域（语境）
examples.en: Long queues at the [airport] security checkpoint caused many passengers to miss their flights.
examples.cn: [机场]安检通道的漫长等待使许多乘客误机。

words.translation: n. 空域, 空间\n[机] 气隙
words.definition: n. the space in the atmosphere immediately above the earth\nn. the atmosphere above a nation that is deemed to be under its jurisdiction

examples.en: The government declared a no-fly zone over the restricted military [airspace].
examples.cn: 政府宣布在限制性军事[领空]上空设立禁飞区。

examples.en: Commercial airlines must file flight plans before entering foreign [airspace].
examples.cn: 商业航空公司在进入外国[领空]前必须提交飞行计划。

examples.en: Violation of national [airspace] without permission is considered a serious diplomatic incident.
examples.cn: 未经许可侵犯国家[领空]被视为严重外交事件。

examples.en: Urban planners must consider the use of [airspace] above buildings for green installations.
examples.cn: 城市规划者必须考虑利用建筑物上方的[空间]进行绿色设施建设。

examples.en: The busy metropolitan [airspace] requires constant monitoring by air traffic controllers.
examples.cn: 繁忙的大都市[空域]需要航空交通管制员持续监控。

words.translation: n. 惊恐, 警报, 警钟\nvt. 使惊恐, 警告\n[计] 报警信号
words.definition:
n. fear resulting from the awareness of danger
n. a device that signals the occurrence of some undesirable event
n. an automatic signal (usually a sound) warning of danger
v. warn or arouse to a sense of danger or call to a state of preparedness

examples.en: The smoke [alarm] in the kitchen went off when she left the pan unattended on the stove.
examples.cn: 她把锅留在炉子上无人看管时，厨房的烟雾[报警器]响了。

examples.en: News of the chemical spill caused widespread [alarm] among residents near the industrial plant.
examples.cn: 化学品泄漏的消息在工厂附近居民中引发了广泛的[恐慌]。

examples.en: The sudden drop in the patient's blood pressure [alarmed] the medical team.
examples.cn: 患者血压的骤降[惊动]了医疗团队。

examples.en: She set the [alarm] for six o'clock to ensure she caught the early train.
examples.cn: 她把[闹钟]定在六点，以确保赶上早班列车。

examples.en: The new security system [alarms] all entry points automatically after midnight.
examples.cn: 新安全系统在午夜后[自动激活]所有入口的报警装置。

words.translation: n. 粘贴簿, 唱片套\n[医] 白色物
words.definition: n. one or more recordings issued together; originally released on 12-inch phonograph records (usually with attractive record covers) and later on cassette audiotape and compact disc\nn. a book of blank pages with pockets or envelopes; for organizing photographs or stamp collections etc

examples.en: She leafed through the old [album] and pointed out photographs of her parents as young children.
examples.cn: 她翻看着旧[相册]，指出了父母年幼时的照片。

examples.en: The band's debut [album] sold over three million copies within its first month of release.
examples.cn: 这支乐队的首张[专辑]发行后一个月内售出了三百多万张。

examples.en: As a child, he kept a meticulously organised stamp [album] full of rare editions.
examples.cn: 小时候，他保存了一本整理得一丝不苟的邮票[册]，里面收藏了许多珍稀版本。

examples.en: The photographer published a stunning [album] documenting the wildlife of the Amazon rainforest.
examples.cn: 这位摄影师出版了一部精彩的[摄影集]，记录了亚马逊雨林的野生动物。

examples.en: Many contemporary artists release their [albums] exclusively on streaming platforms.
examples.cn: 许多当代艺术家仅在流媒体平台上发布他们的[专辑]。

words.translation: n. 酒精, 酒\n[化] 醇; 乙醇; 酒精
words.definition: n. a liquor or brew containing alcohol as the active agent\nn. any of a series of volatile hydroxyl compounds that are made from hydrocarbons by distillation

examples.en: The government raised taxes on [alcohol] as part of a public health initiative.
examples.cn: 政府将[酒精]税提高，作为公共卫生举措的一部分。

examples.en: Excessive consumption of [alcohol] is a leading cause of liver disease and traffic accidents.
examples.cn: 过度饮用[酒精]饮料是肝病和交通事故的主要原因。

examples.en: Medical-grade [alcohol] is used to sterilise equipment and disinfect wounds.
examples.cn: 医用级[酒精]用于消毒设备和消毒伤口。

examples.en: Fermentation converts sugars into [alcohol] through the action of yeast.
examples.cn: 发酵通过酵母的作用将糖转化为[酒精]。

examples.en: The hospital prohibits [alcohol] on its premises to maintain a safe environment for patients.
examples.cn: 医院禁止在其场所内饮用[酒精]饮料，以维护患者的安全环境。

words.translation: n. 酒鬼, 酒精中毒者\na. 酒精的
words.definition: n. a person who drinks alcohol to excess habitually\na. characteristic of or containing alcohol\ns. addicted to alcohol

examples.en: The restaurant offers both [alcoholic] and non-alcoholic beverages on its drinks menu.
examples.cn: 该餐厅的饮品菜单上提供[含酒精]和不含酒精的饮料。

examples.sense: n. 酗酒者；酒精依赖者
examples.en: The recovery centre provides counselling and support for [alcoholics] seeking to rebuild their lives.
examples.cn: 康复中心为寻求重建生活的[酗酒者]提供咨询和支持。

examples.sense: adj. 与酒精中毒相关的
examples.en: His [alcoholic] father's behaviour had a lasting impact on his childhood development.
examples.cn: 他[嗜酒]父亲的行为对他的童年发展产生了持久影响。

examples.en: The patient was admitted with an [alcoholic] liver condition requiring immediate treatment.
examples.cn: 患者因[酒精性]肝病入院，需要立即治疗。

examples.sense: n. 酒精成瘾者（AA中的用法）
examples.en: At the support group, she introduced herself simply as an [alcoholic] in recovery.
examples.cn: 在支持小组中，她只简单地介绍自己是一位正在康复的[酗酒者]。

words.translation: n. 代数学
words.definition: n. the mathematics of generalized arithmetical operations

examples.en: A solid understanding of [algebra] is essential for success in higher mathematics.
examples.cn: 扎实的[代数]基础对于学好高等数学至关重要。

examples.en: Solving simultaneous equations is a core skill in secondary school [algebra].
examples.cn: 解联立方程是中学[代数]的核心技能。

examples.sense: n. 线性代数（高等数学）
examples.en: Linear [algebra] underpins many modern computing algorithms and data analysis techniques.
examples.cn: 线性[代数]是许多现代计算算法和数据分析技术的基础。

examples.sense: n. 代数系统（抽象代数）
examples.en: Abstract [algebra] explores the structures of groups, rings, and fields in pure mathematics.
examples.cn: 抽象[代数]在纯数学中探索群、环、域的结构。

examples.en: The engineer applied [algebra] to calculate the optimal load distribution for the bridge.
examples.cn: 工程师运用[代数]方法计算了桥梁的最优荷载分布。

words.translation: a. 相似的, 同样的\nadv. 一样, 以同样的方式
words.definition: a. having the same or similar characteristics\nr. equally\nr. in a like manner

examples.en: The two proposals are so [alike] in structure that it is difficult to distinguish between them.
examples.cn: 这两份提案在结构上如此[相似]，很难区分。

examples.en: The policy will affect employees and managers [alike], without exception.
examples.cn: 该政策将同样[无一例外]地影响员工和管理人员。

examples.sense: adj. 如出一辙；一模一样
examples.en: The twins look remarkably [alike], often misleading even their closest friends.
examples.cn: 这对双胞胎长得惊人地[相像]，甚至常常误导最亲密的朋友。

examples.en: The charity treats all applicants [alike], regardless of background or social status.
examples.cn: 慈善机构[平等]对待所有申请者，不论其背景或社会地位如何。

examples.en: Science and philosophy are more [alike] than they might initially appear.
examples.cn: 科学和哲学比初看起来更加[相似]。

words.translation: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
words.definition:
a. possessing life
s. (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit
s. (followed by `to' or `of') aware of
s. capable of erupting

examples.en: Rescuers were relieved to find the hiker still [alive] after three days lost in the mountains.
examples.cn: 救援人员发现徒步者在山中失踪三天后仍然[活着]，大为宽慰。

examples.sense: adj. 充满活力的；朝气蓬勃的
examples.en: The city comes [alive] each evening with markets, music, and street performances.
examples.cn: 这座城市每天傍晚都[焕发]生机，充满集市、音乐和街头表演。

examples.en: The auditorium was [alive] with excitement as the curtain rose on opening night.
examples.cn: 开演之夜大幕升起时，礼堂[洋溢]着兴奋之情。

examples.sense: adj. 有效的；仍在运作的
examples.en: The tradition has been kept [alive] by generations of craftsmen who refuse to let it die.
examples.cn: 这一传统被几代拒绝让其消亡的工匠[保持]活力。

examples.sense: adj. 警觉的；警觉到（alive to）
examples.en: Good leaders must remain [alive] to the changing needs of those they serve.
examples.cn: 优秀的领导者必须对其所服务的人群不断变化的需求保持[警觉]。

words.translation:
a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
adv. 全部, 全然
pron. 全部
n. 全部
words.definition: a. quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class\ns. completely given to or absorbed by

examples.en: [All] students are required to submit their assignments before the end of the semester.
examples.cn: [所有]学生须在学期结束前提交作业。

examples.en: The injured player was [all] but certain to miss the remainder of the season.
examples.cn: 受伤的球员[几乎]肯定会缺席本赛季的剩余比赛。

examples.en: She dedicated [all] her energy to completing the ambitious research project on time.
examples.cn: 她将[全部]精力投入到按时完成这个宏大研究项目中。

examples.en: The committee members [all] agreed that immediate action was necessary.
examples.cn: 委员会成员[一致]认为有必要立即采取行动。

examples.en: In the end, [all] that matters is the effort you put into the work.
examples.cn: 归根结底，重要的是你在工作中投入的[一切]努力。

words.translation: a. 对...过敏的, 极反感的\n[医] 变应性的
words.definition: a. characterized by or caused by allergy\ns. having an allergy or peculiar or excessive susceptibility (especially to a specific factor)

examples.en: She is [allergic] to peanuts and always checks ingredient labels before eating packaged food.
examples.cn: 她对花生[过敏]，吃包装食品前总要检查成分标签。

examples.en: The [allergic] reaction to the medication required immediate medical attention.
examples.cn: 对药物的[过敏]反应需要立即就医。

examples.sense: adj. 对……极其反感的（口语）
examples.en: He seemed almost [allergic] to any form of physical exercise and preferred sedentary activities.
examples.cn: 他似乎对任何形式的体育锻炼几乎[极度反感]，更喜欢久坐的活动。

examples.en: The doctor recommended an [allergic] screening test to identify the cause of the rash.
examples.cn: 医生建议进行[过敏]筛查测试以确定皮疹的原因。

examples.en: People with [allergic] constitutions must take extra care during the spring pollen season.
examples.cn: [过敏]体质的人在春季花粉季节必须格外注意。

words.translation: n. 小路, 巷
words.definition: n. a narrow street with walls on both sides

examples.en: The thieves escaped through a narrow [alley] behind the market, disappearing quickly.
examples.cn: 窃贼通过市场后面的一条狭窄[小巷]逃跑，很快消失了。

examples.en: The bowling [alley] was packed on Saturday night with families and groups of friends.
examples.cn: 周六晚上，保龄球[球道]挤满了家庭和朋友群。

examples.en: The garden featured a long [alley] of ancient oak trees leading to the manor house.
examples.cn: 花园里有一条通往庄园的长长的古橡树[林荫道]。

examples.en: The batter hit a powerful shot down the right [alley], earning a double.
examples.cn: 打击手打出一记强劲的右[区]安打，拿到二垒打。

examples.sense: n. 擅长领域（up one's alley）
examples.en: This project is right up her [alley] — it combines data analysis with environmental science.
examples.cn: 这个项目正合她的[胃口]——它结合了数据分析与环境科学。

words.translation: vt. 分派, 分配\n[计] 分配
words.definition: v. distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose

examples.en: The committee decided to [allocate] additional funds to support underprivileged students.
examples.cn: 委员会决定[拨出]额外资金支持贫困学生。

examples.en: The project manager [allocated] specific responsibilities to each member of the team.
examples.cn: 项目经理向团队每个成员[分派]了具体职责。

examples.en: The government [allocated] a significant portion of the national budget to education.
examples.cn: 政府将国家预算的相当一部分[拨给]了教育领域。

examples.en: Thirty minutes were [allocated] for questions at the end of the presentation.
examples.cn: 演示结束后[留出]三十分钟用于提问。

examples.en: Shared costs were [allocated] proportionally based on each company's usage of the facility.
examples.cn: 共享成本根据每家公司对设施的使用情况按比例[分摊]。

words.translation: vt. 允许, 同意给予, 承认\nvi. 容许, 猜想\n[计] 允许命令
words.definition:
v. let have
v. give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause
v. allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something
v. grant as a discount or in exchange

examples.en: The school does not [allow] students to use mobile phones during lessons.
examples.cn: 学校不[允许]学生在上课期间使用手机。

examples.en: Please [allow] three to five working days for the delivery to arrive.
examples.cn: 请[预留]三到五个工作日等待货物送达。

examples.en: New satellite technology [allows] scientists to monitor deforestation in real time.
examples.cn: 新的卫星技术[使]科学家能够实时监测森林砍伐情况。

examples.en: The judge [allowed] that new evidence could be presented at the retrial.
examples.cn: 法官[允许]在重审时提交新证据。

examples.en: The architect [allowed] for potential future expansion when designing the building.
examples.cn: 建筑师在设计建筑时[留有]未来可能扩建的空间。

words.translation: n. 津贴, 零用钱, 限额, 折扣, 允许\nvt. 定量供应
words.definition:
n. an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)
n. a sum granted as reimbursement for expenses
n. an amount added or deducted on the basis of qualifying circumstances
n. a permissible difference; allowing some freedom to move within limits

examples.en: His weekly [allowance] encouraged him to learn basic budgeting and financial management.
examples.cn: 每周的[零用钱]鼓励他学习基本的预算和财务管理。

examples.en: Employees posted overseas receive a generous cost-of-living [allowance].
examples.cn: 外派员工获得丰厚的生活费[补贴]。

examples.en: Each passenger is entitled to a luggage [allowance] of twenty-three kilograms.
examples.cn: 每位乘客有二十三公斤的行李[限额]。

examples.sense: n. 宽容；体谅（make allowance for）
examples.en: The examiner made [allowances] for candidates who were not native speakers of English.
examples.cn: 考官对非英语母语的考生作出了[宽限]。

examples.en: The shop gave her a generous trade-in [allowance] for the old appliance she returned.
examples.cn: 商店为她退回的旧电器给予了丰厚的折旧[折扣]。

words.translation: adv. 几乎, 差不多
words.definition: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but

examples.en: The project was [almost] complete when the funding was unexpectedly withdrawn.
examples.cn: 当资金意外撤回时，项目[几乎]已经完成。

examples.en: It took [almost] two hours to clear the queue at the customs checkpoint.
examples.cn: 在海关通关口排队花了[将近]两个小时。

examples.en: Her performance was [almost] flawless, earning her the highest score of the season.
examples.cn: 她的表演[几近]完美，为她赢得了本赛季的最高分。

examples.en: He [almost] missed the deadline but submitted his application with minutes to spare.
examples.cn: 他[差点]错过截止日期，但还是在最后几分钟内提交了申请。

examples.en: The scientist had achieved [almost] the impossible with her groundbreaking experiment.
examples.cn: 这位科学家的开创性实验[几乎]实现了不可能的事情。

words.translation: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的\nadv. 独自地
words.definition:
s. isolated from others
s. lacking companions or companionship
s. exclusive of anyone or anything else
s. radically distinctive and without equal

examples.en: She preferred to work [alone] rather than in a group when tackling complex problems.
examples.cn: 在处理复杂问题时，她更喜欢[独自]工作而不是在小组中。

examples.en: Living far from family, he often felt utterly [alone] in the crowded city.
examples.cn: 远离家人生活，他在这个拥挤的城市里常常感到完全[孤独]。

examples.en: The cost [alone] should be enough reason to reconsider the proposal.
examples.cn: [仅]成本一项就应该足以重新考虑这个提案。

examples.en: She [alone] possessed the knowledge needed to solve the mysterious code.
examples.cn: [唯有]她具备解开神秘密码所需的知识。

examples.en: The researcher urged policymakers to leave the fragile ecosystem [alone].
examples.cn: 研究人员敦促政策制定者不要干预这个脆弱的生态系统。

words.translation: adv. 平行地, 向前\nprep. 沿着
words.definition:
r. with a forward motion
r. in accompaniment or as a companion
r. to a more advanced state
r. in addition (usually followed by `with')

examples.en: Cyclists enjoy riding [along] the scenic coastal path that stretches for twenty kilometres.
examples.cn: 骑行者喜欢沿着延伸二十公里的风景优美的海岸小径骑行。

examples.en: The convoy moved [along] steadily despite the difficult mountain terrain.
examples.cn: 尽管山地地形艰难，车队仍稳步[前进]。

examples.en: Would you like to come [along] to the conference next week?
examples.cn: 你下周想[一起]来参加会议吗？

examples.en: Trees were planted [along] both sides of the new boulevard to provide shade.
examples.cn: 在新林荫大道两侧[沿途]种植了树木以提供荫凉。

examples.en: The answer had been right there [all along], hidden in plain sight.
examples.cn: 答案[一直]就在那里，就在众目睽睽之下。

words.translation: adv. 在旁边, 靠拢着\nprep. 在...旁边, 与...在一起
words.definition: r side by side

examples.en: The small fishing boats were moored [alongside] the larger cargo vessel in the harbour.
examples.cn: 小渔船停靠在港口较大货船[旁边]。

examples.en: Local volunteers worked [alongside] professional relief workers during the disaster response.
examples.cn: 当地志愿者在灾难救援期间与专业救援人员[并肩]工作。

examples.en: The new initiative was developed [alongside] existing programmes rather than replacing them.
examples.cn: 新举措是与现有项目[并行]开发的，而不是取代它们。

examples.en: When considered [alongside] global benchmarks, the country's progress is impressive.
examples.cn: 与全球基准[相比照]，该国的进步令人印象深刻。

examples.en: Technology should complement [alongside] human creativity, not replace it entirely.
examples.cn: 技术应与人类创造力[相辅相成]，而不是完全取代它。

words.translation: adv. 出声地, 大声地
words.definition: r. using the voice; not silently

examples.en: Reading [aloud] is an effective technique for improving pronunciation and fluency.
examples.cn: [大声]朗读是提高发音和流利度的有效技巧。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to read the passage [aloud] so she could assess their pronunciation.
examples.cn: 老师要求学生[朗读]这段文字，以便她评估他们的发音。

examples.en: She thought [aloud], musing over the problem without fully realising she was being heard.
examples.cn: 她[自言自语]，思考着问题，没有意识到有人在听她说话。

examples.en: He dared to think [aloud] about restructuring the company in front of the board.
examples.cn: 他敢于在董事会面前[公开]说出关于重组公司的想法。

examples.sense: adv. 高声（以便他人听见）
examples.en: The guide asked visitors to speak [aloud] so that everyone in the tour group could hear.
examples.cn: 导游要求游客[大声]说话，以便旅游团中的每个人都能听到。

words.translation: n. 字母\n[计] 字母表
words.definition: n. a character set that includes letters and is used to write a language

examples.en: The Roman [alphabet] is used as the basis for writing in most European languages.
examples.cn: 罗马[字母表]是大多数欧洲语言书写的基础。

examples.en: Learning the [alphabet] is the first step for any child beginning to read and write.
examples.cn: 学习[字母表]是任何孩子开始读写的第一步。

examples.en: The entries in the dictionary are arranged in [alphabetical] order for easy reference.
examples.cn: 词典中的条目按[字母]顺序排列，便于查阅。

examples.en: The Arabic [alphabet] is written from right to left and consists of twenty-eight letters.
examples.cn: 阿拉伯[字母表]从右向左书写，由二十八个字母组成。

examples.en: Understanding the [alphabet] of financial investing takes months of dedicated study.
examples.cn: 了解金融投资的[基础知识]需要数月的专注学习。

words.translation: adv. 已经, 早已
words.definition: r. prior to a specified or implied time

examples.en: By the time the reinforcements arrived, the rescue team had [already] located the survivors.
examples.cn: 援军到达时，救援队[已经]找到了幸存者。

examples.sense: adv. 这么早；如此之快（表惊讶）
examples.en: It's eight o'clock [already] — we need to leave immediately if we want to catch the train.
examples.cn: [已经]八点了——如果我们想赶上火车，需要立即出发。

examples.en: She had [already] prepared a thorough response before the journalist posed the question.
examples.cn: 在记者提问之前，她[已经]准备好了详尽的回答。

examples.sense: adv. 在此之前（过去完成）
examples.en: The researchers [had already] published their preliminary findings before the final results were confirmed.
examples.cn: 研究人员在最终结果得到确认之前[已经]发表了初步研究结果。

examples.sense: adv. 够了；就行了（表不耐烦）
examples.en: That is [already] more information than we need to make a decision.
examples.cn: 这[已经]比我们做决定所需的信息还要多了。

words.translation: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地
words.definition: r in addition

examples.en: She is not only a talented researcher but [also] an accomplished public speaker.
examples.cn: 她不仅是一位才华横溢的研究人员，[也]是一位出色的公众演讲者。

examples.en: The conference addressed economic development and [also] touched on environmental sustainability.
examples.cn: 会议讨论了经济发展，[也]涉及了环境可持续性。

examples.sense: adv. 除此之外（补充信息）
examples.en: He speaks French fluently and [also] has a working knowledge of Spanish and Italian.
examples.cn: 他能流利地说法语，[此外]还具备西班牙语和意大利语的应用能力。

examples.en: The new policy will benefit large corporations, but it should [also] support smaller businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策将使大型企业受益，但[也]应该支持中小型企业。

examples.en: The museum is [also] a research centre, conducting scientific studies on its collections.
examples.cn: 该博物馆[同时]也是一个研究中心，对其馆藏进行科学研究。

words.translation: n. 两者择一, 供替代的选择\na. 两者择一的, 供选择的\n[计] 选择对象
words.definition: s. necessitating a choice between mutually exclusive possibilities\ns. pertaining to unconventional choices

examples.sense: n. 替代选择；备选方案
examples.en: Renewable energy offers a viable [alternative] to fossil fuels for powering the global economy.
examples.cn: 可再生能源为化石燃料提供了一个可行的[替代选择]，用于驱动全球经济。

examples.sense: adj. 另外的；可供选择的
examples.en: The detour provided an [alternative] route when the main road was blocked by flooding.
examples.cn: 当主干道因洪水封堵时，绕行路提供了一条[备用]路线。

examples.en: She pursued an [alternative] lifestyle, rejecting the conventional path of corporate employment.
examples.cn: 她追求[另类]的生活方式，拒绝了传统的企业就业道路。

examples.en: The committee was faced with a stark [alternative]: accept the terms or withdraw from the deal.
examples.cn: 委员会面临一个严峻的[抉择]：接受条款或退出交易。

examples.en: Many patients explore [alternative] therapies alongside conventional medical treatment.
examples.cn: 许多患者在接受传统医疗的同时探索[替代性]疗法。

words.translation: conj. 虽然, 尽管
words.definition: conj. Grant all this; be it that; supposing that;\n   notwithstanding; though.

examples.en: [Although] the experiment failed initially, the researchers refused to abandon the project.
examples.cn: [尽管]实验最初失败了，研究人员还是拒绝放弃这个项目。

examples.en: The film received critical acclaim, [although] it performed modestly at the box office.
examples.cn: 这部电影获得了评论界的好评，[但]票房表现却较为普通。

examples.en: [Although] exhausted after the long journey, she attended the welcome dinner without complaint.
examples.cn: [虽然]长途跋涉后已精疲力竭，她还是毫无怨言地参加了欢迎晚宴。

examples.en: The new policy has its drawbacks, [although] on balance it represents genuine progress.
examples.cn: 新政策有其缺点，[不过]总体而言，它代表了真正的进步。

examples.en: [Although] opinions differ on the best approach, most experts agree on the urgency of the problem.
examples.cn: [尽管]在最佳方法上存在分歧，但大多数专家都同意问题的紧迫性。

words.translation: n. 高度, 海拔, 高处\n[电] 高度
words.definition: n. elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface\nn. the perpendicular distance from the base of a geometric figure to the opposite vertex (or side if parallel)

examples.en: At high [altitude], the reduced oxygen levels make physical exertion more demanding.
examples.cn: 在高[海拔]地区，减少的氧气含量使体力消耗更为困难。

examples.en: The pilot maintained a cruising [altitude] of thirty-five thousand feet above sea level.
examples.cn: 飞行员保持着海平面以上三万五千英尺的巡航[高度]。

examples.en: The ancient monastery was built at a considerable [altitude] to isolate it from the outside world.
examples.cn: 这座古老的寺院建在相当高的[海拔]处，与外界相隔绝。

examples.en: The [altitude] of the sun at noon varies depending on the observer's latitude.
examples.cn: 正午太阳的[仰角]因观测者所处纬度不同而有所差异。

examples.en: Her novel reached a new [altitude] of literary achievement with its intricate narrative structure.
examples.cn: 她的小说凭借其复杂的叙事结构达到了文学成就的新[高度]。

words.translation: adv. 完全地, 总而言之
words.definition: r. with everything included or counted

examples.en: The committee rejected the proposal [altogether], citing insufficient evidence to support it.
examples.cn: 委员会以证据不足为由，[完全]否决了该提案。

examples.en: [Altogether], the project employed over two hundred engineers and specialists.
examples.cn: [总共]，该项目雇用了两百多名工程师和专家。

examples.sense: adv. 总体而言；综合来看
examples.en: [Altogether], the reforms have had a positive impact on the country's economic competitiveness.
examples.cn: [总体而言]，这些改革对该国的经济竞争力产生了积极影响。

examples.en: The situation is not [altogether] hopeless — there are still viable solutions to explore.
examples.cn: 情况并[非完全]无望——仍有可行的解决方案值得探索。

examples.en: The five departments worked [altogether] to produce the comprehensive annual report.
examples.cn: 五个部门[共同]合作，完成了详尽的年度报告。

words.translation: n. 铝\na. 铝的
words.definition: n a silvery ductile metallic element found primarily in bauxite

examples.en: [Aluminium] is widely used in the aerospace industry due to its strength and low weight.
examples.cn: [铝]因其强度高、重量轻的特点被广泛应用于航空航天工业。

examples.en: Recycling [aluminium] requires only five percent of the energy needed to produce it from raw ore.
examples.cn: 回收[铝]所需能源仅为从原矿提炼所需能源的5%。

examples.en: Many modern vehicles use [aluminium] components to reduce overall weight and improve fuel efficiency.
examples.cn: 许多现代汽车使用[铝]合金零部件以减轻整体重量并提高燃油效率。

examples.en: The cooking pots were made of [aluminium], which conducts heat quickly and evenly.
examples.cn: 这些炊具由[铝]制成，导热快而均匀。

examples.en: [Aluminium] has the atomic number thirteen and is the most abundant metal in the Earth's crust.
examples.cn: [铝]的原子序数为13，是地壳中含量最丰富的金属。

words.translation: adv. 总是, 始终
words.definition: r. at all times; all the time and on every occasion\nr. at any time or in any event\nr. forever; throughout all time

examples.en: She [always] arrives at work fifteen minutes early to prepare for the day ahead.
examples.cn: 她[总是]提前十五分钟到达工作单位，为接下来的一天做准备。

examples.en: The principles of scientific inquiry have [always] demanded rigour, honesty, and repeatability.
examples.cn: 科学探究的原则[始终]要求严谨、诚实和可重复性。

examples.sense: adv. 不断地；不停地（表强调）
examples.en: He is [always] finding fault with the team's approach rather than offering constructive solutions.
examples.cn: 他[不断]挑剔团队的方法，而不是提出建设性的解决方案。

examples.en: If the interview goes badly, you can [always] apply for the position again next year.
examples.cn: 如果面试结果不好，你[总可以]明年再次申请这个职位。

examples.en: The institution has [always] been committed to the pursuit of academic excellence.
examples.cn: 该机构[历来]致力于追求学术卓越。

words.translation: be的单数第一人称\n[计] 存取管理程序, 寻址方式, 地址标记, 变址数, 调幅, 辅助存储器
words.definition:
n a radioactive transuranic metallic element; discovered by bombarding uranium with helium atoms
n a master's degree in arts and sciences
n modulation of the amplitude of the (radio) carrier wave
v have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
v be identical to; be someone or something
v occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere
v have an existence, be extant
v happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"
v be identical or equivalent to
v form or compose
v work in a specific place, with a specific subject, or in a specific function
v represent, as of a character on stage
v spend or use time
v have life, be alive
v to remain unmolested, undisturbed, or uninterrupted -- used only in infinitive form
v be priced at

examples.en: The emergency meeting was scheduled for nine [AM], before the markets opened.
examples.cn: 紧急会议定于上午九时[AM]举行，在市场开市之前。

examples.en: The [AM] radio broadcast could be received across the entire region on clear nights.
examples.cn: 晴朗的夜晚，整个地区都能收到[调幅]广播信号。

examples.en: Flights departing at three [AM] require passengers to arrive at the airport by one in the morning.
examples.cn: 凌晨三时起飞的航班要求乘客在上午一时到达机场。

examples.en: She earned her [AM] degree in History from a prestigious university before pursuing her doctorate.
examples.cn: 她在攻读博士学位之前，在一所著名大学获得了历史学[文学硕士]学位。

examples.en: I [am] convinced that consistent effort is the foundation of any meaningful achievement.
examples.cn: 我[坚信]持续努力是任何有意义成就的基础。

words.translation: n. 业余爱好者, 外行, 爱好者\n[电] 业余家
words.definition: n. someone who pursues a study or sport as a pastime\nn. an athlete who does not play for pay\ns. engaged in as a pastime

examples.en: He is a passionate [amateur] photographer whose work has been exhibited in several galleries.
examples.cn: 他是一位热忱的[业余]摄影爱好者，其作品已在多个画廊展出。

examples.en: The [amateur] theatre production received surprisingly enthusiastic reviews from local critics.
examples.cn: 这部[业余]剧场演出出乎意料地获得了当地评论家的热情好评。

examples.en: The committee was criticised for hiring [amateurs] to manage a project of such complexity.
examples.cn: 委员会因聘用[外行人]管理如此复杂的项目而受到批评。

examples.en: Despite its [amateur] production quality, the documentary conveyed a powerful message.
examples.cn: 尽管制作质量[业余]，但这部纪录片传达了强有力的信息。

examples.sense: n. 参赛的非职业选手
examples.en: The marathon includes both professional and [amateur] runners competing on the same course.
examples.cn: 这场马拉松比赛有职业跑者和[业余]跑者在同一赛道上竞技。

words.translation: vt. 使吃惊
words.definition: v. affect with wonder

examples.en: The acrobat's breathtaking performance [amazed] the audience from the very first moment.
examples.cn: 杂技演员令人屏息的表演从第一刻起便令观众[叹为观止]。

examples.en: It continues to [amaze] me how quickly children can adapt to new languages.
examples.cn: 孩子们适应新语言的速度之快至今仍让我[惊叹]。

examples.en: The scale of the archaeological discovery [amazed] even the most experienced researchers.
examples.cn: 考古发现的规模令最有经验的研究人员也[大为惊叹]。

examples.en: Her courage in speaking out against injustice [amazed] those who had considered her timid.
examples.cn: 她勇于挺身反对不公正的勇气，令那些认为她胆怯的人[大为惊叹]。

examples.en: The speed at which the technology has developed has continued to [amaze] industry experts.
examples.cn: 技术发展的速度持续令业内专家[惊讶不已]。

words.translation: a. 令人惊异的
words.definition: s. surprising greatly\ns. inspiring awe or admiration or wonder

examples.sense: adj. 令人惊叹的；不可思议的
examples.en: The [amazing] diversity of life in the ocean depths continues to astonish marine biologists.
examples.cn: 深海中[令人惊叹]的生命多样性持续令海洋生物学家惊叹。

examples.sense: adj. 极好的；出色的（口语）
examples.en: She gave an [amazing] presentation that held the entire conference's attention for an hour.
examples.cn: 她作了一场[精彩绝伦]的演示，吸引了整个会议的注意力长达一小时。

examples.sense: adj. 不可思议的；难以置信的
examples.en: It is [amazing] how much scientific knowledge has been accumulated in the past century.
examples.cn: 过去一个世纪积累了如此多的科学知识，[令人难以置信]。

examples.en: Her [amazing] memory allowed her to recite entire chapters of the textbook from memory.
examples.cn: 她[惊人]的记忆力使她能够凭记忆背诵整章教材。

examples.en: It is [amazing] that such a small team managed to complete the project ahead of schedule.
examples.cn: 如此小的团队竟能提前完成项目，真是[令人惊叹]。

words.translation: n. 大使\n[法] 大使, 使节, 代理
words.definition: n. a diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another\nn. an informal representative

examples.en: The [ambassador] presented his credentials to the head of state upon his arrival in the capital.
examples.cn: [大使]抵达首都后向国家元首递交了国书。

examples.en: She has served as a goodwill [ambassador] for the United Nations since her retirement from sport.
examples.cn: 自从退出体育界以来，她一直担任联合国的亲善[大使]。

examples.sense: n. 形象代言人；倡导者
examples.en: The celebrity [ambassador] helped raise awareness of the charity's work among younger audiences.
examples.cn: 名人[形象大使]帮助在年轻受众中提高了对慈善工作的认知度。

examples.en: The [ambassadors] from all fifteen member states attended the emergency summit in Vienna.
examples.cn: 全部十五个成员国的[大使]出席了在维也纳举行的紧急峰会。

examples.en: The sports brand signed the Olympic champion as their global [ambassador] for three years.
examples.cn: 这家运动品牌签约奥运冠军担任其三年的全球[品牌大使]。

words.translation: a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的\n[法] 意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的
words.definition: a. having more than one possible meaning\ns. having no intrinsic or objective meaning; not organized in conventional patterns

examples.en: The contract's [ambiguous] wording led to a prolonged legal dispute between the two parties.
examples.cn: 合同中[模糊]的措辞导致双方之间长期的法律纠纷。

examples.sense: adj. 不明确的；意义不清的
examples.en: The politician gave an [ambiguous] answer that satisfied neither supporters nor critics.
examples.cn: 这位政治家给出了一个[模棱两可]的答案，既未满足支持者也未满足批评者。

examples.sense: adj. 两可的；双重意义的
examples.en: The title of the novel is deliberately [ambiguous], suggesting multiple interpretations.
examples.cn: 这部小说的书名是故意[模糊]的，暗示着多种解读方式。

examples.sense: adj. 不确定的；难以判断的
examples.en: The medical test results were [ambiguous] and required further investigation.
examples.cn: 医学检测结果[不明确]，需要进一步调查。

examples.en: In academic writing, [ambiguous] pronoun references should always be clarified for precision.
examples.cn: 在学术写作中，[含糊]的代词指代应始终明确以保证精确性。

words.translation: n. 野心, 志向
words.definition: n. a cherished desire\nn. a strong drive for success\nv. have as one's ambition

examples.en: Her [ambition] to become a leading neuroscientist drove her to pursue postgraduate research.
examples.cn: 她成为顶尖神经科学家的[雄心]驱使她攻读研究生学位。

examples.en: His childhood [ambition] was to design aeroplanes, and he never wavered from that dream.
examples.cn: 他童年的[理想]是设计飞机，他从未动摇过那个梦想。

examples.en: Unchecked [ambition] can lead talented individuals to compromise their ethical principles.
examples.cn: 不受约束的[野心]可能导致有才华的个人妥协其道德原则。

examples.en: The organisation's [ambition] is to eradicate preventable diseases in developing nations.
examples.cn: 该组织的[志向]是消除发展中国家的可预防疾病。

examples.en: Students who lack [ambition] may underperform regardless of their natural academic ability.
examples.cn: 缺乏[进取心]的学生无论天生学术能力如何，都可能表现不佳。

words.translation: n. 救护车\n[医] 救护车
words.definition: n. a vehicle that takes people to and from hospitals

examples.en: Bystanders cleared the road immediately so the [ambulance] could reach the scene faster.
examples.cn: 旁观者立即清空道路，以便[救护车]能更快到达现场。

examples.en: The [ambulance] crew provided first aid during the twenty-minute journey to the hospital.
examples.cn: [救护车]人员在二十分钟的送院途中提供了急救处理。

examples.sense: n. 急救医疗服务（广义）
examples.en: Calling an [ambulance] promptly can make the difference between life and death in a stroke.
examples.cn: 在中风时及时呼叫[救护车]可能关系到生死存亡。

examples.en: Florence Nightingale pioneered the use of mobile [ambulance] units during the Crimean War.
examples.cn: 弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔在克里米亚战争期间率先使用了移动[救护]车队。

examples.en: The [ambulance] team worked tirelessly to stabilise the injured victims at the crash site.
examples.cn: [救护]队员在事故现场不遗余力地稳定伤者的伤情。

words.translation: n. 美洲, 美国
words.definition: n. North America and South America and Central America

examples.en: Silicon Valley in [America] is recognised as the global hub of technology innovation.
examples.cn: [美国]的硅谷被公认为全球技术创新中心。

examples.en: Christopher Columbus reached [America] in 1492, transforming global history.
examples.cn: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布于1492年到达[美洲]，改变了世界历史。

examples.en: Jazz music originated in [America] and has since influenced musical traditions worldwide.
examples.cn: 爵士乐起源于[美国]，此后影响了世界各地的音乐传统。

examples.en: The native peoples of [America] developed sophisticated civilisations long before European contact.
examples.cn: [美洲]的原住民在与欧洲人接触之前很久便建立了高度发展的文明。

examples.en: The debate over gun control remains one of the most divisive issues in [America] today.
examples.cn: 枪支管制争论至今仍是[美国]社会中最具争议的问题之一。

words.translation: n. 美国人\na. 美国的, 美洲的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of the United States\nn. a native or inhabitant of a North American or Central American or South American country\na. of or relating to the United States of America or its people or language or culture

examples.en: The [American] dream of social mobility through hard work continues to attract immigrants.
examples.cn: 通过努力工作实现社会流动的[美国]梦想持续吸引着移民。

examples.en: Many [Americans] voted for the first time in decades, energised by the pivotal election issues.
examples.cn: 许多[美国人]受到关键选举议题的激励，数十年来首次投票。

examples.en: [American] bison were nearly hunted to extinction before conservation efforts saved the species.
examples.cn: [美洲]野牛在保护工作拯救该物种之前几乎被猎杀至灭绝。

examples.en: The spread of [American] fast food and popular culture has transformed urban life globally.
examples.cn: [美国]快餐和流行文化的传播已在全球范围内改变了城市生活。

examples.en: The constitution guarantees fundamental rights to all [Americans], regardless of background.
examples.cn: 宪法保障所有[美国公民]的基本权利，不论其背景如何。

words.translation: prep. 在...之中
words.definition: prep. Alt. of Amongst

examples.en: [Among] the candidates, she was considered the most qualified for the senior position.
examples.cn: 在所有候选人[中]，她被认为是最符合高级职位资格的。

examples.en: The responsibilities were divided [among] the five team members according to their expertise.
examples.cn: 责任根据各自专长在五名团队成员[之间]分配。

examples.en: Renewable energy is [among] the fastest-growing sectors of the global economy.
examples.cn: 可再生能源[属于]全球经济增长最快的行业之一。

examples.en: There was considerable disagreement [among] delegates about the proposed resolution.
examples.cn: 代表们[之间]对拟议决议存在相当大的分歧。

examples.en: The nations agreed [among] themselves to establish a joint defence treaty.
examples.cn: 各国[相互]同意建立联合防御条约。

words.translation: n. 总数, 总额\nvi. 总计, 等同
words.definition: n. the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion\nv. be tantamount or equivalent to

examples.en: The [amount] of plastic waste entering the ocean each year is staggering.
examples.cn: 每年进入海洋的塑料垃圾[数量]令人震惊。

examples.en: The total [amount] donated to the charity exceeded two million pounds last year.
examples.cn: 去年捐给该慈善机构的总[金额]超过了两百万英镑。

examples.en: The additional charges [amount] to a significant increase in the overall cost.
examples.cn: 这些额外费用[总计]相当于整体成本的大幅增加。

examples.en: Refusing to cooperate with the investigation [amounts] to an obstruction of justice.
examples.cn: 拒绝配合调查[等同于]妨碍司法公正。

examples.en: No [amount] of persuasion could convince him to change his firmly held position.
examples.cn: 无论多少[程度]的劝说都无法说服他改变其坚定的立场。

words.translation: a. 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的
words.definition: a. more than enough in size or scope or capacity\ns. affording an abundant supply\ns. fairly large

examples.en: There is [ample] evidence to support the conclusion that global temperatures are rising.
examples.cn: 有[充足]的证据支持全球气温正在上升的结论。

examples.en: The new campus provides [ample] space for research laboratories, lecture halls, and student accommodation.
examples.cn: 新校园为研究实验室、讲堂和学生住宿提供了[宽裕]的空间。

examples.en: She had [ample] time to prepare her presentation thoroughly before the board meeting.
examples.cn: 她有[充裕]的时间在董事会议前彻底准备她的演示。

examples.sense: adj. 宽大的；肥大的（体型）
examples.en: The [ample] proportions of the building reflected the grand ambitions of its original designers.
examples.cn: 建筑的[宽大]比例体现了其原始设计者的宏大抱负。

examples.en: The budget allocated for the project proved [ample] to cover all expected and unforeseen costs.
examples.cn: 为项目分配的预算被证明[绰绰有余]，足以覆盖所有预期和意外成本。

words.translation: vt. 消遣, 娱乐, 使发笑
words.definition: v. occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion\nv. make (somebody) laugh

examples.en: The comedian's witty observations about everyday life [amused] the entire audience.
examples.cn: 喜剧演员对日常生活的机智评论[逗乐]了全场观众。

examples.sense: v. 消遣；使（某人）有事可做
examples.en: She [amused] herself during the long flight by reading and listening to podcasts.
examples.cn: 她在漫长的飞行中通过阅读和收听播客来[消遣]。

examples.en: The irony of the situation [amused] her, though she tried not to show it openly.
examples.cn: 这种情况的讽刺意味令她感到[好笑]，尽管她努力不表现出来。

examples.en: Children should be encouraged to [amuse] themselves creatively rather than relying on screens.
examples.cn: 应鼓励孩子们以创造性的方式[自娱]，而不是依赖电子屏幕。

examples.en: His attempts to fix the machine [amused] his colleagues, who could see the obvious solution.
examples.cn: 他修机器的尝试[逗乐]了同事们，他们一眼就看出了显而易见的解决方法。

words.translation: n. 兴味, 娱乐, 消遣\n[法] 娱乐, 娱乐活动
words.definition: n. a feeling of delight at being entertained

examples.en: Reading detective novels is his favourite [amusement] during long business trips.
examples.cn: 阅读侦探小说是他漫长出差途中最喜欢的[消遣]。

examples.en: To everyone's [amusement], the formal speech turned into an unexpectedly humorous story.
examples.cn: 令所有人[忍俊不禁]的是，这篇正式演讲意外地变成了一个幽默故事。

examples.sense: n. 娱乐设施；游乐活动
examples.en: The theme park offers a wide variety of [amusements] suitable for all age groups.
examples.cn: 主题公园提供各种适合所有年龄段的[娱乐]活动。

examples.en: She watched with quiet [amusement] as her students struggled with the deliberately tricky puzzle.
examples.cn: 她以平静的[愉悦]看着学生们费力应对那道故意设计得棘手的谜题。

examples.en: The village fair provided simple [amusements] that brought the community together each summer.
examples.cn: 村庄集市每年夏天提供简单的[娱乐活动]，将社区成员聚集在一起。

words.translation: n. 分析\n[计] 分析机; 分析员; 分析; 分析程序
words.definition:
n. an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole
n. the abstract separation of a whole into its constituent parts in order to study the parts and their relations
n. a form of literary criticism in which the structure of a piece of writing is analyzed
n. the use of closed-class words instead of inflections: e.g., `the father of the bride' instead of `the bride's father'

examples.en: A detailed [analysis] of the data revealed unexpected patterns in consumer behaviour.
examples.cn: 对数据的详细[分析]揭示了消费者行为中意想不到的规律。

examples.sense: n. 化学分析；成分分析
examples.en: Laboratory [analysis] confirmed that the water sample contained unsafe levels of lead.
examples.cn: 实验室[分析]证实，水样含有不安全的铅含量。

examples.sense: n. 心理分析（精神分析）
examples.en: After years of [analysis], she gained a clearer understanding of the root causes of her anxiety.
examples.cn: 经过多年的[分析]，她对自己焦虑的根本原因有了更清晰的认识。

examples.en: The literary [analysis] examined the novel's use of symbolism and narrative structure.
examples.cn: 这篇文学[分析]研究了小说对象征主义和叙事结构的运用。

examples.en: In the final [analysis], the success of the project depended on the commitment of the entire team.
examples.cn: [归根结底]，项目的成功取决于整个团队的投入。

words.translation: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解\n[机] 分析
words.definition: v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning\nv. make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features\nv. break down into components or essential features

examples.en: Scientists [analyze] vast amounts of atmospheric data to track climate patterns.
examples.cn: 科学家[分析]大量大气数据以追踪气候规律。

examples.en: The economist was asked to [analyze] the impact of the new trade policies on domestic industries.
examples.cn: 经济学家被要求[分析]新贸易政策对国内产业的影响。

examples.en: Students were asked to [analyze] the rhetorical techniques used in the political speech.
examples.cn: 要求学生[分析]政治演讲中使用的修辞技巧。

examples.en: The laboratory will [analyze] the soil samples to determine their chemical composition.
examples.cn: 实验室将[分析]土壤样本以确定其化学成分。

examples.en: Before making a decision, it is always wise to [analyze] the potential risks involved.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前，[分析]可能涉及的潜在风险始终是明智之举。

words.translation: n. 祖先, 祖宗
words.definition: n. someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)

examples.en: Many people research their family history to learn more about the lives of their [ancestors].
examples.cn: 许多人研究家族历史以进一步了解[祖先]的生活。

examples.en: The abacus is considered an [ancestor] of the modern electronic computer.
examples.cn: 算盘被认为是现代电子计算机的[鼻祖]。

examples.en: Our [ancestors] depended entirely on nature for food, shelter, and medicine.
examples.cn: 我们的[祖先]完全依赖自然获取食物、庇护所和药物。

examples.en: The steam engine was the [ancestor] of most modern industrial machinery.
examples.cn: 蒸汽机是大多数现代工业机械的[前身]。

examples.en: Homo sapiens shares a common [ancestor] with chimpanzees, according to evolutionary biology.
examples.cn: 根据进化生物学，智人与黑猩猩拥有共同的[祖先]。

words.translation: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
words.definition:
n. a very old person
n. a person who lived in ancient times
s. belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
s. very old

examples.en: The [ancient] civilisations of Egypt, Greece, and Rome laid the foundations of Western culture.
examples.cn: 埃及、希腊和罗马的[古代]文明奠定了西方文化的基础。

examples.sense: adj. 古老的；年代久远的
examples.en: The [ancient] manuscripts were carefully preserved in a climate-controlled archive.
examples.cn: 这些[古老]的手稿被保存在一个恒温控制的档案馆中。

examples.sense: adj. 极老的；非常古旧的（口语）
examples.en: Her [ancient] laptop takes fifteen minutes to start up and crashes regularly.
examples.cn: 她那台[极其老旧]的笔记本电脑启动需要十五分钟，还经常崩溃。

examples.en: [Ancient] Greek philosophy continues to influence modern ethical and political thought.
examples.cn: [古希腊]哲学继续影响着现代伦理和政治思想。

examples.en: Some critics dismissed the proposal as [ancient] thinking that ignored contemporary realities.
examples.cn: 一些批评者将该提案斥为无视当代现实的[陈旧]思想。

words.translation: conj. 和, 与\n[计] 与
words.definition:
conj. A particle which expresses the relation of connection or
   addition. It is used to conjoin a word with a word, a clause with a
   clause, or a sentence with a sentence.
conj. In order to; -- used instead of the infinitival to,
   especially after try, come, go.
conj. It is sometimes, in old songs, a mere expletive.
conj. If; though. See An, conj.

examples.en: Science [and] the humanities are complementary fields that together enrich human understanding.
examples.cn: 科学[与]人文学科是相互补充的领域，共同丰富了人类的认知。

examples.en: She completed her undergraduate degree [and] immediately enrolled in a master's programme.
examples.cn: 她完成了本科学位，[然后]立即攻读硕士课程。

examples.en: The project requires financial investment [and] considerable technical expertise to succeed.
examples.cn: 该项目需要财务投资[并且]需要相当的技术专业知识才能成功。

examples.en: Work consistently every day [and] you will see measurable improvements within months.
examples.cn: 每天坚持工作，[那么]你将在几个月内看到可量化的进步。

examples.en: The problem is complex [and] yet surprisingly simple to solve with the right framework.
examples.cn: 这个问题很复杂，[然而]用正确的框架却出乎意料地简单易解。

words.translation: n. 轶事, 奇闻
words.definition: n. short account of an incident (especially a biographical one)

examples.en: The professor opened his lecture with a humorous [anecdote] about a famous physicist's mistake.
examples.cn: 教授以一则关于一位著名物理学家失误的幽默[轶事]开始了他的讲座。

examples.en: Her speech was filled with personal [anecdotes] that made the abstract concepts feel relatable.
examples.cn: 她的演讲充满了个人[趣闻]，使抽象概念变得贴近生活。

examples.sense: n. 个案（区别于统计数据）
examples.en: A single [anecdote] is not sufficient to draw reliable conclusions about a broader phenomenon.
examples.cn: 单一的[个案]不足以对更广泛的现象得出可靠结论。

examples.en: The biography is rich with [anecdotes] that reveal the statesman's private personality.
examples.cn: 这部传记充满了揭示这位政治家私人性格的[轶事]。

examples.en: The [anecdote] about Newton and the apple, though probably apocryphal, has endured for centuries.
examples.cn: 关于牛顿和苹果的[轶事]虽然可能是杜撰的，但已流传了数百年。

words.translation: n. 忿怒\nvt. 激怒, 使发怒\nvi. 发怒
words.definition:
n. a strong emotion; a feeling that is oriented toward some real or supposed grievance
n. the state of being angry
v. make angry
v. become angry

examples.en: He channelled his [anger] at injustice into writing a powerful political essay.
examples.cn: 他将对不公正的[愤怒]化为动力，写出了一篇有力的政治文章。

examples.en: The misleading report [angered] many scientists who questioned its accuracy.
examples.cn: 这篇误导性的报告[激怒]了许多质疑其准确性的科学家。

examples.en: Public [anger] over the government's handling of the crisis intensified daily.
examples.cn: 公众对政府处理危机方式的[愤怒]每天都在加剧。

examples.en: She concealed her [anger] behind a calm exterior during the contentious board meeting.
examples.cn: 她在争议性的董事会议上用平静的外表掩盖了内心的[恼怒]。

examples.en: The [anger] of the displaced community finally pushed local authorities to act.
examples.cn: 被迁移社区的[激愤]最终迫使地方当局采取行动。

words.translation: n. 角, 角度, 角落\nvi. 钓鱼, 谋取, 博取, 斜向移动, 转变角度\nvt. 使转动角度, 在...钓鱼, 获取
words.definition:
n. the space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians
n. a member of a Germanic people who conquered England and merged with the Saxons and Jutes to become Anglo-Saxons
v. move or proceed at an angle
v. fish with a hook

examples.en: The photographer chose an unusual [angle] to capture the grandeur of the cathedral.
examples.cn: 摄影师选择了一个不寻常的[角度]来捕捉大教堂的宏伟。

examples.en: The documentary explored the conflict from the [angle] of ordinary citizens affected by it.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片从受其影响的普通公民的[视角]探讨了这场冲突。

examples.en: The interior [angles] of a triangle always sum to one hundred and eighty degrees.
examples.cn: 三角形的内[角]之和始终等于一百八十度。

examples.en: The surgeon [angled] the instrument carefully to avoid damaging the surrounding tissue.
examples.cn: 外科医生小心地[倾斜]手术器械，以避免损伤周围组织。

examples.sense: v. 别有用心地写（angle for）
examples.en: The journalist was accused of [angling] her article to support a particular political agenda.
examples.cn: 这位记者被指责故意[歪曲]文章立场以支持特定政治议程。

words.translation: a. 生气的, 愤怒的
words.definition: a. feeling or showing anger\ns. (of the elements) as if showing violent anger\ns. severely inflamed and painful

examples.en: She was deeply [angry] at the blatant disregard for environmental regulations.
examples.cn: 她对公然漠视环境法规的行为感到[深深愤怒]。

examples.sense: adj. 激烈的；情绪激动的
examples.en: The [angry] exchange during the debate reflected deep divisions within the party.
examples.cn: 辩论中[激烈]的交锋反映了党内的深层分裂。

examples.en: The fishing boats struggled against the [angry] sea as the storm worsened.
examples.cn: 随着风暴加剧，渔船在[汹涌]的海浪中挣扎。

examples.sense: adj. 红肿的；炎症的（伤口）
examples.en: The wound looked [angry] and infected, requiring immediate antibiotic treatment.
examples.cn: 伤口看起来[红肿]感染，需要立即进行抗生素治疗。

examples.en: He wrote an [angry] letter to the newspaper condemning the government's inaction.
examples.cn: 他给报纸写了一封[愤怒]的信，谴责政府的不作为。

words.translation: n. 动物\n[医] 动物
words.definition: n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement\ns. marked by the appetites and passions of the body

examples.en: The conservation programme aims to protect [animals] facing extinction in their natural habitats.
examples.cn: 该保护项目旨在保护在自然栖息地面临灭绝的[动物]。

examples.sense: n. 哺乳动物（区别于昆虫等）
examples.en: Mammals are warm-blooded [animals] that give birth to live young and nurse them with milk.
examples.cn: 哺乳动物是温血[动物]，胎生并用乳汁哺育幼崽。

examples.en: Working conditions in the factory were described as fit only for [animals], not human beings.
examples.cn: 工厂的工作条件被描述为只适合[牲畜]，而非人类。

examples.en: He suppressed his [animal] instincts and responded with calculated calm.
examples.cn: 他压制了[本能]的冲动，以经过深思熟虑的冷静作出回应。

examples.sense: n. 生物（哲学、生物学广义）
examples.en: Aristotle classified humans as rational [animals], distinct from other creatures by reason.
examples.cn: 亚里士多德将人类归类为理性[动物]，以理性区别于其他生物。

words.translation: n. 踝\n[医] 踝, 踝关节
words.definition: n. a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus

examples.en: She twisted her [ankle] during training and was unable to compete in the championship.
examples.cn: 她在训练中扭伤了[脚踝]，无法参加锦标赛。

examples.en: The physiotherapist designed a rehabilitation programme to strengthen the injured [ankle].
examples.cn: 理疗师设计了一套康复方案来强化受伤的[踝关节]。

examples.en: She wore a delicate bracelet around her [ankle] that jingled softly as she walked.
examples.cn: 她的[脚踝]上戴着一个精致的脚链，走路时轻轻叮当作响。

examples.en: The floodwater had risen to [ankle] depth, making it difficult to walk through the streets.
examples.cn: 洪水已经上涨到[脚踝]深，在街道上行走十分困难。

examples.en: Proper footwear provides crucial support for the [ankle] during high-impact exercise.
examples.cn: 适合的鞋履在高强度运动中为[脚踝]提供关键支撑。

words.translation: n. 周年纪念
words.definition: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

examples.en: The company is celebrating its fiftieth [anniversary] with a special exhibition of its history.
examples.cn: 公司正在以一场特别的历史展览庆祝其五十周年[纪念日]。

examples.en: They renewed their vows on their twenty-fifth wedding [anniversary] in front of close family.
examples.cn: 他们在结婚二十五周年[纪念日]在近亲面前重新宣誓。

examples.en: The [anniversary] of the armistice was marked by a national ceremony at the war memorial.
examples.cn: 停战[周年纪念日]由一场在战争纪念碑举行的国家仪式来纪念。

examples.en: The orchestra performs a special concert each year to mark the [anniversary] of its founding.
examples.cn: 乐团每年举办特别音乐会，以纪念其创立[周年纪念]。

examples.en: On the [anniversary] of the disaster, survivors gathered to pay tribute to those who had perished.
examples.cn: 在灾难[周年纪念日]，幸存者聚集在一起向遇难者致敬。

words.translation: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告\nvi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
words.definition:
v. make known; make an announcement
v. announce publicly or officially
v. give the names of
v. foreshadow or presage

examples.en: The prime minister [announced] a sweeping package of economic reforms at the press conference.
examples.cn: 首相在新闻发布会上[宣布]了一揽子全面的经济改革方案。

examples.en: The university [announced] the results of the entrance examination on its official website.
examples.cn: 大学在其官方网站上[公布]了入学考试的结果。

examples.en: The chairperson [announced] that the next committee meeting would be held online.
examples.cn: 主席[通知]下次委员会会议将在线上举行。

examples.en: The first blossoms [announced] the arrival of spring after the long, cold winter.
examples.cn: 第一批花朵[宣示]了漫长寒冬后春天的到来。

examples.en: The host [announced] each performer by name before they took to the stage.
examples.cn: 主持人在每位表演者上台前都[介绍]了其姓名。

words.translation: n. 公告, 发表, 告知\n[经] 通告, 布告, 公告
words.definition: n. a formal public statement\nn. a public statement containing information about an event that has happened or is going to happen

examples.en: The [announcement] of the merger sent the company's stock price soaring overnight.
examples.cn: 合并[公告]一夜之间使公司股价大幅攀升。

examples.en: The official [announcement] of the election results was delayed due to technical problems.
examples.cn: 选举结果的官方[公告]因技术问题而推迟发布。

examples.en: A public address [announcement] informed passengers of the unexpected change to the schedule.
examples.cn: 一则广播[通知]告知乘客时刻表的意外变更。

examples.en: The [announcement] posted on the notice board invited applications for the leadership position.
examples.cn: 张贴在公告栏上的[启事]邀请人们申请领导职位。

examples.en: The scientist's [announcement] of a breakthrough in cancer research made international headlines.
examples.cn: 科学家关于癌症研究突破的[宣布]登上了国际头条。

words.translation: vt. 使恼怒, 骚扰
words.definition: v. cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations

examples.en: It [annoys] her when colleagues interrupt meetings with unrelated personal conversations.
examples.cn: 同事在会议中插入无关的私人谈话让她感到[烦恼]。

examples.en: The persistent noise from the construction work [annoyed] residents throughout the summer.
examples.cn: 建筑施工持续的噪音在整个夏天令居民感到[烦扰]。

examples.en: He was [annoyed] by the constant interruptions during his attempt to concentrate.
examples.cn: 他在试图集中注意力时不断被打断，为此感到[恼火]。

examples.en: Her tendency to dismiss others' ideas without consideration [annoyed] even her closest colleagues.
examples.cn: 她不加考虑就否定他人想法的倾向[惹怒]了连她最亲密的同事。

examples.en: Students were asked not to [annoy] the librarian with requests that were clearly outside her role.
examples.cn: 学生被要求不要以明显超出职责范围的请求[打扰]图书管理员。

words.translation: n. 年刊, 年报\na. 每年的, 一年一次的, 全年的, 一年生的
words.definition:
n. (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year
n. a reference book that is published regularly once every year
a. completing its life cycle within a year
s. occurring or payable every year

examples.sense: adj. 每年的；一年一度的
examples.en: The [annual] conference brings together researchers from over forty countries to share findings.
examples.cn: [一年一度]的会议汇聚了来自四十多个国家的研究人员共享研究成果。

examples.sense: adj. 年度的；按年计算的
examples.en: The company's [annual] report showed a significant increase in revenue compared to the previous year.
examples.cn: 公司的[年度]报告显示，与上年相比收入显著增长。

examples.en: Sunflowers are popular [annuals] that bloom spectacularly before dying off in autumn.
examples.cn: 向日葵是受欢迎的[一年生植物]，在秋天枯萎前开得绚烂夺目。

examples.sense: adj. 年均的；每年的（统计）
examples.en: The [annual] inflation rate reached its highest level in over a decade last year.
examples.cn: 去年的[年]通货膨胀率达到了十多年来的最高水平。

examples.en: The school publishes an [annual] that documents student achievements throughout the academic year.
examples.cn: 学校出版一本[年刊]，记录整个学年的学生成就。

words.translation: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的\npron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个
words.definition: s. any of various alternatives; some other
