words.translation: n. 假定, 自负, 担任, 假装\n[经] 假定, 承担
words.definition:
n. a hypothesis that is taken for granted
n. the act of taking possession of or power over something
n. celebration in the Roman Catholic Church of the Virgin Mary's being taken up into heaven when her earthly life ended; corresponds to the Dormition in the Eastern Orthodox Church
n. (Christianity) the taking up of the body and soul of the Virgin Mary when her earthly life had ended

examples.en: The economic model rests on several key [assumptions] that may not hold in reality.
examples.cn: 这一经济模型依赖于几个在现实中可能不成立的关键[假设]。

examples.en: Her [assumption] that everyone had read the report led to confusion during the meeting.
examples.cn: 她[想当然地以为]每个人都读过报告，导致会议期间出现混乱。

examples.en: The [assumption] of the presidency marked a new chapter in the nation's political history.
examples.cn: 总统职位的[接任]标志着国家政治历史的新篇章。

examples.en: His [assumption] that the role was already his before the formal selection offended many colleagues.
examples.cn: 他在正式遴选前便[理所当然地认为]职位已属于自己，冒犯了许多同事。

examples.en: The [Assumption] of the Virgin Mary is celebrated as a major feast day in the Catholic Church.
examples.cn: 圣母玛利亚的[升天节]在天主教会中作为重要节日庆祝。

words.translation: vt. 使惊讶
words.definition: v affect with wonder

examples.en: The speed of the technological transformation continued to [astonish] even the most seasoned experts.
examples.cn: 技术变革的速度持续令即使是最资深的专家也[惊叹]不已。

examples.en: It never ceases to [astonish] observers how rapidly attitudes toward renewable energy have shifted.
examples.cn: 人们对可再生能源态度的转变速度之快，永远不会停止[令]观察者[惊叹]。

examples.en: The jury was [astonished] by the dramatic reversal of events during the final day of the trial.
examples.cn: 审判最后一天戏剧性的事件逆转令陪审团[大为震惊]。

examples.en: Her ability to learn five languages in two years [astonished] the entire linguistics department.
examples.cn: 她在两年内学会五门语言的能力令整个语言学系[叹服]。

examples.en: The young pianist's maturity and depth of expression [astonished] the international judges.
examples.cn: 年轻钢琴家的成熟度和表达深度令国际评委[叹为观止]。

words.translation: n. 太空旅行者, 宇航员\n[法] 美国太空人
words.definition: n. a person trained to travel in a spacecraft

examples.en: The [astronaut] spent six months aboard the International Space Station conducting scientific experiments.
examples.cn: [宇航员]在国际空间站上停留了六个月，进行科学实验。

examples.en: China's first [astronaut] in space inspired a generation of young people to pursue careers in science.
examples.cn: 中国第一位[航天员]进入太空，激励了一代年轻人投身科学事业。

examples.en: Training to become an [astronaut] requires years of intensive physical and intellectual preparation.
examples.cn: 接受训练成为[宇航员]需要多年密集的体能和智力准备。

examples.en: The crew of [astronauts] successfully repaired the damaged satellite during the spacewalk.
examples.cn: [宇航员]机组人员在太空行走中成功修复了受损的卫星。

examples.en: Neil Armstrong, the first [astronaut] to walk on the Moon, became a symbol of human achievement.
examples.cn: 第一个在月球上行走的[宇航员]尼尔·阿姆斯特朗成为人类成就的象征。

words.translation: n. 天文学家
words.definition: n. a physicist who studies astronomy

examples.en: The [astronomer] spent years mapping previously uncharted regions of the night sky.
examples.cn: 这位[天文学家]花了数年时间绘制以前未探索的夜空区域地图。

examples.en: Ancient [astronomers] used the movement of stars to predict seasons and navigate the seas.
examples.cn: 古代[天文学家]利用星象运动来预测季节和航海。

examples.en: The [astronomer] detected an unusual radio signal that intrigued the scientific community.
examples.cn: 这位[天文学家]探测到了一个令科学界着迷的异常无线电信号。

examples.en: The team of [astronomers] collaborated internationally to study a recently discovered exoplanet.
examples.cn: 这支[天文学家]团队进行了国际合作，研究一颗最新发现的系外行星。

examples.en: She is an amateur [astronomer] who photographs galaxies from her backyard observatory.
examples.cn: 她是一位业余[天文学家]，在后院天文台拍摄星系照片。

words.translation: n. 天文学
words.definition: n. the branch of physics that studies celestial bodies and the universe as a whole

examples.en: Modern [astronomy] has revealed that the universe contains hundreds of billions of galaxies.
examples.cn: 现代[天文学]已揭示宇宙包含数千亿个星系。

examples.en: Radio [astronomy] has allowed scientists to study celestial objects that emit no visible light.
examples.cn: 射电[天文学]使科学家能够研究不发出可见光的天体。

examples.en: The invention of the telescope transformed [astronomy] from a purely theoretical discipline.
examples.cn: 望远镜的发明将[天文学]从纯粹的理论学科中解放出来。

examples.en: Students interested in [astronomy] can attend the weekly stargazing sessions at the observatory.
examples.cn: 对[天文学]感兴趣的学生可以参加天文台每周的观星活动。

examples.en: The boundary between [astronomy] and cosmology has become increasingly blurred in recent decades.
examples.cn: 近几十年来，[天文学]与宇宙学之间的界限变得越来越模糊。

words.translation: prep. 在, 向, 对\n[计] 地址转换器, 异常传输, 自动订票
words.definition: n. 100 at equal 1 kip in Laos

examples.en: The annual summit will be held [at] the United Nations headquarters in New York.
examples.cn: 年度峰会将在纽约联合国总部[举行]。

examples.en: The laboratory publishes its findings [at] regular intervals throughout the year.
examples.cn: 实验室全年[定期]发布研究结果。

examples.en: The report was aimed [at] policymakers rather than the general public.
examples.cn: 这份报告的目标受众是政策制定者，而非普通大众。

examples.en: The company was [at] a crossroads, needing to choose between expansion and consolidation.
examples.cn: 公司处[于]十字路口，需要在扩张和整合之间作出选择。

examples.en: She excels [at] statistical analysis and has published widely in peer-reviewed journals.
examples.cn: 她在统计分析方面[表现出色]，在经同行评审的期刊上广泛发表论文。

words.translation: n. 运动员, 运动选手\n[医] 运动员
words.definition: n. a person trained to compete in sports

examples.sense: n. 运动员；田径运动员
examples.en: The elite [athlete] maintained a rigorous training schedule of eight hours per day.
examples.cn: 这位精英[运动员]保持着每天八小时的严格训练时间表。

examples.en: Many professional [athletes] partner with charities to use their public profile for social good.
examples.cn: 许多职业[运动员]与慈善机构合作，利用其公众形象服务社会。

examples.en: She was a natural [athlete] who excelled at several different sports simultaneously.
examples.cn: 她是天生的[运动健将]，同时在几项不同运动中表现出色。

examples.sense: n. 参赛运动员（奥运会）
examples.en: Over ten thousand [athletes] competed in the Summer Olympics that year.
examples.cn: 那年有一万多名[运动员]参加了夏季奥运会。

examples.en: The scholarship programme identifies talented young [athletes] and supports their development.
examples.cn: 该奖学金项目发掘有才华的年轻[运动员]并支持他们的发展。

words.translation: a. 运动的
words.definition: a. relating to or befitting athletics or athletes\ns. having a sturdy and well proportioned body

examples.en: Her [athletic] build and stamina made her a strong candidate for the national triathlon team.
examples.cn: 她的[运动型]体格和耐力使她成为国家铁人三项队的有力候选人。

examples.en: The [athletic] coordinator designed fitness programmes tailored to each student's physical ability.
examples.cn: [体育]协调员设计了针对每位学生体能的健身项目。

examples.en: The school's [athletic] achievements were celebrated at the annual awards ceremony.
examples.cn: 学校的[运动]成就在年度颁奖典礼上受到表彰。

examples.en: She led an [athletic] lifestyle that included cycling, swimming, and weekly yoga sessions.
examples.cn: 她过着[运动型]的生活方式，包括骑行、游泳和每周瑜伽课。

examples.en: The university actively recruits [athletic] students who also demonstrate strong academic potential.
examples.cn: 大学积极招募同时展现出强劲学术潜力的[运动型]学生。

words.translation: n. 体育运动
words.definition: n. participation in sports events as an extracurricular activity

examples.en: She won three gold medals in [athletics] at the regional championships last summer.
examples.cn: 她去年夏天在地区锦标赛的[田径]比赛中获得了三枚金牌。

examples.sense: n. 体育锻炼（集体活动）
examples.en: The school places equal emphasis on academic excellence and participation in [athletics].
examples.cn: 学校对学业成绩和参与[体育运动]给予同等重视。

examples.sense: n. 运动（美式：各类体育项目）
examples.en: College [athletics] programmes in the United States provide scholarships to talented student athletes.
examples.cn: 美国大学[体育]项目为有才华的学生运动员提供奖学金。

examples.sense: n. 竞技运动（职业水平）
examples.en: World [athletics] governing bodies have introduced stricter rules to ensure fair competition.
examples.cn: 世界[田径]管理机构引入了更严格的规则以确保公平竞争。

examples.en: Ancient Greek [athletics] formed the foundation of the modern Olympic Games tradition.
examples.cn: 古希腊[竞技运动]奠定了现代奥运会传统的基础。

words.translation: n. 大西洋\na. 大西洋的
words.definition: n. the 2nd largest ocean; separates North and South America on the west from Europe and Africa on the east\na. relating to or bordering the Atlantic Ocean

examples.en: The [Atlantic] Ocean separates the continents of Europe and Africa from the Americas.
examples.cn: [大西洋]将欧洲和非洲大陆与美洲分隔开来。

examples.en: The [Atlantic] coast of Portugal is renowned for its dramatic cliffs and surfing conditions.
examples.cn: 葡萄牙的[大西洋]海岸以其壮观的悬崖和冲浪条件而闻名。

examples.en: [Atlantic] trade routes in the eighteenth century shaped the modern global economy.
examples.cn: 十八世纪的[大西洋]贸易路线塑造了现代全球经济。

examples.en: The North [Atlantic] Treaty Organisation was founded in 1949 as a collective defence alliance.
examples.cn: 北[大西洋]公约组织成立于1949年，是一个集体防御联盟。

examples.sense: adj. 跨越大西洋的（文化）
examples.en: The [Atlantic] partnership between Europe and North America remains a cornerstone of global diplomacy.
examples.cn: 欧洲与北美之间的[大西洋]伙伴关系仍然是全球外交的基石。

words.translation: n. 大气, 空气, 气氛\n[医] 大气; 大气压
words.definition:
n. a particular environment or surrounding influence
n. the mass of air surrounding the Earth
n. the weather or climate at some place
n. the envelope of gases surrounding any celestial body

examples.en: Greenhouse gases trap heat in the Earth's [atmosphere], contributing to global warming.
examples.cn: 温室气体将热量困在地球[大气层]中，导致全球变暖。

examples.en: The concert hall had a warm, intimate [atmosphere] that drew the audience into the performance.
examples.cn: 音乐厅有一种温馨而亲密的[气氛]，将观众带入了表演之中。

examples.en: A supportive [atmosphere] in the workplace encourages employees to take creative risks.
examples.cn: 工作场所中支持性的[氛围]鼓励员工勇于进行创意冒险。

examples.en: Pollutants released by industry are degrading the [atmosphere] of many urban centres.
examples.cn: 工业释放的污染物正在恶化许多城市中心的[空气质量]。

examples.en: The pressure at sea level is approximately one [atmosphere], or 101,325 pascals.
examples.cn: 海平面处的气压约为一[大气压]，即101,325帕斯卡。

words.translation: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量\n[计] 原子
words.definition: n. (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element\nn. (nontechnical usage) a tiny piece of anything

examples.en: The splitting of the [atom] released energy far beyond what scientists had initially predicted.
examples.cn: [原子]的分裂释放出远超科学家最初预测的能量。

examples.sense: n. 最小单位；极微小量
examples.en: There was not an [atom] of truth in the rumours that circulated after the announcement.
examples.cn: 公告发布后流传的谣言中没有一[点]真实成分。

examples.en: Every element in the periodic table is defined by the number of protons in its [atom].
examples.cn: 元素周期表中每种元素都由其[原子]中质子的数量来界定。

examples.en: The peaceful use of the [atom] for energy generation remains a contentious political issue.
examples.cn: 和平利用[原子]能发电仍然是一个有争议的政治问题。

examples.en: Quantum physics explores the behaviour of particles far smaller than a single [atom].
examples.cn: 量子物理学探索比单个[原子]小得多的粒子的行为。

words.translation: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附属, 使喜爱, 系, 缚\nvi. 附属, 归属, 联系在一起\n[计] 挂接服务器命令, 关联, 挂接, 附加
words.definition: v. cause to be attached\nv. be attached; be in contact with\nv. become attached

examples.en: Please [attach] your CV and a covering letter when applying for the position.
examples.cn: 申请职位时，请[附上]您的简历和求职信。

examples.en: The engineer [attached] the sensor to the pipeline to monitor pressure changes.
examples.cn: 工程师将传感器[连接]到管道上，以监测压力变化。

examples.en: She had become deeply [attached] to the small community where she had spent her childhood.
examples.cn: 她对度过童年的那个小社区产生了深深的[依恋]。

examples.en: The journalist was [attached] to the military unit for the duration of the campaign.
examples.cn: 在整个战役期间，记者被[分配]到军事单位随行采访。

examples.en: Different cultures [attach] varying degrees of significance to public displays of emotion.
examples.cn: 不同文化对情绪的公开表达所[赋予]的重要性程度不同。

words.translation: n. 攻击, 抨击\nvt. 攻击, 抨击, 动手干\nvi. 攻击
words.definition:
n. (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons)
n. an offensive move in a sport or game
n. the act of attacking
n. a decisive manner of beginning a musical tone or phrase

examples.en: The cyber [attack] targeted critical infrastructure and disrupted essential public services.
examples.cn: 网络[攻击]针对关键基础设施，扰乱了基本公共服务。

examples.en: He suffered a severe [attack] of asthma during the high-altitude hike.
examples.cn: 他在高海拔徒步期间遭受了严重的哮喘[发作]。

examples.en: The editorial [attacked] the government's failure to address the housing crisis effectively.
examples.cn: 社论[抨击]了政府未能有效应对住房危机。

examples.sense: v. 积极着手；大力推进
examples.en: The research team [attacked] the problem from multiple angles simultaneously.
examples.cn: 研究团队同时从多个角度[着力攻克]这一问题。

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to acid rain can [attack] even the most durable stone surfaces.
examples.cn: 长期暴露在酸雨中甚至会[侵蚀]最耐用的石材表面。

words.translation: vt. 达到, 获得\nvi. 达到
words.definition:
v to gain with effort
v reach a point in time, or a certain state or level
v find unexpectedly
v reach a destination, either real or abstract

examples.en: Through persistent effort, she [attained] a level of fluency that impressed native speakers.
examples.cn: 通过坚持不懈的努力，她[达到]了令母语者印象深刻的流利程度。

examples.en: The company [attained] international recognition for its innovative approach to sustainable design.
examples.cn: 该公司因其创新的可持续设计方法而[获得]了国际认可。

examples.en: Students who [attain] the required score in the entrance examination will be offered a place.
examples.cn: 在入学考试中[达到]要求分数的学生将获得录取资格。

examples.en: The expedition finally [attained] its goal after weeks of difficult mountaineering.
examples.cn: 探险队经过数周艰难的登山之后，终于[实现]了目标。

examples.en: Mastery of any discipline can only be [attained] through years of dedicated practice and study.
examples.cn: 任何学科的精通只能通过多年专注的练习和学习来[达到]。

words.translation: n. 尝试, 企图\nvt. 尝试, 企图
words.definition: n. earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something

examples.en: Her first [attempt] at publishing a novel was rejected, but she refused to give up.
examples.cn: 她第一次[尝试]出版小说遭到拒绝，但她拒绝放弃。

examples.en: Investigators [attempted] to reconstruct the sequence of events leading to the accident.
examples.cn: 调查人员[试图]重建导致事故的事件顺序。

examples.en: The [attempt] to break the world record fell short by just three seconds.
examples.cn: 打破世界纪录的[尝试]仅差三秒未能成功。

examples.en: Security services foiled a suspected [attempt] on the life of the visiting dignitary.
examples.cn: 安全部门挫败了一次针对来访要人生命的疑似[谋杀图谋]。

examples.en: Students may make three [attempts] at the practical examination before requiring additional training.
examples.cn: 学生可对实践考试进行三次[作答]，之后才需要额外培训。

words.translation: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随\nvi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席
words.definition:
v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
v. take charge of or deal with
v. to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result
v. give heed (to)

examples.en: All department heads were required to [attend] the emergency budget review meeting.
examples.cn: 所有部门负责人均被要求[出席]紧急预算审查会议。

examples.en: She [attended] an international school before enrolling at university in her home country.
examples.cn: 她在本国大学入学之前[就读]于一所国际学校。

examples.en: Nurses [attended] to the patients throughout the night during the emergency.
examples.cn: 紧急情况期间，护士整夜[照料]患者。

examples.en: Students are expected to [attend] to feedback provided on their written assignments.
examples.cn: 学生被要求[关注]书面作业上的反馈意见。

examples.en: The prime minister was [attended] by a delegation of senior advisers during the state visit.
examples.cn: 首相在国事访问期间由一个高级顾问代表团[陪同]。

words.translation: n. 注意, 注意力\n[计] 引起注意信号
words.definition:
n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others
n. a general interest that leads people to want to know more
n. a courteous act indicating affection
n. the faculty or power of mental concentration

examples.en: The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics captured the [attention] of every student in the hall.
examples.cn: 教授关于量子力学的讲座吸引了大厅里每位学生的[注意]。

examples.en: Paying close [attention] to details is essential when proofreading academic papers.
examples.cn: 校对学术论文时，密切[关注]细节至关重要。

examples.en: The charity campaign drew national [attention] to the plight of homeless children.
examples.cn: 这次慈善活动引起了全国对流浪儿童困境的[关注]。

examples.en: His sudden collapse in the corridor attracted the [attention] of passing nurses immediately.
examples.cn: 他在走廊里突然晕倒，立刻引起了路过护士的[注意]。

examples.en: Social media platforms are designed to compete for users' [attention] around the clock.
examples.cn: 社交媒体平台旨在全天候争夺用户的[注意力]。

words.translation: adv. 注意地, 留心地
words.definition: r. with attention; in an attentive manner

examples.en: The students listened [attentively] as the teacher explained the rules of calculus.
examples.cn: 学生们[专心地]听老师讲解微积分的规则。

examples.en: She watched [attentively] while the surgeon demonstrated the delicate procedure on a model.
examples.cn: 她[专注地]观看外科医生在模型上演示精细操作。

examples.en: Reading [attentively] rather than skimming is the key to retaining complex information.
examples.cn: [专注地]阅读而非浏览是记住复杂信息的关键。

examples.en: The audience sat [attentively] through the three-hour performance without a single distraction.
examples.cn: 观众[专心地]坐着看完了三小时的表演，没有任何分心。

examples.en: He nodded [attentively] as his mentor outlined the steps required for the research project.
examples.cn: 他[专注地]点头，听导师概述研究项目所需的步骤。

words.translation: n. 态度, 看法, 姿势\n[医] 体态, 姿势, 态度
words.definition: n. a complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways\nn. a theatrical pose created for effect\nn. position of aircraft or spacecraft relative to a frame of reference (the horizon or direction of motion)

examples.en: Her positive [attitude] towards failure helped her overcome every obstacle in her career.
examples.cn: 她对失败的积极[态度]帮助她克服了职业生涯中的每一个障碍。

examples.en: The government's [attitude] towards environmental protection has shifted significantly over the past decade.
examples.cn: 政府对环境保护的[态度]在过去十年中发生了显著转变。

examples.en: Developing a responsible [attitude] towards one's studies is fundamental to academic success.
examples.cn: 培养对学业负责任的[态度]是学业成功的基础。

examples.en: His dismissive [attitude] during the negotiation offended several members of the opposing delegation.
examples.cn: 他在谈判中轻蔑的[态度]冒犯了对方代表团的几位成员。

examples.en: Society's [attitude] towards mental health has become more open and compassionate in recent years.
examples.cn: 近年来，社会对心理健康的[态度]变得更加开放和富有同情心。

words.translation: vt. 吸引, 诱惑\nvi. 有吸引力
words.definition: v. direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes\nv. be attractive to\nv. exert a force on (a body) causing it to approach or prevent it from moving away

examples.en: The ancient ruins [attract] millions of tourists from around the world every year.
examples.cn: 这些古代遗址每年[吸引]来自世界各地的数百万游客。

examples.en: Bold headlines are crafted specifically to [attract] the reader's eye on a crowded page.
examples.cn: 醒目的标题是专门设计来在拥挤的版面上[吸引]读者眼球的。

examples.en: The new research centre hopes to [attract] top scientists from leading universities worldwide.
examples.cn: 这个新研究中心希望[吸引]来自全球顶尖大学的优秀科学家。

examples.en: Bright flowers [attract] pollinators such as bees and butterflies to the garden.
examples.cn: 鲜艳的花朵[吸引]蜜蜂和蝴蝶等传粉者来到花园。

examples.en: The company redesigned its website to [attract] a younger and more tech-savvy demographic.
examples.cn: 该公司重新设计了网站，以[吸引]更年轻、更懂技术的人群。

words.translation: n. 吸引, 吸引人的事物, 吸引力\n[医] 吸引
words.definition:
n. the force by which one object attracts another
n. an entertainment that is offered to the public
n. the quality of arousing interest; being attractive or something that attracts
n. a characteristic that provides pleasure and attracts

examples.sense: n. 吸引力；吸引人的事物
examples.en: The Great Wall remains China's most iconic tourist [attraction], drawing visitors from every continent.
examples.cn: 长城仍然是中国最具标志性的旅游[景点]，吸引来自各大洲的游客。

examples.sense: n. 吸引力；吸引人的事物
examples.en: The mutual [attraction] between the two scientists led to a fruitful research partnership.
examples.cn: 两位科学家之间相互的[吸引力]促成了富有成效的研究合作。

examples.sense: n. 吸引力；吸引人的事物
examples.en: Gravitational [attraction] between celestial bodies governs the motion of planets in our solar system.
examples.cn: 天体之间的引力[吸引]支配着太阳系中行星的运动。

examples.sense: n. 吸引力；吸引人的事物
examples.en: The city's main [attraction] is its vibrant street food culture that operates late into the night.
examples.cn: 这座城市的主要[吸引力]在于其充满活力、营业至深夜的街头美食文化。

examples.sense: n. 吸引力；吸引人的事物
examples.en: Part of literature's enduring [attraction] lies in its ability to transport readers to other worlds.
examples.cn: 文学经久不衰的[魅力]部分在于其将读者带入其他世界的能力。

words.translation: a. 吸引人的, 有魅力的\n[法] 有吸引力的, 有迷惑力的
words.definition: a. pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm\ns. having power to arouse interest\na. having the properties of a magnet; the ability to draw or pull;

examples.sense: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
examples.en: The scholarship package was particularly [attractive] to students from lower-income families.
examples.cn: 这个奖学金套餐对来自低收入家庭的学生特别[有吸引力]。

examples.sense: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
examples.en: Designers strive to create [attractive] layouts that guide the user's eye naturally across the screen.
examples.cn: 设计师努力创造[吸引人的]布局，引导用户的视线自然地在屏幕上移动。

examples.sense: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
examples.en: The coastal town's [attractive] blend of history and natural beauty draws artists and writers alike.
examples.cn: 这个沿海小镇迷人的[魅力]融合了历史与自然美景，吸引了艺术家和作家。

examples.sense: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
examples.en: An [attractive] salary alone is no longer sufficient to retain talented employees in competitive industries.
examples.cn: 在竞争激烈的行业中，仅凭[诱人的]薪资已不足以留住有才华的员工。

examples.sense: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的
examples.en: The proposal was made more [attractive] by the inclusion of flexible working arrangements.
examples.cn: 加入灵活工作安排后，这个提案变得更加[吸引人]。

words.translation: n. 听众, 观众, 读者\n[法] 听讼, 观众, 听众
words.definition: n. a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance\nn. the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment

examples.en: The [audience] fell silent as the conductor raised his baton to begin the symphony.
examples.cn: 指挥举起指挥棒准备开始交响乐时，[观众]鸦雀无声。

examples.en: Social media allows authors to build a loyal [audience] without traditional publishing channels.
examples.cn: 社交媒体让作者无需传统出版渠道便能建立忠实的[读者群]。

examples.en: The documentary reached a global [audience] of over 50 million viewers within its first week.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片在首周内便触及了超过5000万的全球[观众]。

examples.en: A skilled orator knows how to adapt the message to suit the specific [audience] being addressed.
examples.cn: 一个有技巧的演说家知道如何调整信息以适应特定的[听众]。

examples.en: The play received a standing ovation from the [audience] at the end of the final act.
examples.cn: 话剧在最后一幕结束时获得了[观众]的起立鼓掌。

words.translation: n. 八月\na. 威严的, 令人敬畏的
words.definition: n. the month following July and preceding September\ns. of or befitting a lord\ns. profoundly honored

examples.sense: adj. 威严的；令人敬畏的
examples.en: The [august] presence of the elder statesman commanded immediate respect from all those assembled.
examples.cn: 这位资深政治家[威严的]气场立刻赢得了所有在场者的尊重。

examples.sense: adj. 威严的；令人敬畏的
examples.en: Standing before the [august] panel of judges, the young lawyer felt both nervous and determined.
examples.cn: 站在[令人敬畏的]评审团面前，这位年轻律师既紧张又坚定。

examples.sense: adj. 威严的；令人敬畏的
examples.en: The [august] institution has upheld academic freedom and scholarly excellence for three centuries.
examples.cn: 这所[声名显赫的]机构三个世纪以来一直维护学术自由和卓越学术。

examples.en: The summer internship programme runs from July through [August] at the research institute.
examples.cn: 暑期实习项目在研究所从七月持续到[八月]。

examples.en: Harvest festivals in rural areas typically take place in late [August] when crops are ready.
examples.cn: 农村地区的丰收节通常在庄稼成熟的[八月]下旬举行。

words.translation: n. 阿姨, 姨妈, 舅妈, 姑妈, 伯母
words.definition: n. the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle

examples.sense: n. 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母
examples.en: My [aunt] encouraged me to pursue a career in medicine after she saw my aptitude for biology.
examples.cn: 我的[姑母]看到我在生物学方面的天赋后，鼓励我从事医学事业。

examples.sense: n. 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母
examples.en: During the summer holidays, she stayed with her [aunt] in the countryside to help with the farm.
examples.cn: 暑假期间，她住在乡下[姨母]家，帮忙打理农场。

examples.sense: n. 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母
examples.en: Her [aunt] was a renowned botanist whose research on medicinal plants shaped her own career path.
examples.cn: 她的[姑母]是一位著名植物学家，其对药用植物的研究影响了她自己的职业道路。

examples.sense: n. 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母
examples.en: The inheritance left by his [aunt] enabled him to fund his first entrepreneurial venture.
examples.cn: 他[伯母]留下的遗产使他得以资助自己的第一次创业。

examples.sense: n. 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母
examples.en: His [aunt] taught him the value of persistence by sharing stories of her struggles as an immigrant.
examples.cn: 他的[姨母]通过分享自己作为移民的奋斗故事，教导他坚持的价值。

words.translation: n. 澳洲, 澳大利亚
words.definition: n. a nation occupying the whole of the Australian continent; Aboriginal tribes are thought to have migrated from southeastern Asia 20,000 years ago; first Europeans were British convicts sent there as a penal colony\nn. the smallest continent; between the South Pacific and the Indian Ocean

examples.en: [Australia] is home to some of the world's most unique wildlife, including kangaroos and koalas.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]是世界上一些最独特野生动物的家园，包括袋鼠和考拉。

examples.en: The Great Barrier Reef, located off the coast of [Australia], is the world's largest coral reef system.
examples.cn: 位于[澳大利亚]海岸外的大堡礁是世界上最大的珊瑚礁系统。

examples.en: Many international students choose to study in [Australia] for its high-quality universities and multicultural environment.
examples.cn: 许多国际学生选择在[澳大利亚]求学，因为那里拥有高质量的大学和多元文化环境。

examples.en: Indigenous communities in [Australia] have maintained rich oral traditions for over 60,000 years.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]的土著社区保持了超过6万年的丰富口头传统。

examples.en: The bushfires that swept through [Australia] in 2019 destroyed millions of hectares of forest and wildlife habitat.
examples.cn: 2019年席卷[澳大利亚]的丛林大火摧毁了数百万公顷的森林和野生动物栖息地。

words.translation: n. 澳大利亚人\na. 澳大利亚的, 澳洲的, 澳洲人的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Australia\nn. the Austronesian languages spoken by Australian aborigines\na. of or relating to or characteristic of Australia or its inhabitants or its languages

examples.sense: adj. 澳大利亚的；n. 澳大利亚人
examples.en: The [Australian] government introduced strict gun control laws following a tragic mass shooting in 1996.
examples.cn: 1996年一场悲惨的大规模枪击事件后，[澳大利亚]政府出台了严格的枪支管制法律。

examples.sense: adj. 澳大利亚的；n. 澳大利亚人
examples.en: Several [Australian] athletes broke world records at the international swimming championships last month.
examples.cn: 上个月，几名[澳大利亚]运动员在国际游泳锦标赛上打破了世界纪录。

examples.sense: adj. 澳大利亚的；n. 澳大利亚人
examples.en: The [Australian] accent and cultural idioms can take time for newcomers to fully understand.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]口音和文化习语可能需要一段时间才能让newcomers完全理解。

examples.sense: adj. 澳大利亚的；n. 澳大利亚人
examples.en: The [Australian] Open is one of the four Grand Slam tennis tournaments held each calendar year.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]网球公开赛是每年举办的四大网球大满贯赛事之一。

examples.sense: adj. 澳大利亚的；n. 澳大利亚人
examples.en: As an [Australian] living abroad, she often missed the vast open landscapes of her homeland.
examples.cn: 作为一名旅居海外的[澳大利亚人]，她常常思念故乡辽阔的开放景色。

words.translation: a. 可靠的, 可信的, 真正的\n[法] 被认证的, 确认的, 可信的
words.definition: s. conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief\ns. not counterfeit or copied

examples.sense: adj. 真实的；正宗的；可信的
examples.en: The museum confirmed that the painting was [authentic] after years of rigorous scientific testing.
examples.cn: 经过多年严格的科学检测，博物馆确认这幅画是[真实的]。

examples.sense: adj. 真实的；正宗的；可信的
examples.en: Travellers seeking [authentic] cultural experiences prefer to stay in local homestays rather than chain hotels.
examples.cn: 寻求[正宗]文化体验的旅行者更喜欢住在当地民宿而非连锁酒店。

examples.sense: adj. 真实的；正宗的；可信的
examples.en: Her [authentic] portrayal of the historical figure earned widespread critical acclaim.
examples.cn: 她对这位历史人物[真实的]刻画赢得了广泛的评论界赞誉。

examples.sense: adj. 真实的；正宗的；可信的
examples.en: Leaders who communicate in an [authentic] manner tend to inspire greater trust among their teams.
examples.cn: 以[真诚]方式沟通的领导者往往能在团队中激发更大的信任。

examples.sense: adj. 真实的；正宗的；可信的
examples.en: The chef insisted on using [authentic] Sichuan peppercorns to recreate the traditional flavour profile.
examples.cn: 厨师坚持使用[正宗]的四川花椒来重现传统的风味特征。

words.translation: n. 作家, 作家的著作, 创始人\n[法] 作者, 著作人, 本人
words.definition: v. be the author of

examples.en: The [author] drew on her own childhood experiences to craft the novel's most poignant scenes.
examples.cn: 这位[作者]汲取自己的童年经历，创作出小说中最感人的场景。

examples.en: As the [author] of over twenty scientific papers, he was regarded as an authority in his field.
examples.cn: 作为二十多篇科学论文的[作者]，他被认为是该领域的权威。

examples.en: She [authored] a groundbreaking report on climate migration that influenced international policy.
examples.cn: 她[撰写]了一份关于气候移民的开创性报告，影响了国际政策。

examples.en: The [author] spent seven years researching historical archives before publishing the biography.
examples.cn: 这位[作家]在出版传记之前，花了七年时间研究历史档案。

examples.en: Modern [authors] must often balance creative writing with the demands of social media promotion.
examples.cn: 现代[作家]通常必须在创意写作与社交媒体宣传的需求之间取得平衡。

words.translation: n. 权力, 当权者, 当局, 权威, 专家\n[经] 代理权, 授权, 权威
words.definition:
n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions
n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others
n. an expert whose views are taken as definitive
n. official permission or approval

examples.en: The regional [authority] issued new regulations limiting the use of single-use plastics in restaurants.
examples.cn: 地区[当局]发布了新规定，限制餐厅使用一次性塑料制品。

examples.en: His decades of fieldwork gave him undisputed [authority] on the subject of tropical biodiversity.
examples.cn: 他数十年的野外工作使他在热带生物多样性方面拥有无可争议的[权威]。

examples.en: Teachers must balance [authority] in the classroom with the need to foster student creativity.
examples.cn: 教师必须在课堂[权威]与培养学生创造力的需要之间取得平衡。

examples.en: The health [authority] launched a nationwide vaccination campaign to contain the outbreak.
examples.cn: 卫生[当局]启动了全国性疫苗接种运动，以遏制疫情。

examples.en: She spoke with such [authority] on economic policy that even seasoned experts were impressed.
examples.cn: 她谈论经济政策时如此[权威]，连经验丰富的专家都印象深刻。

words.translation: n. 自动手枪, 自动机械\na. 自动的, 机械的, 必然的, 无意识的
words.definition: a. operating with minimal human intervention; independent of external control\ns. resembling the unthinking functioning of a machine\ns. without volition or conscious control

examples.en: The factory replaced manual assembly lines with [automatic] robots to improve both speed and precision.
examples.cn: 工厂用[自动]机器人取代了手工装配线，以提高速度和精度。

examples.en: After years of practice, playing scales became an [automatic] response for the concert pianist.
examples.cn: 经过多年练习，演奏音阶对这位音乐会钢琴家来说已成为[无意识的]反应。

examples.en: The building is equipped with an [automatic] sprinkler system that activates when smoke is detected.
examples.cn: 该建筑配备了[自动]喷水灭火系统，一旦探测到烟雾便会启动。

examples.en: Breathing is an [automatic] function controlled by the brainstem without conscious effort.
examples.cn: 呼吸是由脑干控制的[无意识的]功能，无需有意识的努力。

examples.en: Software updates are downloaded through an [automatic] process that runs in the background overnight.
examples.cn: 软件更新通过夜间在后台运行的[自动]进程下载。

words.translation: a. 自治的\n[医] 自主的
words.definition: s. (of political bodies) not controlled by outside forces\ns. existing as an independent entity\ns. (of persons) free from external control and constraint in e.g. action and judgment

examples.en: The university operates as an [autonomous] institution free from direct government interference in academic affairs.
examples.cn: 该大学作为[自治]机构运作，学术事务不受政府直接干预。

examples.en: Developers are working to create [autonomous] vehicles capable of navigating complex urban environments safely.
examples.cn: 开发者正在努力创造能够安全驾驭复杂城市环境的[自主]车辆。

examples.en: The territory was granted [autonomous] status, allowing it to manage its own education and taxation systems.
examples.cn: 该领土被授予[自治]地位，使其能够管理自己的教育和税收体系。

examples.en: An [autonomous] learner takes responsibility for setting goals and evaluating their own progress.
examples.cn: [自主]学习者负责设定目标并评估自己的进步。

examples.en: The drone operates as an [autonomous] unit, making real-time decisions without human input.
examples.cn: 这架无人机作为[自主]单元运作，无需人工输入即可实时做出决策。

words.translation: n. 秋天, 成熟期
words.definition: n the season when the leaves fall from the trees

examples.en: The forests of New England are famous for their spectacular display of colours in [autumn].
examples.cn: 新英格兰的森林以其在[秋天]壮观的色彩展示而闻名。

examples.en: University freshers traditionally begin their studies in [autumn] when the academic year commences.
examples.cn: 大学新生传统上在学年开始的[秋季]开始学业。

examples.en: The harvest season in [autumn] brings farmers together for communal celebrations across rural China.
examples.cn: [秋天]的收获季节将农民聚集在一起，在中国农村举行集体庆祝活动。

examples.en: Migratory birds begin their long southward journey as the temperature drops in [autumn].
examples.cn: 随着[秋季]气温下降，候鸟开始了漫长的南飞之旅。

examples.en: He described the [autumn] of his life as a time of quiet reflection and hard-won wisdom.
examples.cn: 他将人生的[秋天]描述为一段安静反思和来之不易的智慧时光。

words.translation: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的\n[医] 有效的, 可得的
words.definition: a. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service\ns. not busy; not otherwise committed\ns. convenient for use or disposal

examples.en: The scholarship is [available] to all students who maintain a grade point average above 3.8.
examples.cn: 该奖学金对所有平均绩点在3.8以上的学生[开放]。

examples.en: Fresh produce is [available] at the local market every morning from six o'clock onwards.
examples.cn: 当地市场每天早上六点起就有新鲜农产品[供应]。

examples.en: The professor is [available] for consultation every Thursday afternoon in her office.
examples.cn: 教授每周四下午在办公室[有空]接受咨询。

examples.en: With modern technology, a wealth of educational resources is [available] to students at no cost.
examples.cn: 借助现代技术，学生可以免费[获取]丰富的教育资源。

examples.en: The treatment was not [available] in rural hospitals due to a shortage of specialised equipment.
examples.cn: 由于专业设备短缺，农村医院无法[获得]该治疗方法。

words.translation: n. 大街, 途径, 林荫路
words.definition: n. a line of approach\nn. a wide street or thoroughfare

examples.en: The tree-lined [avenue] leading to the palace was illuminated by hundreds of lanterns during the festival.
examples.cn: 通向宫殿的林荫[大道]在节日期间被数百盏灯笼照亮。

examples.en: Diplomatic negotiation remains the most productive [avenue] for resolving international disputes peacefully.
examples.cn: 外交谈判仍然是和平解决国际争端最有效的[途径]。

examples.en: The researchers explored every [avenue] of inquiry before concluding that the hypothesis was incorrect.
examples.cn: 研究人员在得出假设错误的结论之前，探索了每一个调查[途径]。

examples.en: Entrepreneurship provides an [avenue] for creative individuals to transform ideas into viable businesses.
examples.cn: 创业为有创造力的个人提供了将想法转化为可行企业的[途径]。

examples.en: The Fifth [Avenue] in New York is renowned for its luxury boutiques and iconic landmarks.
examples.cn: 纽约第五[大道]以其豪华精品店和标志性地标而闻名。

words.translation:
n. 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损
a. 平均的, 中等的, 平常的
vt. 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡
vi. 平均为, 呈中间色
words.definition:
n. a statistic describing the location of a distribution
n. (sports) the ratio of successful performances to opportunities
n. an intermediate scale value regarded as normal or usual
v. amount to or come to an average, without loss or gain

examples.en: The [average] temperature in coastal cities tends to be more moderate than in inland regions.
examples.cn: 沿海城市的[平均]气温往往比内陆地区更为温和。

examples.en: Her test scores were well above [average], placing her in the top five percent of the cohort.
examples.cn: 她的考试成绩远高于[平均水平]，位列同批学生前5%。

examples.en: On [average], students who read for pleasure score higher on comprehension assessments.
examples.cn: [平均而言]，喜欢课外阅读的学生在理解能力评估中得分更高。

examples.en: The company's monthly profits [averaged] two million yuan over the course of the fiscal year.
examples.cn: 该公司全年月均利润[平均]为200万元。

examples.en: An [average] citizen in a developed country consumes far more energy than one in a developing nation.
examples.cn: 发达国家的[普通]公民消耗的能源远多于发展中国家的公民。

words.translation: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消\n[法] 避免, 回避, 躲开
words.definition: v. stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something\nv. refrain from doing something

examples.en: Students should [avoid] plagiarism at all costs, as it carries serious academic and legal consequences.
examples.cn: 学生应不惜一切代价[避免]抄袭，因为这会带来严重的学术和法律后果。

examples.en: The government introduced regulations to help companies [avoid] environmentally damaging practices.
examples.cn: 政府出台了法规，帮助企业[避免]对环境有害的做法。

examples.en: Experienced cyclists learn to [avoid] potholes and wet drain covers to prevent accidents.
examples.cn: 有经验的骑行者学会[避开]坑洞和湿滑的排水盖，以防发生事故。

examples.en: To [avoid] misunderstanding, the contract terms were written in plain, unambiguous language.
examples.cn: 为了[避免]误解，合同条款以简单、明确的语言书写。

examples.en: She tried to [avoid] making eye contact during the confrontation to prevent the situation from escalating.
examples.cn: 她试图在对峙中[避免]眼神接触，以防局势升级。

words.translation: a. 醒着的\nvt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到\nvi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
words.definition: a. not in a state of sleep; completely conscious

examples.sense: adj. 醒着的；v. 唤醒；觉醒
examples.en: She lay [awake] for hours, replaying the conversation in her mind before finally drifting off to sleep.
examples.cn: 她[清醒地]躺了好几个小时，反复回忆那段对话，最终才入睡。

examples.sense: adj. 醒着的；v. 唤醒；觉醒
examples.en: The thunderstorm kept the entire household [awake] throughout the night with its deafening crashes.
examples.cn: 雷暴以其震耳欲聋的轰鸣声让整个家庭整夜[无法入睡]。

examples.sense: adj. 醒着的；v. 唤醒；觉醒
examples.en: His travels through impoverished regions [awoke] in him a deep commitment to social justice.
examples.cn: 他在贫困地区的旅行[唤醒]了他对社会正义的深切承诺。

examples.sense: adj. 醒着的；v. 唤醒；觉醒
examples.en: Students who remain [awake] and alert during lectures tend to absorb information more effectively.
examples.cn: 在课堂上保持[清醒]和专注的学生往往能更有效地吸收信息。

examples.sense: adj. 醒着的；v. 唤醒；觉醒
examples.en: The novel's final chapter [awoke] readers to the devastating consequences of unchecked industrialisation.
examples.cn: 小说的最后一章让读者[觉醒]，意识到不受约束的工业化带来的毁灭性后果。

words.translation: n. 奖品, 裁定, 判决\nvt. 授予, 给予
words.definition:
n. a grant made by a law court
n. a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction
v. give, especially as an honor or reward
v. give as judged due or on the basis of merit

examples.sense: n. 奖励；奖品；v. 授予
examples.en: The humanitarian [award] was presented to the doctor for her decades of service in conflict zones.
examples.cn: 这位医生因在冲突地区数十年的服务而被授予人道主义[奖项]。

examples.sense: n. 奖励；奖品；v. 授予
examples.en: The committee decided to [award] the research grant to the team proposing the most innovative solution.
examples.cn: 委员会决定将研究经费[授予]提出最具创新性解决方案的团队。

examples.sense: n. 奖励；奖品；v. 授予
examples.en: Winning a prestigious [award] early in one's career can open doors that might otherwise remain closed.
examples.cn: 在职业生涯早期获得一项声望颇高的[奖项]可以打开原本关闭的大门。

examples.sense: n. 奖励；奖品；v. 授予
examples.en: The court [awarded] substantial compensation to the victims of the environmental disaster.
examples.cn: 法院向环境灾难受害者[判给]了大量赔偿金。

examples.sense: n. 奖励；奖品；v. 授予
examples.en: The film swept the major [awards] at the festival, including Best Director and Best Screenplay.
examples.cn: 这部电影横扫电影节的主要[奖项]，包括最佳导演和最佳剧本。

words.translation: a. 知道的, 有觉悟的
words.definition: a. (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception

examples.en: Students must be [aware] of the ethical implications of artificial intelligence in modern society.
examples.cn: 学生必须[意识到]人工智能在现代社会中的伦理影响。

examples.en: She was not [aware] that her casual comment had caused offence until a colleague pointed it out.
examples.cn: 她没有[意识到]自己随口的评论已经造成冒犯，直到一位同事指出。

examples.en: Being [aware] of your own cognitive biases is the first step towards more objective decision-making.
examples.cn: [意识到]自身的认知偏见是迈向更客观决策的第一步。

examples.en: Environmentally [aware] consumers are increasingly choosing products with minimal packaging.
examples.cn: 有环保[意识]的消费者越来越多地选择包装最少的产品。

examples.en: The general was [aware] that any miscalculation could result in catastrophic consequences for both sides.
examples.cn: 将军[意识到]任何误判都可能给双方带来灾难性后果。

words.translation: adv. 离去
words.definition:
s. not present; having left
a. used of an opponent's ground
s. (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter
r. from a particular thing or place or position (`forth' is obsolete)

examples.sense: adv. 离开；远离；（距离/时间）之外
examples.en: The athlete trained six days a week, even when [away] from home competing in overseas tournaments.
examples.cn: 这位运动员每周训练六天，即使[离家]参加海外赛事也不例外。

examples.sense: adv. 离开；远离；（距离/时间）之外
examples.en: The village is only ten kilometres [away] from the city centre, yet it feels like a different world.
examples.cn: 这个村庄距市中心仅十公里[之外]，却感觉像是另一个世界。

examples.sense: adv. 离开；远离；（距离/时间）之外
examples.en: The final examination is just two weeks [away], so students are intensifying their revision schedules.
examples.cn: 期末考试仅剩两周[之遥]，学生们正在加强复习计划。

examples.sense: adv. 离开；远离；（距离/时间）之外
examples.en: She put [away] her phone and devoted her full attention to the conversation with her professor.
examples.cn: 她把手机[收起来]，将全部注意力投入到与教授的对话中。

examples.sense: adv. 离开；远离；（距离/时间）之外
examples.en: The volunteer spent three months [away] in a remote village, teaching children basic literacy skills.
examples.cn: 这名志愿者在一个偏远村庄[待了]三个月，教孩子们基本识字技能。

words.translation: a. 引起敬畏的, 可怕的
words.definition: s inspiring awe or admiration or wonder

examples.sense: adj. 令人敬畏的；极好的
examples.en: The [awesome] scale of the Grand Canyon left every visitor speechless upon first sight.
examples.cn: 大峡谷[令人叹为观止的]规模让每位游客第一眼见到时都无言以对。

examples.sense: adj. 令人敬畏的；极好的
examples.en: Witnessing a total solar eclipse is an [awesome] reminder of the forces governing our universe.
examples.cn: 目睹日全食是对支配宇宙力量的[令人敬畏的]提醒。

examples.sense: adj. 令人敬畏的；极好的
examples.en: The team's [awesome] performance in the final secured them the championship title by a wide margin.
examples.cn: 该队在决赛中[出色的]表现使他们以大比分赢得了冠军头衔。

examples.sense: adj. 令人敬畏的；极好的
examples.en: She described the northern lights as an [awesome] natural spectacle she would never forget.
examples.cn: 她将北极光描述为一场永生难忘的[壮观的]自然奇景。

examples.sense: adj. 令人敬畏的；极好的
examples.en: The [awesome] responsibility of leading a nation during a crisis weighs heavily on any statesperson.
examples.cn: 在危机期间领导一个国家的[重大]责任对任何政治家来说都是沉重的负担。

words.translation: a. 可怕的, 庄严的, 虔敬的
words.definition: s. causing fear or dread or terror

examples.en: The [awful] conditions in the refugee camp shocked the international aid workers who arrived on site.
examples.cn: 难民营[可怕的]状况震惊了抵达现场的国际援助人员。

examples.en: She felt [awful] about missing her friend's graduation after all the years of support they had shared.
examples.cn: 她对错过朋友的毕业典礼感到[非常愧疚]，尽管他们多年来相互支持。

examples.en: The film received [awful] reviews from critics, who called it predictable and poorly acted.
examples.cn: 这部电影获得了[糟糕的]评论，评论家称其情节可预测且表演拙劣。

examples.en: Historians describe the famine of that decade as one of the most [awful] humanitarian disasters in history.
examples.cn: 历史学家将那个十年的饥荒描述为历史上最[可怕的]人道主义灾难之一。

examples.en: The [awful] smell from the chemical spill forced residents to evacuate the surrounding neighbourhood.
examples.cn: 化学品泄漏产生的[可怕]气味迫使居民撤离周边社区。

words.translation: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的
words.definition:
s. causing inconvenience
a. lacking grace or skill in manner or movement or performance
s. difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
s. not elegant or graceful in expression

examples.sense: adj. 笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的
examples.en: The journalist's pointed question put the politician in an [awkward] position during the live interview.
examples.cn: 记者尖锐的问题在直播采访中让这位政客陷入[尴尬的]境地。

examples.sense: adj. 笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的
examples.en: His [awkward] attempt to apologise only made the misunderstanding worse between the two parties.
examples.cn: 他[笨拙的]道歉尝试只让双方之间的误解更加严重。

examples.sense: adj. 笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的
examples.en: Navigating cultural differences can feel [awkward] at first but becomes natural with experience.
examples.cn: 处理文化差异起初可能感觉[尴尬]，但随着经验积累会变得自然。

examples.sense: adj. 笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的
examples.en: The [awkward] silence after his speech suggested the audience had not understood his main argument.
examples.cn: 他演讲结束后[尴尬的]沉默表明听众没有理解他的主要论点。

examples.sense: adj. 笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的
examples.en: Fitting the large sofa through the [awkward] narrow doorway required three attempts and considerable patience.
examples.cn: 将大沙发搬过[棘手的]狭窄门口需要三次尝试和相当大的耐心。

words.translation: n. 婴孩\n[医] 婴儿
words.definition:
n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
n. the youngest member of a group (not necessarily young)
n. an unborn child; a human fetus
n. (slang) sometimes used as a term of address for attractive young women

examples.en: The hospital's neonatal unit provided round-the-clock care for premature [babies] and their anxious parents.
examples.cn: 医院新生儿科为早产[婴儿]及其焦虑的父母提供全天候护理。

examples.en: Language acquisition begins when a [baby] first starts to distinguish the sounds of its mother tongue.
examples.cn: 语言习得始于[婴儿]开始区分母语语音时。

examples.en: Researchers study how [babies] develop object permanence as a key milestone in cognitive development.
examples.cn: 研究人员研究[婴儿]如何发展客体永久性，视之为认知发展的关键里程碑。

examples.en: The wildlife sanctuary cared for a [baby] elephant that had been separated from its herd.
examples.cn: 野生动物保护区照料了一头与兽群失散的[幼小]大象。

examples.en: Parental leave policies directly affect [baby] development outcomes and long-term family wellbeing.
examples.cn: 育儿假政策直接影响[婴儿]发育结果和家庭长期福祉。

words.translation: n. 单身汉, 学士\n[法] 学士, 单身汉
words.definition: n. a man who has never been married\nv. lead a bachelor's existence

examples.en: He completed his [bachelor] degree in environmental science before pursuing a master's programme abroad.
examples.cn: 他完成环境科学[学士]学位后，前往海外攻读硕士课程。

examples.en: A [bachelor] of arts degree from a prestigious university remains highly valued by many employers.
examples.cn: 来自知名大学的文学[学士]学位仍受到许多雇主的高度重视。

examples.en: The [bachelor] lifestyle he had enjoyed for years came to an end when he met his future partner at a conference.
examples.cn: 他享受多年的[单身]生活在他于一次会议上遇见未来伴侣时画上了句号。

examples.en: Completing a [bachelor] degree online has become increasingly viable thanks to advances in e-learning platforms.
examples.cn: 由于电子学习平台的进步，在线完成[学士]学位变得越来越可行。

examples.en: Her [bachelor] thesis on urban poverty attracted attention from several non-governmental organisations.
examples.cn: 她关于城市贫困的[学士]论文引起了几个非政府组织的关注。

words.translation:
a. 后面的
vt. 使后退, 支持
vi. 倒退, 背靠
adv. 向后地
n. 背部, 后面
words.definition:
n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine
n. the part of something that is furthest from the normal viewer
n. (football) a person who plays in the backfield
n. the part of a garment that covers the back of your body

examples.sense: n. 背部；后面；adv. 向后；返回
examples.en: She rested her [back] against the wall and took a deep breath to calm her nerves before the speech.
examples.cn: 她靠着墙[背]深吸一口气，在演讲前平复心情。

examples.sense: n. 背部；后面；adv. 向后；返回
examples.en: After studying abroad for two years, she was eager to come [back] to her hometown.
examples.cn: 在国外学习两年后，她迫切希望[回]到家乡。

examples.en: Several major investors agreed to [back] the start-up after its founder presented a compelling pitch.
examples.cn: 几位主要投资者在创始人发表了令人信服的陈述后，同意[支持]这家初创企业。

examples.sense: n. 背部；后面；adv. 向后；返回
examples.en: The answer to the question was printed on the [back] of the examination booklet.
examples.cn: 问题的答案印在考试手册的[背面]。

examples.sense: n. 背部；后面；adv. 向后；返回
examples.en: He looked [back] on his university years as the most formative period of his intellectual life.
examples.cn: 他[回顾]自己的大学岁月，视之为智识生命中最具塑造力的时期。

words.translation: n. 背痛
words.definition: n. an ache localized in the back

examples.en: Prolonged hours of sitting at a desk without proper posture frequently lead to chronic [backache].
examples.cn: 长时间以不良姿势坐在桌前经常导致慢性[背痛]。

examples.en: The physiotherapist recommended targeted exercises to relieve the patient's persistent [backache].
examples.cn: 物理治疗师推荐了针对性练习，以缓解患者持续的[腰痛]。

examples.en: Her [backache] worsened after she lifted heavy boxes during the office relocation without assistance.
examples.cn: 在办公室搬迁中独自搬运重箱后，她的[背痛]加剧了。

examples.en: Ergonomic chairs are designed to reduce the risk of [backache] in people who work long hours.
examples.cn: 人体工学椅旨在降低长时间工作者患[背痛]的风险。

examples.en: Many construction workers suffer from occupational [backache] caused by repeated heavy lifting.
examples.cn: 许多建筑工人因反复搬运重物而患有职业性[背痛]。

words.translation: n. 背景, 背景资料\n[计] 背景, 后台
words.definition:
n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training
n. the part of a scene (or picture) that lies behind objects in the foreground
n. information that is essential to understanding a situation or problem
n. extraneous signals that can be confused with the phenomenon to be observed or measured

examples.en: The applicant's diverse cultural [background] made her an ideal candidate for the international relations post.
examples.cn: 申请人多元的文化[背景]使她成为国际关系职位的理想候选人。

examples.en: Understanding the historical [background] of a conflict is essential for finding a lasting resolution.
examples.cn: 了解冲突的历史[背景]对于找到持久解决方案至关重要。

examples.en: Music played softly in the [background] as guests mingled at the charity reception.
examples.cn: 宾客在慈善招待会上交流时，[背景]音乐轻柔地响起。

examples.en: Students from disadvantaged [backgrounds] often face additional barriers when applying to elite institutions.
examples.cn: 来自弱势[背景]的学生在申请精英院校时往往面临额外障碍。

examples.en: The painting's dark [background] contrasted sharply with the luminous central figure.
examples.cn: 这幅画深色的[背景]与明亮的中心人物形成了鲜明对比。

words.translation: adv. 向后地, 相反地\na. 向后的, 相反的\n[计] 倒推
words.definition:
a. directed or facing toward the back or rear
a. (used of temperament or behavior) marked by a retiring nature
s. retarded in intellectual development
s. having made less than normal progress

examples.en: The country's [backward] infrastructure hampered economic development and foreign investment for decades.
examples.cn: 该国[落后的]基础设施数十年来阻碍了经济发展和外资引进。

examples.en: He took a [backward] glance at the city skyline as the train carried him away from home.
examples.cn: 火车载着他离开家乡时，他[向后]望了一眼城市天际线。

examples.en: Refusing to adopt new technologies is widely regarded as [backward] thinking in competitive industries.
examples.cn: 拒绝采用新技术在竞争激烈的行业中被普遍视为[落后的]思维。

examples.en: The gymnast performed a flawless [backward] somersault that received a perfect score from all judges.
examples.cn: 体操运动员完成了一个完美的[后]空翻，获得了所有裁判的满分。

examples.en: He counted [backward] from ten to calm himself before delivering the keynote address.
examples.cn: 他从十[倒数]，在发表主题演讲前让自己平静下来。

words.translation: n. 熏猪肉\n[机] 腌肉
words.definition: n. back and sides of a hog salted and dried or smoked; usually sliced thin and fried\nn. English scientist and Franciscan monk who stressed the importance of experimentation; first showed that air is required for combustion and first used lenses to correct vision (1220-1292)\nn. English statesman and philosopher; precursor of British empiricism; advocated inductive reasoning (1561-1626)

examples.en: The aroma of sizzling [bacon] drifted through the kitchen early in the morning.
examples.cn: 清晨，嘶嘶作响的[培根]香味飘散在厨房里。

examples.en: A traditional English breakfast typically includes [bacon], eggs, toast, and baked beans.
examples.cn: 传统英式早餐通常包括[培根]、鸡蛋、吐司和烤豆。

examples.en: High consumption of processed meats like [bacon] has been linked to increased health risks in several studies.
examples.cn: 多项研究将大量食用[培根]等加工肉类与增加的健康风险联系起来。

examples.en: She wrapped the chicken in strips of [bacon] before roasting it to add moisture and flavour.
examples.cn: 她在烤鸡之前用[培根]条包裹鸡肉，以增加水分和风味。

examples.en: In many Western countries, [bacon] sandwiches are a popular quick breakfast option.
examples.cn: 在许多西方国家，[培根]三明治是一种受欢迎的快速早餐选择。

words.translation: n. 细菌\n[医] [无芽胞]杆菌属
words.definition: n (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants

examples.en: Each [bacterium] in the culture was examined under a high-powered electron microscope.
examples.cn: 培养物中的每种[细菌]都在高倍电子显微镜下进行了检查。

examples.en: The discovery that a particular [bacterium] caused the disease led to the development of targeted antibiotics.
examples.cn: 发现某种特定[细菌]导致该疾病，从而推动了靶向抗生素的研发。

examples.en: Not every [bacterium] is harmful; many species are essential for digestion and immune function.
examples.cn: 并非每种[细菌]都有害；许多菌种对消化和免疫功能至关重要。

examples.en: The resistant [bacterium] posed a serious threat to patients in the hospital's intensive care unit.
examples.cn: 耐药性[细菌]对医院重症监护室的患者构成了严重威胁。

examples.en: Scientists engineered a [bacterium] capable of breaking down plastic waste in contaminated water.
examples.cn: 科学家改造了一种能够分解受污染水中塑料废弃物的[细菌]。

words.translation: a. 坏的\nn. 坏\nadv. 坏地
words.definition:
n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency
a. having undesirable or negative qualities
s. very intense
s. feeling physical discomfort or pain (`tough' is occasionally used colloquially for `bad')

examples.sense: adj. 坏的；严重的；不好的
examples.en: Spreading unverified information online can have [bad] consequences for both individuals and society.
examples.cn: 在网上传播未经核实的信息可能对个人和社会产生[不良]后果。

examples.sense: adj. 坏的；严重的；不好的
examples.en: The flooding caused [bad] damage to the agricultural land, devastating the local farming community.
examples.cn: 洪水对农业用地造成了[严重的]破坏，使当地农业社区深受打击。

examples.sense: adj. 坏的；严重的；不好的
examples.en: She felt [bad] about cancelling the appointment at such short notice.
examples.cn: 她因临时取消预约而感到[愧疚]。

examples.sense: adj. 坏的；严重的；不好的
examples.en: Consistent [bad] habits, such as skipping breakfast, can negatively affect concentration and academic performance.
examples.cn: 持续的[不良]习惯，如不吃早饭，会对专注力和学业成绩产生负面影响。

examples.sense: adj. 坏的；严重的；不好的
examples.en: A [bad] first impression can take considerable effort and time to overcome in professional settings.
examples.cn: 在职业环境中，[不好的]第一印象可能需要相当大的努力和时间才能改变。

words.translation: adv. 严重地, 恶劣地, 极度地
words.definition:
r. to a severe or serious degree
r. evilly or wickedly
r. in a disobedient or naughty way
r. with great intensity (`bad' is a nonstandard variant for `badly')

examples.sense: adv. 严重地；糟糕地；非常
examples.en: The earthquake [badly] damaged the city's infrastructure, leaving thousands without water and electricity.
examples.cn: 地震[严重]破坏了城市基础设施，使数千人断水断电。

examples.sense: adv. 严重地；糟糕地；非常
examples.en: She performed [badly] in the mock exam but used the experience to identify her weak areas.
examples.cn: 她在模拟考试中表现[糟糕]，但利用这次经历找出了自己的薄弱环节。

examples.sense: adv. 严重地；糟糕地；非常
examples.en: The project was [badly] managed from the start, resulting in delays and budget overruns.
examples.cn: 该项目从一开始就[管理不善]，导致延误和预算超支。

examples.sense: adv. 严重地；糟糕地；非常
examples.en: He [badly] needed a break after working consecutive sixteen-hour days without rest.
examples.cn: 连续工作十六小时没有休息后，他[非常]需要休息一下。

examples.sense: adv. 严重地；糟糕地；非常
examples.en: The region was [badly] affected by drought, forcing many farmers to abandon their fields.
examples.cn: 该地区受干旱[严重]影响，迫使许多农民放弃农田。

words.translation: n. 羽毛球运动
words.definition: n. a game played on a court with light long-handled rackets used to volley a shuttlecock over a net

examples.en: China has dominated world [badminton] competitions for decades, producing numerous world champions.
examples.cn: 中国数十年来主导了世界[羽毛球]赛事，培养了众多世界冠军。

examples.en: Playing [badminton] regularly improves hand-eye coordination, agility, and cardiovascular fitness.
examples.cn: 定期打[羽毛球]能提高手眼协调能力、敏捷性和心血管健康。

examples.en: The school installed new [badminton] courts as part of its commitment to promoting physical activity.
examples.cn: 学校新建了[羽毛球]场地，作为其推广体育活动承诺的一部分。

examples.en: He took up [badminton] in secondary school and eventually represented his province at national level.
examples.cn: 他在中学开始打[羽毛球]，最终代表省份参加全国比赛。

examples.en: The fast-paced nature of [badminton] makes it both exciting to watch and physically demanding to play.
examples.cn: [羽毛球]节奏快的特点使其既精彩好看，打起来又对体力要求高。

words.translation: n. 袋子, 袋状物\nvt. 使膨大, 装袋, 猎获
words.definition:
n. a flexible container with a single opening
n. the quantity of game taken in a particular period (usually by one person)
n. a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women)
n. the quantity that a bag will hold

examples.en: She packed a [bag] with essentials and set off on the three-week hiking expedition at dawn.
examples.cn: 她打包了一个装有必需品的[包]，黎明时出发开始为期三周的徒步探险。

examples.en: The airport security officer asked her to place her [bag] on the conveyor belt for scanning.
examples.cn: 机场安检员要求她将[包]放在传送带上进行扫描。

examples.en: Reusable shopping [bags] have become more common as consumers try to reduce plastic waste.
examples.cn: 随着消费者努力减少塑料垃圾，可重复使用的购物[袋]变得越来越普遍。

examples.en: She had [bags] under her eyes after spending three consecutive nights preparing for the presentation.
examples.cn: 连续三夜准备演示文稿后，她的眼睛下方有了[眼袋]。

examples.en: The diplomat carried a leather [bag] containing classified documents to the confidential meeting.
examples.cn: 外交官携带一个装有机密文件的皮革[包]前往保密会议。

words.translation: n. 行李\n[经] 行李
words.definition: n. cases used to carry belongings when traveling\nn. a worthless or immoral woman\nn. the portable equipment and supplies of an army

examples.en: Airlines impose strict weight limits on checked [baggage] to ensure aircraft safety and fuel efficiency.
examples.cn: 航空公司对托运[行李]实施严格的重量限制，以确保飞机安全和燃油效率。

examples.en: Travellers are advised to label all [baggage] clearly to prevent confusion at the carousel.
examples.cn: 建议旅客清晰标注所有[行李]，以防在行李传送带处造成混淆。

examples.en: Emotional [baggage] from past relationships can make it difficult to form new healthy connections.
examples.cn: 过去感情关系带来的情感[包袱]会使建立新的健康关系变得困难。

examples.en: The merger was complicated by the financial [baggage] the acquired company carried from previous ventures.
examples.cn: 这次并购因被收购公司从以往业务带来的财务[包袱]而变得复杂。

examples.en: Excess [baggage] fees at international airports have prompted travellers to pack more efficiently.
examples.cn: 国际机场的超重[行李]费促使旅客更高效地打包。

words.translation: vt. 烘焙, 烤\nvi. 烤面包\nn. 烘焙, 烤
words.definition: v. cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven\nv. prepare with dry heat in an oven\nv. be very hot, due to hot weather or exposure to the sun

examples.en: She learned to [bake] sourdough bread during the pandemic, turning a hobby into a small business.
examples.cn: 她在疫情期间学会了[烤]酸面包，将爱好转化为小生意。

examples.en: The science of [baking] involves precise chemical reactions that transform raw ingredients into finished goods.
examples.cn: [烘焙]科学涉及精确的化学反应，将原材料转化为成品。

examples.en: Students [baked] traditional pastries as part of a cultural exchange programme with a French school.
examples.cn: 学生们[烤制]了传统糕点，作为与法国学校文化交流项目的一部分。

examples.en: Clay tablets were [baked] in kilns to preserve the cuneiform writing inscribed on their surfaces.
examples.cn: 泥板在窑中[烧制]以保存刻在其表面的楔形文字。

examples.en: The arid climate [bakes] the soil so hard in summer that crops struggle to take root.
examples.cn: 干旱气候在夏天将土壤[烤得]坚硬，庄稼难以生根。

words.translation: n. 面包店
words.definition: n. a workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold

examples.en: The family-owned [bakery] had served the neighbourhood for three generations with fresh bread every morning.
examples.cn: 这家家族经营的[面包店]三代以来每天早晨为社区提供新鲜面包。

examples.en: She completed an apprenticeship at a renowned French [bakery] before opening her own patisserie.
examples.cn: 她在一家著名的法国[面包店]完成学徒期后，开设了自己的糕点店。

examples.en: The smell of fresh croissants from the corner [bakery] drew a queue of customers every weekend morning.
examples.cn: 街角[面包店]新鲜可颂的香气每个周末早晨都吸引了一排顾客。

examples.en: Artisan [bakeries] have experienced a revival as consumers seek high-quality, traditionally made products.
examples.cn: 随着消费者寻求高质量、传统制作的产品，手工[面包店]经历了复兴。

examples.en: The university campus [bakery] offered subsidised meals to support students on tight budgets.
examples.cn: 大学校园[面包店]提供补贴餐食，支持预算紧张的学生。

words.translation: n. 平衡, 差额\nvi. 平衡, 相等\nvt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消
words.definition:
n. a state of equilibrium
n. equality between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account
n. equality of distribution
n. the difference between the totals of the credit and debit sides of an account

examples.sense: n. 平衡；结余；v. 平衡
examples.en: Maintaining a healthy [balance] between study and leisure is vital for long-term academic performance.
examples.cn: 保持学习与休闲之间的健康[平衡]对长期学业表现至关重要。

examples.sense: n. 平衡；结余；v. 平衡
examples.en: The auditors checked the [balance] sheet carefully for any discrepancies in the financial records.
examples.cn: 审计员仔细检查[资产负债表]，寻找财务记录中的任何差异。

examples.sense: n. 平衡；结余；v. 平衡
examples.en: She struggled to [balance] the demands of her career with her responsibilities as a parent.
examples.cn: 她努力在职业需求与为人父母的责任之间寻求[平衡]。

examples.sense: n. 平衡；结余；v. 平衡
examples.en: The tightrope walker demonstrated extraordinary [balance] as he crossed the gorge without a safety net.
examples.cn: 走钢丝者在没有安全网的情况下跨越峡谷，展示了非凡的[平衡]能力。

examples.sense: n. 平衡；结余；v. 平衡
examples.en: Ecological [balance] in rainforests depends on the complex interdependence of thousands of species.
examples.cn: 热带雨林的生态[平衡]依赖于数千个物种之间复杂的相互依存关系。

words.translation: n. 阳台, 戏院楼厅
words.definition: n. an upper floor projecting from the rear over the main floor in an auditorium\nn. a platform projecting from the wall of a building and surrounded by a balustrade or railing or parapet

examples.en: She stood on the [balcony] watching the sunrise paint the mountains in shades of gold and rose.
examples.cn: 她站在[阳台]上，望着日出将山峦染成金色和玫瑰色。

examples.en: The apartment's spacious [balcony] overlooked a park filled with cherry blossom trees in spring.
examples.cn: 这套公寓宽敞的[阳台]俯瞰着春天开满樱花的公园。

examples.en: The prime minister addressed the crowd from the [balcony] of the government building.
examples.cn: 首相从政府大楼的[阳台]向人群发表讲话。

examples.en: In the opera house, seats in the upper [balcony] offered a panoramic view of the entire stage.
examples.cn: 在歌剧院，上层[包厢]的座位可以全景欣赏整个舞台。

examples.en: Growing herbs on the [balcony] has become a popular hobby for urban residents with limited outdoor space.
examples.cn: 在[阳台]种植香草已成为户外空间有限的城市居民的流行爱好。

words.translation: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物\nv. 捏成球形
words.definition:
n. round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games
n. an object with a spherical shape
n. the people assembled at a lavish formal dance
n. a spherical object used as a plaything

examples.en: The goalkeeper dived to his left and deflected the [ball] away from the net at the last moment.
examples.cn: 守门员向左扑倒，在最后一刻将[球]从球门边偏转出去。

examples.en: The charity [ball] raised over a million yuan for children's educational programmes in rural areas.
examples.cn: 慈善[舞会]为农村地区儿童教育项目筹集了超过百万元。

examples.en: He rolled a [ball] of clay into a perfect sphere to demonstrate the technique to his students.
examples.cn: 他将一团泥土揉成一个完美的球体，向学生展示这项技术。

examples.en: The annual [ball] at the embassy brought together diplomats and cultural figures from forty countries.
examples.cn: 大使馆年度[舞会]将来自四十个国家的外交官和文化人士聚集在一起。

examples.en: Cricket requires the bowler to deliver the [ball] with precision, spin, and strategic variation.
examples.cn: 板球要求投球手以精准、旋转和策略变化投出[球]。

words.translation: n. 芭蕾舞
words.definition: n. a theatrical representation of a story that is performed to music by trained dancers\nn. music written for a ballet

examples.en: She trained for twelve years before earning a place in the national [ballet] company.
examples.cn: 她训练了十二年才在国家[芭蕾舞]团获得一席之地。

examples.en: The [ballet] company's production of Swan Lake was praised for its technical brilliance and emotional depth.
examples.cn: [芭蕾舞]团的《天鹅湖》演出因其技术精湛和情感深度而获得赞誉。

examples.en: Classical [ballet] demands years of rigorous physical training, discipline, and artistic sensitivity.
examples.cn: 古典[芭蕾舞]需要多年严格的体能训练、纪律和艺术敏感性。

examples.en: Modern [ballet] companies often incorporate contemporary dance elements to appeal to younger audiences.
examples.cn: 现代[芭蕾舞]团经常融入当代舞蹈元素，以吸引年轻观众。

examples.en: The choreographer blended traditional [ballet] techniques with folk dance to create a uniquely Chinese production.
examples.cn: 编舞者将传统[芭蕾舞]技巧与民间舞蹈融合，创造了一部独具中国特色的作品。

words.translation: n. 气球\nvt. 使成气球状\nvi. 膨胀如气球, 激增
words.definition:
n. large tough nonrigid bag filled with gas or heated air
n. small thin inflatable rubber bag with narrow neck
v. ride in a hot-air balloon
v. become inflated

examples.en: Scientists released a weather [balloon] carrying instruments to measure atmospheric temperature and pressure.
examples.cn: 科学家放飞了一个携带仪器的气象[气球]，用于测量大气温度和气压。

examples.en: The children cheered as the colourful [balloons] were released into the sky at the end of the ceremony.
examples.cn: 仪式结束时，五彩[气球]被放飞升空，孩子们欢呼雀跃。

examples.en: A hot-air [balloon] flight over the valley at dawn offered breathtaking views of the landscape below.
examples.cn: 黎明时分乘坐热气[气球]飞越山谷，俯瞰下方的风景令人叹为观止。

examples.en: The government's debt has [ballooned] to an unsustainable level over the past five years.
examples.cn: 过去五年，政府债务已[膨胀]至不可持续的水平。

examples.en: Medical researchers use [balloon] catheters to widen blocked arteries in a minimally invasive procedure.
examples.cn: 医学研究人员使用[气囊]导管在微创手术中扩张阻塞的动脉。

words.translation: n. 圆珠笔
words.definition: n. a pen that has a small metal ball as the point of transfer of ink to paper

examples.en: She signed the contract with a silver [ballpoint] pen that had been a gift from her mentor.
examples.cn: 她用导师赠送的银色[圆珠笔]签署了合同。

examples.en: The invention of the [ballpoint] pen in the 1940s revolutionised everyday writing by replacing the fountain pen.
examples.cn: 20世纪40年代[圆珠笔]的发明通过取代钢笔彻底改变了日常书写方式。

examples.en: Students are required to complete the examination paper in blue or black [ballpoint] ink only.
examples.cn: 学生必须仅使用蓝色或黑色[圆珠笔]墨水完成试卷。

examples.en: The artist created remarkably detailed portraits using nothing but a standard [ballpoint] pen.
examples.cn: 这位艺术家仅用一支普通[圆珠笔]创作了非常精细的肖像画。

examples.en: A reliable [ballpoint] pen is an essential tool in any student's pencil case throughout the school year.
examples.cn: 一支可靠的[圆珠笔]是学生在整个学年中铅笔盒里必不可少的工具。

words.translation: n. 竹子\n[医] 竹类
words.definition: n. the hard woody stems of bamboo plants; used in construction and crafts and fishing poles\nn. woody tropical grass having hollow woody stems; mature canes used for construction and furniture

examples.en: Giant pandas depend almost entirely on [bamboo] as their primary source of nutrition and energy.
examples.cn: 大熊猫几乎完全依赖[竹子]作为其主要营养和能量来源。

examples.en: Architects are increasingly using [bamboo] as a sustainable building material due to its strength and flexibility.
examples.cn: 由于[竹子]强度高、韧性好，建筑师越来越多地将其作为可持续建筑材料使用。

examples.en: The craftsman wove a basket from strips of dried [bamboo] using techniques passed down through generations.
examples.cn: 这位工匠使用代代相传的技艺，用干燥的[竹]条编织了一个篮子。

examples.en: Dense [bamboo] forests provide habitat and shelter for numerous species across tropical Asia.
examples.cn: 茂密的[竹]林为热带亚洲众多物种提供了栖息地和庇护所。

examples.en: The traditional ink brush is often paired with [bamboo] paper for Chinese calligraphy practice.
examples.cn: 传统毛笔经常与[竹纸]搭配，用于中国书法练习。

words.translation: n. 禁令\nvt. 禁止, 取缔
words.definition:
n. 100 bani equal 1 leu in Moldova
n. 100 bani equal 1 leu in Romania
n. an official prohibition or edict against something
v. forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper)

examples.en: The city council voted to [ban] the use of fireworks within residential areas for safety reasons.
examples.cn: 市议会投票[禁止]在住宅区内出于安全原因燃放烟花。

examples.en: A lifetime [ban] from competing was imposed on the athlete after a doping violation was confirmed.
examples.cn: 一名运动员在确认违规使用禁药后，被处以终身[禁赛]。

examples.en: The international community called for a [ban] on the development and use of autonomous weapons.
examples.cn: 国际社会呼吁[禁止]开发和使用自主武器。

examples.en: The school [banned] mobile phones in classrooms to reduce distraction during lessons.
examples.cn: 学校[禁止]在课堂上使用手机，以减少上课时的分心。

examples.en: Environmental advocates pushed for a [ban] on single-use plastics across the entire retail sector.
examples.cn: 环保倡导者推动在整个零售业实施一次性塑料[禁令]。

words.translation: n. 香蕉
words.definition: n. any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits\nn. elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh

examples.en: Nutritionists recommend eating a [banana] before exercise as a quick source of natural energy.
examples.cn: 营养学家建议在运动前吃一根[香蕉]，作为快速的天然能量来源。

examples.en: The tropical regions of Central America produce a large proportion of the world's [banana] supply.
examples.cn: 中美洲热带地区生产了世界上大部分[香蕉]供应。

examples.en: Scientists have warned that the most common [banana] variety faces an existential threat from fungal disease.
examples.cn: 科学家警告称，最常见的[香蕉]品种面临真菌病的生存威胁。

examples.en: She mashed a ripe [banana] into the batter to add natural sweetness to the muffins.
examples.cn: 她将一根熟[香蕉]捣碎加入面糊中，为松饼增添天然甜味。

examples.en: In many developing countries, [banana] cultivation is a cornerstone of the agricultural economy.
examples.cn: 在许多发展中国家，[香蕉]种植是农业经济的基石。

words.translation: n. 带子, 队, 乐队\nv. 联合, 结合\n[计] 频带; 波段; 区
words.definition:
n. instrumentalists not including string players
n. a stripe or stripes of contrasting color
n. an adornment consisting of a strip of a contrasting color or material
n. a range of frequencies between two limits

examples.en: The rock [band] released their debut album after years of performing in small local venues.
examples.cn: 这支摇滚[乐队]在多年于小型本地场馆演出后，发布了首张专辑。

examples.en: She wore a thin silver [band] around her wrist inscribed with her university's motto.
examples.cn: 她手腕上戴着一条细银[环]，上面刻着她大学的格言。

examples.en: A [band] of volunteers coordinated the evacuation of residents from the flood-affected area.
examples.cn: 一[群]志愿者协调了洪水受灾地区居民的疏散工作。

examples.en: Radio signals are transmitted across specific frequency [bands] to prevent interference between broadcasts.
examples.cn: 无线电信号在特定频[段]上传输，以防止广播之间的干扰。

examples.en: The marching [band] performed at the national stadium during the opening ceremony of the sports festival.
examples.cn: 在体育节开幕式上，进行曲[乐队]在国家体育场演出。

words.translation: n. 绷带\n[化] 帘布筒; 实心轮胎; 紧带; 绷带
words.definition: n. a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body\nv. dress by covering or binding

examples.sense: n. 绷带；v. 用绷带包扎
examples.en: The nurse carefully applied a sterile [bandage] to the wound to prevent infection.
examples.cn: 护士仔细地在伤口上敷上无菌[绷带]，以防止感染。

examples.sense: n. 绷带；v. 用绷带包扎
examples.en: He [bandaged] his sprained ankle before rejoining his teammates on the training pitch.
examples.cn: 他在重新加入训练场的队友之前，用[绷带]包扎了扭伤的脚踝。

examples.sense: n. 绷带；v. 用绷带包扎
examples.en: First aid training teaches participants how to apply a pressure [bandage] to control severe bleeding.
examples.cn: 急救培训教导参与者如何施加压力[绷带]以控制严重出血。

examples.sense: n. 绷带；v. 用绷带包扎
examples.en: The soldier's wounds were [bandaged] in the field before he was evacuated to the military hospital.
examples.cn: 士兵在被送往军事医院前，伤口在战场上被[包扎]好。

examples.sense: n. 绷带；v. 用绷带包扎
examples.en: She kept an elastic [bandage] in her sports kit to support her knee during long-distance running.
examples.cn: 她在运动包里备了一条弹力[绷带]，用于在长跑时支撑膝盖。

words.translation:
n. 重击, 突然巨响, 刘海
v. 发巨响, 重击
adv. 砰然地, 突然巨响地, 直接地
[计] 撞击符
words.definition:
n. a sudden very loud noise
n. a border of hair that is cut short and hangs across the forehead
n. the swift release of a store of affective force
v. to produce a sharp often metallic explosive or percussive sound

examples.sense: n. 砰的一声；v. 砰地关；猛击
examples.en: The door slammed with a loud [bang] that echoed through the empty corridor.
examples.cn: 门砰地一声关上，[砰]的声响在空荡荡的走廊里回荡。

examples.sense: n. 砰的一声；v. 砰地关；猛击
examples.en: The experiment began with a [bang] when the chemical reaction produced an unexpected flash of light.
examples.cn: 当化学反应产生意外的闪光时，实验以一声[爆响]开始。

examples.sense: n. 砰的一声；v. 砰地关；猛击
examples.en: She [banged] her fist on the table in frustration when she discovered the error in her calculations.
examples.cn: 当她发现计算中的错误时，沮丧地用拳头[砸]桌子。

examples.sense: n. 砰的一声；v. 砰地关；猛击
examples.en: The starting pistol [banged] and the sprinters surged from their blocks in unison.
examples.cn: 起跑枪[砰]地一响，短跑运动员们齐刷刷地从起跑器上冲了出去。

examples.sense: n. 砰的一声；v. 砰地关；猛击
examples.en: Fireworks lit up the sky with a series of [bangs] during the national day celebrations.
examples.cn: 国庆庆典期间，烟花以一连串的[砰砰]声点亮了夜空。

words.translation: n. 银行, 堤, 岸\n[医] 库
words.definition:
n. sloping land (especially the slope beside a body of water)
n. a long ridge or pile
n. an arrangement of similar objects in a row or in tiers
n. a supply or stock held in reserve for future use (especially in emergencies)

examples.sense: n. 银行；堤岸；v. 存款；倾斜转弯
examples.en: The central [bank] raised interest rates to curb rising inflation across the national economy.
examples.cn: 中央[银行]提高利率以遏制全国经济中不断上涨的通货膨胀。

examples.sense: n. 银行；堤岸；v. 存款；倾斜转弯
examples.en: Children played along the grassy [bank] of the river, skimming stones across the calm water.
examples.cn: 孩子们在河岸草地[堤岸]上玩耍，向平静的水面打水漂。

examples.sense: n. 银行；堤岸；v. 存款；倾斜转弯
examples.en: She [banked] her savings in a high-interest account to maximise the return on her investment.
examples.cn: 她将储蓄[存入]高利息账户，以最大化投资回报。

examples.sense: n. 银行；堤岸；v. 存款；倾斜转弯
examples.en: A [bank] of monitors displayed live data feeds from sensors positioned across the research station.
examples.cn: 一[排]显示器展示来自研究站各处传感器的实时数据。

examples.sense: n. 银行；堤岸；v. 存款；倾斜转弯
examples.en: The aircraft [banked] sharply to the right to avoid turbulence detected by its weather sensors.
examples.cn: 飞机急剧向右[倾斜转弯]，以避开气象传感器探测到的湍流。

words.translation: n. 条, 棒, 酒吧, 栅, 障碍物\nvt. 禁止, 阻挡, 妨碍\n[计] 棒形图
words.definition:
n. a counter where you can obtain food or drink
n. a rigid piece of metal or wood; usually used as a fastening or obstruction or weapon
n. an obstruction (usually metal) placed at the top of a goal
n. (meteorology) a unit of pressure equal to a million dynes per square centimeter

examples.sense: n. 酒吧；棒；条；障碍；v. 阻止
examples.en: The iron [bar] was bent out of shape by the force of the collision during the accident.
examples.cn: 铁[棒]在事故碰撞的冲击下变形弯曲。

examples.sense: n. 酒吧；棒；条；障碍；v. 阻止
examples.en: She passed the [bar] exam on her first attempt and immediately joined a prestigious law firm.
examples.cn: 她第一次就通过了[律师资格]考试，并立即加入了一家知名律师事务所。

examples.sense: n. 酒吧；棒；条；障碍；v. 阻止
examples.en: Language differences can be a significant [bar] to effective communication in international negotiations.
examples.cn: 语言差异可能是国际谈判中有效沟通的重大[障碍]。

examples.sense: n. 酒吧；棒；条；障碍；v. 阻止
examples.en: He was [barred] from entering the country following a previous violation of immigration laws.
examples.cn: 他因此前违反移民法而被[禁止]入境。

examples.sense: n. 酒吧；棒；条；障碍；v. 阻止
examples.en: The city council voted to [bar] construction in the protected wetland area surrounding the lake.
examples.cn: 市议会投票[禁止]在湖泊周围的受保护湿地区域进行建设。

words.translation: n. 烤肉\nvt. 烤肉, 烧烤
words.definition: n. meat that has been barbecued or grilled in a highly seasoned sauce\nn. a cookout in which food is cooked over an open fire; especially a whole animal carcass roasted on a spit\nn. a rack to hold meat for cooking over hot charcoal usually out of doors

examples.en: The community organised a [barbecue] in the park to raise funds for the local primary school.
examples.cn: 社区在公园组织了一次[烧烤]活动，为当地小学筹集资金。

examples.en: They [barbecued] fresh fish by the lakeside during their summer camping trip.
examples.cn: 他们在夏季露营旅行中在湖边[烧烤]了新鲜的鱼。

examples.en: The [barbecue] sauce had been simmering for hours, developing a rich and smoky depth of flavour.
examples.cn: [烧烤]酱汁已经慢炖了几个小时，形成了浓郁而烟熏的深厚风味。

examples.en: Street-side [barbecue] vendors are a staple of Chinese night markets, especially in summer.
examples.cn: 路边[烧烤]摊是中国夜市的标配，尤其在夏天。

examples.en: She marinated the lamb overnight before [barbecuing] it slowly over charcoal for the garden party.
examples.cn: 她将羊肉腌制一夜，然后在花园派对前用炭火慢慢[烧烤]。

words.translation: n. 理发师
words.definition: n. United States composer (1910-1981)\nn. a hairdresser who cuts hair and shaves beards as a trade\nv. perform the services of a barber: cut the hair and/or beard of

examples.en: The neighbourhood [barber] had been cutting hair for the same families for over thirty years.
examples.cn: 这位街坊[理发师]为同样的几个家庭理发已超过三十年。

examples.en: He visited the [barber] every three weeks to maintain his preferred short professional style.
examples.cn: 他每三周去一次[理发师]那里，保持自己偏爱的短发职业形象。

examples.en: The [barber] shop served as a social hub where men gathered to discuss local news and politics.
examples.cn: [理发师]店是男士聚集讨论本地新闻和政治的社交中心。

examples.en: Traditional [barbers] use a straight razor to achieve a close, precise shave for their clients.
examples.cn: 传统[理发师]使用直剃刀为客户进行贴面精准剃须。

examples.en: The mobile [barber] visited care homes weekly to provide grooming services to elderly residents.
examples.cn: 上门[理发师]每周拜访养老院，为老年居民提供美发服务。

words.translation: n. 理发店
words.definition: n. a shop where men can get their hair cut

examples.en: The old [barbershop] on the corner was decorated with vintage posters and a classic striped pole.
examples.cn: 街角那家老[理发店]装饰着复古海报和经典的条纹柱子。

examples.en: He waited at the [barbershop] for over an hour on a busy Saturday morning before his turn came.
examples.cn: 繁忙的周六早晨，他在[理发店]等了一个多小时才轮到他。

examples.en: The [barbershop] quartet sang traditional harmonies that filled the community hall with warmth.
examples.cn: 这个[理发店]四重唱组合演唱了传统和声，让社区大厅充满了温馨。

examples.en: A modern [barbershop] often offers not just haircuts but also beard grooming and skincare services.
examples.cn: 现代[理发店]不仅提供理发，还提供胡须修剪和护肤服务。

examples.en: The [barbershop] became a gathering place for the local community to exchange stories and support one another.
examples.cn: 这家[理发店]成为当地社区交流故事、相互支持的聚集地。

words.translation: a. 赤裸的, 缺少的, 无遮蔽的, 坦率的\nvt. 使赤裸, 露出
words.definition:
v. lay bare
s. completely unclothed
s. lacking in amplitude or quantity
a. lacking its natural or customary covering

examples.sense: adj. 裸露的；空的；仅仅的；v. 露出
examples.en: The artist sketched the [bare] branches of the winter trees against the pale sky.
examples.cn: 艺术家在淡白的天空映衬下素描了冬日树木[光秃秃的]枝干。

examples.sense: adj. 裸露的；空的；仅仅的；v. 露出
examples.en: They survived on the [bare] minimum of food and water during the three weeks stranded in the mountains.
examples.cn: 被困山中三周期间，他们靠[最低限度的]食物和水维持生存。

examples.sense: adj. 裸露的；空的；仅仅的；v. 露出
examples.en: The walls of the abandoned factory were [bare], stripped of all fixtures and fittings.
examples.cn: 废弃工厂的墙壁[空荡荡的]，所有装置和配件都被剥除了。

examples.sense: adj. 裸露的；空的；仅仅的；v. 露出
examples.en: She [bared] her frustration when questioned about the policy contradictions by the journalist.
examples.cn: 当记者就政策矛盾提问时，她[袒露]了自己的不满。

examples.sense: adj. 裸露的；空的；仅仅的；v. 露出
examples.en: Walking [barefoot] on the warm sand is one of the simple pleasures of a beach holiday.
examples.cn: 赤[脚]走在温暖的沙滩上是海滨假期简单的乐趣之一。

words.translation: n. 交易, 买卖协定, 特价商品\nv. 讲价, 交易
words.definition: n. an agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each\nn. an advantageous purchase\nv. come to terms; arrive at an agreement

examples.sense: n. 便宜货；交易；v. 讨价还价
examples.en: She found a genuine [bargain] at the second-hand bookshop — a rare first edition for just fifty yuan.
examples.cn: 她在二手书店发现了一件真正的[便宜货]——一本罕见的初版书只需五十元。

examples.sense: n. 便宜货；交易；v. 讨价还价
examples.en: Both parties [bargained] for weeks before finally reaching a mutually satisfactory trade agreement.
examples.cn: 双方[谈判]了数周，最终才达成双方满意的贸易协议。

examples.sense: n. 便宜货；交易；v. 讨价还价
examples.en: The peace [bargain] required significant concessions from both sides to be considered legitimate.
examples.cn: 这项和平[协议]要求双方做出重大让步才能被视为合法。

examples.sense: n. 便宜货；交易；v. 讨价还价
