examples.en: Consumers should always compare prices to ensure they are getting a genuine [bargain].
examples.cn: 消费者应始终比较价格，以确保他们获得的是真正的[实惠]。

examples.sense: n. 便宜货；交易；v. 讨价还价
examples.en: The union [bargained] collectively with the management to improve wages and working conditions.
examples.cn: 工会与管理层进行了集体[谈判]，以改善工资和工作条件。

words.translation: n. 树皮, 吠声\nvi. 吠, 叫骂\nvt. 喊出, 剥树皮
words.definition:
n. tough protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees and other woody plants
n. a noise resembling the bark of a dog
n. a sailing ship with 3 (or more) masts
n. the sound made by a dog

examples.sense: n. 树皮；狗叫声；v. 叫；咆哮
examples.en: The rough [bark] of the ancient oak tree was covered in layers of moss and lichen.
examples.cn: 古老橡树粗糙的[树皮]上覆盖着层层苔藓和地衣。

examples.sense: n. 树皮；狗叫声；v. 叫；咆哮
examples.en: The dog's sharp [bark] alerted the family to the stranger approaching the front gate.
examples.cn: 狗的尖锐[吠叫声]提醒家人有陌生人正在靠近前门。

examples.sense: n. 树皮；狗叫声；v. 叫；咆哮
examples.en: The sergeant [barked] orders at the recruits during the early morning drill session.
examples.cn: 中士在清晨训练中向新兵[大声呵斥]命令。

examples.sense: n. 树皮；狗叫声；v. 叫；咆哮
examples.en: Herbal remedies derived from tree [bark] have been used in traditional medicine for centuries.
examples.cn: 从树[皮]中提取的草药已在传统医学中使用了数百年。

examples.sense: n. 树皮；狗叫声；v. 叫；咆哮
examples.en: She [barked] a warning to her colleague when she noticed the equipment malfunction.
examples.cn: 当她注意到设备故障时，大声[喊出]警告提醒同事。

words.translation: n. 障碍, 栅栏\n[化] 势垒; 阻片; 阻挡层
words.definition: n. a structure or object that impedes free movement\nn. any condition that makes it difficult to make progress or to achieve an objective\nn. anything serving to maintain separation by obstructing vision or access

examples.en: Language remains one of the greatest [barriers] to international communication and cooperation.
examples.cn: 语言仍然是国际交流与合作的最大[障碍]之一。

examples.en: The coastal [barrier] was reinforced with concrete to protect the town from storm surges.
examples.cn: 沿海[屏障]用混凝土加固，以保护小镇免受风暴潮侵袭。

examples.en: Trade [barriers] between the two countries were gradually reduced through a series of bilateral negotiations.
examples.cn: 两国之间的贸易[壁垒]通过一系列双边谈判逐步降低。

examples.en: Economic inequality acts as a [barrier] that prevents many talented individuals from accessing higher education.
examples.cn: 经济不平等是阻止许多有才华的个人接受高等教育的[障碍]。

examples.en: Police erected steel [barriers] along the parade route to manage the crowds safely.
examples.cn: 警察沿游行路线竖立了钢制[护栏]，以安全地管理人群。

words.translation:
n. 底部, 垒, 基础, 基地
vt. 以...作基础
a. 卑鄙的, 低劣的
[计] 基准
words.definition:
n. installation from which a military force initiates operations
n. a place that the runner must touch before scoring
n. the bottom or lowest part
n. (anatomy) the part of an organ nearest its point of attachment

examples.sense: n. 基础；基地；底部；v. 以…为基础
examples.en: The theory lacks a solid empirical [base] and has been widely criticised in academic journals.
examples.cn: 该理论缺乏坚实的实证[基础]，在学术期刊上受到广泛批评。

examples.sense: n. 基础；基地；底部；v. 以…为基础
examples.en: The expedition established a [base] camp at the foot of the mountain before the final ascent.
examples.cn: 探险队在最终攀登前在山脚下建立了[基地]营地。

examples.sense: n. 基础；基地；底部；v. 以…为基础
examples.en: Her argument was [based] on extensive field research conducted over three years in rural communities.
examples.cn: 她的论点[基于]三年来在农村社区进行的广泛实地调查研究。

examples.sense: n. 基础；基地；底部；v. 以…为基础
examples.en: The sculptor reinforced the [base] of the statue to prevent it from toppling during exhibitions.
examples.cn: 雕塑家加固了雕像的[底座]，防止其在展览期间倾倒。

examples.sense: n. 基础；基地；底部；v. 以…为基础
examples.en: The military [base] was strategically located to provide rapid response capability across the region.
examples.cn: 军事[基地]位置经过战略规划，能够为整个地区提供快速反应能力。

words.translation: n. 棒球\n[计] 棒球系统
words.definition: n. a ball game played with a bat and ball between two teams of nine players; teams take turns at bat trying to score runs\nn. a ball used in playing baseball

examples.en: [Baseball] is considered America's national pastime and has been played professionally since the 19th century.
examples.cn: [棒球]被视为美国的国民消遣，自19世纪以来就已进行职业比赛。

examples.en: She wore a [baseball] cap to shield her face from the scorching afternoon sun.
examples.cn: 她戴着[棒球]帽遮挡午后烈日。

examples.en: The coach emphasised that [baseball] requires both physical skill and sharp tactical thinking.
examples.cn: 教练强调[棒球]既需要身体技能，也需要敏锐的战术思维。

examples.en: Major League [Baseball] attracts hundreds of millions of viewers from across the globe each season.
examples.cn: 美国职业[棒球]大联盟每个赛季吸引来自全球数亿观众。

examples.en: His passion for [baseball] began when his grandfather took him to his first game at the age of six.
examples.cn: 他六岁时祖父带他去看第一场比赛，从此爱上了[棒球]。

words.translation: n. 地下室, 墙脚\n[化] 地下室
words.definition: n. the lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage\nn. the ground floor facade or interior in Renaissance architecture

examples.en: The research team converted the university's [basement] into a fully equipped recording studio.
examples.cn: 研究团队将大学的[地下室]改建为设备齐全的录音室。

examples.en: Flooding from the heavy rain seeped into the [basement] and damaged the stored archives.
examples.cn: 大雨引发的洪水渗入[地下室]，损坏了存放的档案。

examples.en: The [basement] of the old library contained rare manuscripts that dated back several centuries.
examples.cn: 老图书馆的[地下室]存放着可追溯至几个世纪前的珍贵手稿。

examples.en: She set up a small gym in the [basement] to exercise without leaving the house during winter.
examples.cn: 她在[地下室]建了一个小型健身房，冬天无需出门就能锻炼。

examples.en: The start-up company began its operations in a cramped [basement] with just three laptops and a whiteboard.
examples.cn: 这家初创公司在一间只有三台笔记本电脑和一块白板的狭小[地下室]里开始运营。

words.translation: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律\na. 基本的, 碱性的\n(计算机)BASIC语言
words.definition:
n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn; an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code; no longer in general use
n. (usually plural) a necessary commodity for which demand is constant
a. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality

examples.en: Access to clean water and nutritious food represents the most [basic] of human needs.
examples.cn: 获得清洁水源和营养食物是人类最[基本的]需求。

examples.en: The curriculum begins with [basic] grammar and vocabulary before advancing to complex language structures.
examples.cn: 课程从[基础的]语法和词汇开始，然后逐步发展到复杂的语言结构。

examples.en: A [basic] understanding of statistics is increasingly essential for careers in data-driven industries.
examples.cn: 对统计学的[基本]理解对于数据驱动行业的职业来说越来越不可缺少。

examples.en: The accommodation was [basic] but comfortable enough for a week-long research expedition.
examples.cn: 住宿条件[简陋]，但对于一周的研究考察来说已足够舒适。

examples.en: Respect for human dignity forms the [basic] principle underlying all international human rights law.
examples.cn: 尊重人的尊严构成所有国际人权法的[基本]原则。

words.translation: n. 盆, 盆地\n[医] 第三脑室, 骨盆
words.definition: n. a bowl-shaped vessel; usually used for holding food or liquids\nn. the quantity that a basin will hold\nn. a natural depression in the surface of the land often with a lake at the bottom of it

examples.en: The Amazon [basin] is one of the most biodiverse regions on the planet, home to millions of species.
examples.cn: 亚马逊[流域]是地球上生物多样性最丰富的地区之一，是数百万物种的家园。

examples.en: She poured cold water into the [basin] and splashed it on her face to wake herself up.
examples.cn: 她把冷水倒入[脸盆]里，把水泼在脸上让自己清醒。

examples.en: The river [basin] provides water resources for agriculture across five neighbouring provinces.
examples.cn: 这条河的[流域]为五个邻近省份的农业提供水资源。

examples.en: Geologists discovered significant oil deposits beneath the sedimentary layers of the coastal [basin].
examples.cn: 地质学家在沿海[盆地]的沉积层下发现了大量石油储量。

examples.en: Deforestation in the upper river [basin] has increased the risk of flooding in downstream communities.
examples.cn: 上游河[流域]的森林砍伐增加了下游社区的洪水风险。

words.translation: n. 基础, 主要成分\n[化] 基底
words.definition: n. the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained\nn. the most important or necessary part of something

examples.en: The peace treaty was negotiated on the [basis] of mutual respect and territorial integrity.
examples.cn: 和平条约在相互尊重和领土完整的[基础]上进行谈判。

examples.en: All policy decisions should be made on the [basis] of evidence rather than political expediency.
examples.cn: 所有政策决定都应以证据而非政治便宜为[基础]做出。

examples.en: Staff members are evaluated on a regular [basis] to ensure continuous professional development.
examples.cn: 工作人员定期接受评估，以确保持续的职业发展。

examples.en: The partnership was formed on the [basis] of shared values and complementary expertise.
examples.cn: 这一合作关系建立在共同价值观和互补专业知识的[基础]上。

examples.en: She volunteers at the community centre on a weekly [basis], teaching English to recent immigrants.
examples.cn: 她每周定期在社区中心志愿服务，为新移民教授英语。

words.translation: n. 篮, 篮子\nvt. 装入篮
words.definition:
n. a container that is usually woven and has handles
n. the quantity contained in a basket
n. horizontal circular metal hoop supporting a net through which players try to throw the basketball
n. a score in basketball made by throwing the ball through the hoop

examples.en: She filled the wicker [basket] with fresh vegetables from the garden to take to the market.
examples.cn: 她把花园里的新鲜蔬菜装满柳条[篮子]带去市场。

examples.en: The player scored the winning [basket] with just two seconds remaining on the clock.
examples.cn: 球员在比赛还剩两秒时投入了制胜的[一球]。

examples.en: Diversifying investments across different sectors is known as not putting all eggs in one [basket].
examples.cn: 将投资分散到不同行业被称为不把所有鸡蛋放在同一个[篮子]里。

examples.en: Traditional [basket] weaving is a craft passed down through generations in many indigenous cultures.
examples.cn: 传统[篮]编工艺在许多土著文化中代代相传。

examples.en: The charity distributed food [baskets] to low-income families throughout the holiday season.
examples.cn: 慈善机构在节假日期间向低收入家庭分发食品[篮]。

words.translation: n. 篮球
words.definition: n. a game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop\nn. an inflated ball used in playing basketball

examples.en: The national [basketball] team underwent intensive training before competing in the international championship.
examples.cn: 国家[篮球]队在参加国际锦标赛前接受了强化训练。

examples.en: Playing [basketball] develops teamwork, strategic thinking, and physical endurance simultaneously.
examples.cn: 打[篮球]同时培养团队合作、战略思维和体能耐力。

examples.en: He discovered his passion for [basketball] at the age of ten when he first watched a professional game.
examples.cn: 他十岁时第一次观看职业比赛，发现了对[篮球]的热爱。

examples.en: The school installed new outdoor [basketball] courts as part of its expanded sports facilities.
examples.cn: 学校新建了户外[篮球]场，作为扩展体育设施的一部分。

examples.en: [Basketball] has become one of the most widely watched sports globally, with a massive international fanbase.
examples.cn: [篮球]已成为全球收视率最高的运动之一，拥有庞大的国际球迷群体。

words.translation: n. 蝙蝠, 球棒\nv. 用球棒打, 眨眼\n[计] 成批
words.definition:
n. nocturnal mouselike mammal with forelimbs modified to form membranous wings and anatomical adaptations for echolocation by which they navigate
n. (baseball) a turn trying to get a hit
n. a club used for hitting a ball in various games
v. strike with, or as if with a baseball bat

examples.sense: n. 球棒；蝙蝠；v. 击打
examples.en: The batsman raised his [bat] in celebration after scoring a century against the visiting team.
examples.cn: 击球手在对阵来访球队打出百分之后举起[球棒]庆祝。

examples.sense: n. 球棒；蝙蝠；v. 击打
examples.en: [Bats] use echolocation to navigate in complete darkness with remarkable precision.
examples.cn: [蝙蝠]利用回声定位在完全黑暗中以惊人的精度导航。

examples.sense: n. 球棒；蝙蝠；v. 击打
examples.en: He [batted] away the questions about his private life and kept the interview focused on his work.
examples.cn: 他[挡开]有关私生活的问题，让采访集中在他的工作上。

examples.sense: n. 球棒；蝙蝠；v. 击打
examples.en: The colony of [bats] roosting in the cave ceiling numbered in the tens of thousands.
examples.cn: 栖息在洞穴顶部的[蝙蝠]群数量达数万只。

examples.sense: n. 球棒；蝙蝠；v. 击打
examples.en: She picked up a cricket [bat] for the first time at summer camp and quickly discovered a natural talent.
examples.cn: 她在夏令营第一次拿起板球[球棒]，很快发现了天赋。

words.translation: n. 沐浴, 浴室\n[医] 浴
words.definition:
n. a vessel containing liquid in which something is immersed (as to process it or to maintain it at a constant temperature or to lubricate it)
n. you soak and wash your body in a bathtub
n. an ancient Hebrew liquid measure equal to about 10 gallons
n. a town in southwestern England on the River Avon; famous for its hot springs and Roman remains

examples.en: A warm [bath] before bed is known to help lower body temperature and promote deeper sleep.
examples.cn: 睡前洗个温水[澡]有助于降低体温，促进更深层次的睡眠。

examples.en: The ancient Roman [baths] were sophisticated public facilities that served as social meeting places.
examples.cn: 古罗马[浴场]是精密的公共设施，兼作社交聚会场所。

examples.en: She ran a [bath] for her young son after he came home covered in mud from playing outside.
examples.cn: 儿子在外面玩耍后浑身是泥回到家，她为他放了一浴缸[洗澡水]。

examples.en: The laboratory used a chemical [bath] to develop the film and reveal the photographic images.
examples.cn: 实验室使用化学[浴液]显影胶片，呈现摄影图像。

examples.en: The spa offered mineral [baths] designed to soothe tired muscles and improve circulation.
examples.cn: 温泉中心提供矿物质[浴]，旨在舒缓疲惫的肌肉并改善循环。

words.translation: vt. 沐浴, 用水洗\nvi. 洗澡
words.definition:
n. the act of swimming
v. cleanse the entire body
v. suffuse with or as if with light
v. clean one's body by immersion into water

examples.sense: v. 洗澡；沐浴；使充满（光等）
examples.en: She would [bathe] in the mountain stream every morning during the summer expedition.
examples.cn: 她在夏季探险期间每天早晨在山间小溪里[沐浴]。

examples.sense: v. 洗澡；沐浴；使充满（光等）
examples.en: The golden light of the setting sun [bathed] the landscape in a warm amber glow.
examples.cn: 落日的金光将大地[沐浴]在温暖的琥珀色光芒中。

examples.sense: v. 洗澡；沐浴；使充满（光等）
examples.en: Parents are advised to [bathe] infants in lukewarm water to avoid shocking their sensitive skin.
examples.cn: 建议父母用温水给婴儿[洗澡]，以避免刺激其敏感皮肤。

examples.sense: v. 洗澡；沐浴；使充满（光等）
examples.en: The coastal town was [bathed] in fog every morning until the sun climbed high enough to burn it away.
examples.cn: 这座沿海小镇每天早晨[笼罩]在雾中，直到太阳升高才将其驱散。

examples.sense: v. 洗澡；沐浴；使充满（光等）
examples.en: Doctors advised her to [bathe] the wound gently with saline solution twice a day.
examples.cn: 医生建议她每天两次用生理盐水轻轻[清洗]伤口。

words.translation: n. 浴衣
words.definition: n. a loose-fitting robe of towelling; worn after a bath or swim

examples.en: She wrapped herself in a thick [bathrobe] after stepping out of the shower on the cold winter morning.
examples.cn: 在寒冷的冬日早晨淋浴后，她裹上一件厚厚的[浴袍]。

examples.en: Luxury hotels often provide guests with plush [bathrobes] as part of their premium amenities.
examples.cn: 豪华酒店通常为宾客提供蓬松[浴袍]作为高端设施的一部分。

examples.en: He padded downstairs in his [bathrobe] to make coffee before the rest of the household woke up.
examples.cn: 他穿着[浴袍]蹑手蹑脚地走下楼，在家里其他人醒来之前煮咖啡。

examples.en: The embroidered [bathrobe] was a thoughtful gift that she packed for the wellness retreat.
examples.cn: 这件绣花[浴袍]是她为健康疗养打包的一份贴心礼物。

examples.en: Cotton [bathrobes] absorb moisture quickly and are recommended for sensitive skin.
examples.cn: 棉质[浴袍]吸水性强，适合敏感肌肤使用。

words.translation: n. 浴室, 厕所
words.definition: n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet

examples.en: The hotel renovated every [bathroom] in the building to meet modern accessibility standards.
examples.cn: 酒店翻新了楼内每间[浴室]，以符合现代无障碍标准。

examples.en: She spent an hour in the [bathroom] preparing for the formal dinner with the visiting dignitaries.
examples.cn: 她在[浴室]里花了一个小时，为与来访贵宾的正式晚宴做准备。

examples.en: Proper ventilation in the [bathroom] is essential to prevent the buildup of mould and mildew.
examples.cn: [浴室]适当通风对于防止霉菌和霉斑积聚至关重要。

examples.en: Water-saving fixtures in the [bathroom] can significantly reduce a household's annual water consumption.
examples.cn: [浴室]中的节水设施可以显著减少家庭年度用水量。

examples.en: She kept a small notebook in the [bathroom] to jot down ideas that came to her while getting ready.
examples.cn: 她在[浴室]里放了一本小笔记本，用来记录梳洗时冒出的想法。

words.translation: n. 浴缸
words.definition: n. a relatively large open container that you fill with water and use to wash the body

examples.en: The plumber repaired the cracked [bathtub] and replaced the ageing fixtures in the bathroom.
examples.cn: 水管工修复了破裂的[浴缸]并更换了浴室中老化的配件。

examples.en: She filled the [bathtub] with warm water and lavender oil to relax after the stressful examination week.
examples.cn: 压力重重的考试周结束后，她往[浴缸]里放满温水和薰衣草精油放松身心。

examples.en: Renovating the old house included replacing the cast-iron [bathtub] with a modern walk-in shower.
examples.cn: 翻新旧房子包括将铸铁[浴缸]换成现代步入式淋浴间。

examples.en: The free-standing [bathtub] was the centrepiece of the master bathroom in the newly designed apartment.
examples.cn: 独立式[浴缸]是新设计公寓主卧浴室的中心装饰。

examples.en: Environmental concerns led many families to install showers instead of [bathtubs] to conserve water.
examples.cn: 出于环保考虑，许多家庭选择安装淋浴而非[浴缸]以节约用水。

words.translation: n. 电池, 殴打\n[化] 蓄电池
words.definition:
n. group of guns or missile launchers operated together at one place
n. a device that produces electricity; may have several primary or secondary cells arranged in parallel or series
n. a collection of related things intended for use together
n. a unit composed of the pitcher and catcher

examples.sense: n. 电池；炮兵连；一连串
examples.en: The electric vehicle's [battery] can be fully charged in under thirty minutes at a fast-charging station.
examples.cn: 电动汽车的[电池]在快速充电站不到三十分钟就能完全充电。

examples.sense: n. 电池；炮兵连；一连串
examples.en: Researchers are working to develop more efficient [battery] technology to extend the range of electric cars.
examples.cn: 研究人员正在努力开发更高效的[电池]技术，以延长电动汽车的续航里程。

examples.sense: n. 电池；炮兵连；一连串
examples.en: He faced a [battery] of questions from journalists at the press conference following the announcement.
examples.cn: 发布公告后，他在新闻发布会上面对了记者的[一连串]提问。

examples.sense: n. 电池；炮兵连；一连串
examples.en: The solar panels store energy in a [battery] bank that powers the building throughout the night.
examples.cn: 太阳能板将能量储存在[电池]组中，为建筑物整夜供电。

examples.sense: n. 电池；炮兵连；一连串
examples.en: The coastal [battery] of artillery cannons was positioned to defend the harbour from naval attack.
examples.cn: 海岸[炮兵连]的火炮被部署在防御港口免受海军攻击的位置。

words.translation: n. 战役\nv. 战斗
words.definition: n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war\nv. battle or contend against in or as if in a battle

examples.en: The [battle] of Stalingrad was one of the most decisive turning points of the Second World War.
examples.cn: 斯大林格勒[战役]是第二次世界大战最具决定性的转折点之一。

examples.en: She [battled] a serious illness throughout her final year of university while still graduating with honours.
examples.cn: 她在大学最后一年与重病[搏斗]，仍以优异成绩毕业。

examples.en: The legal [battle] over the patent rights continued for three years before the court issued a ruling.
examples.cn: 专利权方面的法律[争斗]持续了三年，法院才做出裁决。

examples.en: Environmental groups are [battling] government plans to open the protected forest to commercial logging.
examples.cn: 环保团体正在[对抗]政府开放受保护森林进行商业伐木的计划。

examples.en: The nation's [battle] against poverty requires sustained investment in education and healthcare.
examples.cn: 这个国家与贫困的[斗争]需要在教育和医疗保健方面持续投入。

words.translation: n. 战场, 战地
words.definition: n a region where a battle is being (or has been) fought

examples.en: The ancient [battleground] has been preserved as a national heritage site for future generations.
examples.cn: 这片古老的[战场]已被保护为供后代参观的国家遗址。

examples.en: Social media has become a [battleground] for competing narratives about political and social issues.
examples.cn: 社交媒体已成为政治和社会议题上竞争叙事的[战场]。

examples.en: The courtroom became a [battleground] for the two legal teams presenting opposing interpretations of the evidence.
examples.cn: 法庭成为两支法律团队就证据提出对立解释的[战场]。

examples.en: The classroom should never become a [battleground] of ideology but a space for open and respectful dialogue.
examples.cn: 课堂绝不应成为意识形态的[战场]，而应是开放、尊重对话的空间。

examples.en: The disputed territory remains a [battleground] for overlapping territorial claims from three countries.
examples.cn: 这片争议领土仍是三国领土主权重叠主张的[争夺场]。

words.translation: n. 海湾, 狗吠声, 月桂\nvt. 吠, 使走投无路\nvi. 吠
words.definition:
n. an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf
n. the sound of a hound on the scent
n. a compartment on a ship between decks; often used as a hospital
n. a compartment in an aircraft used for some specific purpose

examples.sense: n. 海湾；v. 吠叫；at bay 被逼退
examples.en: The fishing boats returned to the sheltered [bay] as storm clouds gathered on the horizon.
examples.cn: 随着地平线上乌云聚集，渔船返回了隐蔽的[海湾]。

examples.sense: n. 海湾；v. 吠叫；at bay 被逼退
examples.en: The hounds [bayed] loudly as they tracked the scent through the dense undergrowth.
examples.cn: 猎犬穿越茂密的灌木丛追踪气味时，发出响亮的[吠叫声]。

examples.sense: n. 海湾；v. 吠叫；at bay 被逼退
examples.en: The authorities managed to keep the spread of misinformation at [bay] through rapid fact-checking.
examples.cn: 当局通过快速事实核查成功将错误信息的传播[遏制住]。

examples.sense: n. 海湾；v. 吠叫；at bay 被逼退
examples.en: Guanabara [Bay] in Brazil is one of the largest bays in the world by water volume.
examples.cn: 巴西的瓜纳巴拉[湾]是世界上水量最大的海湾之一。

examples.sense: n. 海湾；v. 吠叫；at bay 被逼退
examples.en: The ancient castle was built on a cliff overlooking the [bay] for both defence and trade.
examples.cn: 古老的城堡建在俯瞰[海湾]的悬崖上，兼顾防御和贸易功能。

words.translation: v. 是, 表示, 在\n[计] 后端, 总线允许
words.definition:
v. have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
v. be identical to; be someone or something
v. occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere
v. happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"

examples.en: To [be] truly educated means not only acquiring knowledge but also developing critical thinking skills.
examples.cn: 真正受过教育意味着不仅要获取知识，还要培养批判性思维能力。

examples.en: She aspires to [be] a diplomat who bridges cultural divides through language and empathy.
examples.cn: 她渴望成为一名通过语言和同理心弥合文化鸿沟的[外交官]。

examples.en: The report confirmed what scientists had long suspected: the data could not [be] fabricated.
examples.cn: 报告证实了科学家长期以来的怀疑：这些数据不可能[是]伪造的。

examples.en: What matters most is not where you come from, but who you choose to [be].
examples.cn: 最重要的不是你来自哪里，而是你选择[成为]什么样的人。

examples.en: Let the evidence [be] the guide, not preconceived assumptions, when drawing scientific conclusions.
examples.cn: 在得出科学结论时，让证据[成为]指引，而非先入为主的假设。

words.translation: n. 海滩
words.definition: n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake\nv. land on a beach

examples.en: The pristine white [beach] stretched for miles along the coastline of the remote tropical island.
examples.cn: 洁白无瑕的[海滩]沿着偏远热带岛屿的海岸线延伸数英里。

examples.en: Rising sea levels threaten to erode [beaches] and destroy coastal ecosystems around the world.
examples.cn: 海平面上升威胁着侵蚀全球[海滩]并摧毁沿海生态系统。

examples.en: Volunteers organised a community [beach] clean-up to remove plastic waste and protect marine wildlife.
examples.cn: 志愿者组织了社区[海滩]清洁活动，清除塑料废弃物并保护海洋野生动物。

examples.en: The military landing was a decisive manoeuvre that established control of the fortified [beach].
examples.cn: 军事登陆是一次决定性的机动，确立了对设防[滩头]的控制权。

examples.en: The photographer captured the children building sandcastles on the golden [beach] at low tide.
examples.cn: 摄影师捕捉到孩子们在退潮时分在金色[海滩]上堆沙堡的画面。

words.translation:
n. 横梁, 杆, 光线, 容光焕发
vi. 用梁支承, 微笑, 射出光线
vt. 照耀, 感到欣喜
[计] 束
words.definition:
n. long thick piece of wood or metal or concrete, etc., used in construction
n. a group of nearly parallel lines of electromagnetic radiation
n. a column of light (as from a beacon)
n. (nautical) breadth amidships

examples.sense: n. 横梁；光束；v. 微笑；播送
examples.en: A [beam] of sunlight broke through the clouds and illuminated the cathedral's stained glass windows.
examples.cn: 一道[光束]穿破云层，照亮了大教堂的彩色玻璃窗。

examples.sense: n. 横梁；光束；v. 微笑；播送
examples.en: The architect designed the roof using exposed timber [beams] to create a warm, rustic atmosphere.
examples.cn: 建筑师使用外露木质[横梁]设计屋顶，营造温暖质朴的氛围。

examples.sense: n. 横梁；光束；v. 微笑；播送
examples.en: She [beamed] with pride when her daughter's name was called during the graduation ceremony.
examples.cn: 女儿的名字在毕业典礼上被念到时，她[满面]骄傲地[微笑]。

examples.sense: n. 横梁；光束；v. 微笑；播送
examples.en: The satellite [beams] high-speed internet signals to remote regions where cables cannot reach.
examples.cn: 卫星向电缆无法到达的偏远地区[播送]高速网络信号。

examples.sense: n. 横梁；光束；v. 微笑；播送
examples.en: The gymnast performed a flawless routine on the balance [beam] to score a personal best.
examples.cn: 体操运动员在平衡[木]上完成了完美的自选动作，创下个人最佳成绩。

words.translation: n. 豆子\n[化] 油嘴; 豆
words.definition:
n. any of various edible seeds of plants of the family Leguminosae used for food
n. any of various seeds or fruits that are beans or resemble beans
n. any of various leguminous plants grown for their edible seeds and pods
v. hit on the head, especially with a pitched baseball

examples.en: Black [beans] are a staple ingredient in Latin American cuisine and an excellent source of protein.
examples.cn: 黑[豆]是拉丁美洲菜肴的主食，也是优质的蛋白质来源。

examples.en: The farmer planted several varieties of [bean] crops to reduce the risk of total harvest failure.
examples.cn: 农民种植了几个品种的[豆类]作物，以降低全面减产的风险。

examples.en: Coffee [beans] are carefully selected and roasted to different levels to produce distinct flavour profiles.
examples.cn: 咖啡[豆]经过精心筛选，烘焙至不同程度，产生各具特色的风味。

examples.en: She grew runner [beans] along the garden fence, creating both a harvest and a natural privacy screen.
examples.cn: 她在花园围栏沿线种植了菜[豆]，既能收获蔬菜，又形成天然遮挡。

examples.en: Soya [beans] are a versatile crop used in food products, animal feed, and industrial applications worldwide.
examples.cn: 大[豆]是一种用途广泛的作物，全球范围内用于食品、动物饲料和工业应用。

words.translation: n. 豆腐

examples.en: Soft [beancurd] absorbs the flavours of the broth and spices it is cooked with beautifully.
examples.cn: 嫩[豆腐]能完美地吸收与之同煮的汤底和香料的味道。

examples.en: Mapo [beancurd] is a classic Sichuan dish celebrated for its bold, numbing spice and silky texture.
examples.cn: 麻婆[豆腐]是经典川菜，以其浓烈麻辣和嫩滑口感而备受推崇。

examples.en: [Beancurd] is an excellent source of plant-based protein and is widely consumed across East Asia.
examples.cn: [豆腐]是优质的植物蛋白来源，在东亚地区被广泛食用。

examples.en: The chef crumbled firm [beancurd] into the stir-fry as a nutritious substitute for minced meat.
examples.cn: 厨师将老[豆腐]捏碎加入炒菜中，作为肉末的营养替代品。

examples.en: In Chinese tradition, [beancurd] is associated with simplicity, humility, and nourishment.
examples.cn: 在中国传统中，[豆腐]象征着朴素、谦逊和滋养。

words.translation: n. 熊\nvt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价\nvi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向
words.definition:
n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws
n. an investor with a pessimistic market outlook; an investor who expects prices to fall and so sells now in order to buy later at a lower price
v. have
v. move while holding up or supporting

examples.sense: v. 承受；忍受；生（孩子）；携带
examples.en: The ancient bridge was not strong enough to [bear] the weight of modern heavy vehicles.
examples.cn: 这座古老的桥梁承受不了现代重型车辆的重量。

examples.sense: v. 承受；忍受；生（孩子）；携带
examples.en: She [bore] the responsibilities of leading the research team with quiet determination and skill.
examples.cn: 她以沉静的决心和技巧[承担]着领导研究团队的责任。

examples.en: The wildlife researcher observed the [bear] from a safe distance as it foraged along the riverbank.
examples.cn: 野生动物研究人员从安全距离观察[熊]在河岸觅食。

examples.sense: v. 承受；忍受；生（孩子）；携带
examples.en: She could not [bear] to watch the documentary about the environmental destruction of coral reefs.
examples.cn: 她无法[忍受]观看关于珊瑚礁环境破坏的纪录片。

examples.sense: v. 承受；忍受；生（孩子）；携带
examples.en: The document [bears] the official seal of the ministry and is considered legally binding.
examples.cn: 该文件[载有]部门的官方印章，被视为具有法律效力。

words.translation: n. 胡须\nvt. 抓住胡须, 公开反对
words.definition:
n. the hair growing on the lower part of a man's face
n. a tuft or growth of hairs or bristles on certain plants such as iris or grasses
n. a person who diverts suspicion from someone (especially a woman who accompanies a male homosexual in order to conceal his homosexuality)
n. hairy growth on or near the face of certain mammals

examples.en: He grew a full [beard] during the winter expedition and shaved it off when he returned home.
examples.cn: 他在冬季探险期间留了一把完整的[胡须]，回家后才剃掉。

examples.en: The historical portrait depicted a wise elder with a long white [beard] and penetrating eyes.
examples.cn: 这幅历史肖像描绘了一位长着白色长[胡须]、目光深邃的智慧长者。

examples.en: A well-trimmed [beard] has become fashionable among professional men in many urban environments.
examples.cn: 精心修剪的[胡子]在许多城市环境中的职业男性中变得时尚。

examples.en: The actor shaved his [beard] for the role, transforming his appearance significantly for the film.
examples.cn: 演员为了角色剃掉了[胡子]，显著改变了他在影片中的外貌。

examples.en: In many ancient cultures, a long [beard] was a symbol of wisdom, dignity, and social standing.
examples.cn: 在许多古代文化中，长[胡须]是智慧、尊严和社会地位的象征。

words.translation: n. 畜生, 动物, 野兽, 兽性
words.definition: n. a cruelly rapacious person

examples.en: The ancient myths described a terrible [beast] that could only be defeated by courage and cunning.
examples.cn: 古代神话描述了一头只能用勇气和智慧才能战胜的可怕[野兽]。

examples.en: The documentary followed wildlife rangers protecting endangered [beasts] from poaching in the national park.
examples.cn: 纪录片追踪了野生动物护林员在国家公园保护濒危[野兽]免遭偷猎的故事。

examples.en: Corruption is a [beast] that devours public trust and undermines institutional integrity.
examples.cn: 腐败是吞噬公众信任、破坏机构廉正的[猛兽]。

examples.en: The new supercomputer is a technological [beast] capable of processing billions of calculations per second.
examples.cn: 这台新型超级计算机是一头每秒可处理数十亿次计算的技术[怪兽]。

examples.en: The philosopher argued that what separates humans from [beasts] is the capacity for moral reasoning.
examples.cn: 这位哲学家认为，将人类与[野兽]区分开来的是道德推理能力。

words.translation:
n. 心跳(声), 打, 敲打声, 拍子
v. 打, 拍打, 打败
a. 疲乏的, 颓废的
beat的过去式
[计] 拍; 节拍
words.definition:
n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman
n. a single pulsation of an oscillation produced by adding two waves of different frequencies; has a frequency equal to the difference between the two oscillations
n. the sound of stroke or blow
n. a regular rate of repetition

examples.sense: v. 打败；敲打；跳动；n. 节拍
examples.en: The underdog team managed to [beat] the defending champions with a last-minute goal.
examples.cn: 弱势队伍以最后一分钟的进球[击败]了卫冕冠军。

examples.sense: v. 打败；敲打；跳动；n. 节拍
examples.en: Her heart [beat] faster as she approached the podium to deliver her first public speech.
examples.cn: 当她走向讲台准备发表第一次公开演讲时，心脏[跳动]加速。

examples.sense: v. 打败；敲打；跳动；n. 节拍
examples.en: The drummer maintained a steady [beat] throughout the performance to anchor the band's rhythm.
examples.cn: 鼓手在整个表演中保持稳定的[节拍]，为乐队的节奏提供支撑。

examples.sense: v. 打败；敲打；跳动；n. 节拍
examples.en: Rain [beat] against the windows relentlessly throughout the night, making sleep difficult.
examples.cn: 雨水整夜不停地[拍打]着窗户，令人难以入睡。

examples.sense: v. 打败；敲打；跳动；n. 节拍
examples.en: The chef [beat] the egg whites until they formed stiff peaks before folding them into the batter.
examples.cn: 厨师[打发]蛋白至硬峰状态，然后折入面糊。

words.translation: a. 美丽的
words.definition: a. delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration\ns. (of weather) highly enjoyable

examples.sense: adj. 美丽的；令人愉悦的
examples.en: The [beautiful] symmetry of the snowflake reveals the mathematical precision underlying nature's designs.
examples.cn: 雪花[美丽的]对称性揭示了自然设计背后的数学精确性。

examples.sense: adj. 美丽的；令人愉悦的
examples.en: She delivered a [beautiful] speech that moved the audience to tears with its sincerity and depth.
examples.cn: 她发表了一篇[精彩的]演讲，以其真诚和深度令观众动容流泪。

examples.sense: adj. 美丽的；令人愉悦的
examples.en: The archaeologist described the mosaic as one of the most [beautiful] artefacts discovered at the site.
examples.cn: 考古学家将这幅马赛克描述为该遗址发现的最[精美的]文物之一。

examples.sense: adj. 美丽的；令人愉悦的
examples.en: A [beautiful] mind is one that sees complexity, asks questions, and never stops seeking understanding.
examples.cn: 一颗[美丽的]心灵能看到复杂性、提出问题并永不停止寻求理解。

examples.sense: adj. 美丽的；令人愉悦的
examples.en: The mountainous landscape was breathtakingly [beautiful] in autumn when the foliage turned crimson and gold.
examples.cn: 秋天树叶变成深红和金色时，山地景色[美丽]得令人叹为观止。

words.translation: n. 美, 美人
words.definition: n. the qualities that give pleasure to the senses\nn. an outstanding example of its kind

examples.en: The [beauty] of classical music lies in its capacity to express emotions that words cannot capture.
examples.cn: 古典音乐的[美]在于其表达文字无法捕捉的情感的能力。

examples.en: Philosophers have debated the nature of [beauty] for millennia, questioning whether it is objective or subjective.
examples.cn: 哲学家们数千年来一直在争论[美]的本质，质疑它是客观的还是主观的。

examples.en: The [beauty] of scientific discovery is that each answer generates a multitude of new questions.
examples.cn: 科学发现的[美]在于每一个答案都会产生无数新问题。

examples.en: She was renowned not only for her physical [beauty] but also for her extraordinary intellect and compassion.
examples.cn: 她不仅以外在[美貌]著称，还以非凡的才智和慈悲心闻名。

examples.en: The national park was established to preserve the natural [beauty] of the wilderness for future generations.
examples.cn: 国家公园的建立是为了为后代保护荒野的自然[美景]。

words.translation: conj. 因为
words.definition: conj. By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the\n   reason that.\nconj. In order that; that.

examples.en: The experiment failed [because] the team had not accounted for variations in temperature during testing.
examples.cn: 实验失败了，[因为]团队在测试过程中没有考虑温度变化。

examples.en: She chose to study medicine [because] she wanted to make a tangible difference in people's lives.
examples.cn: 她选择学医[因为]她希望对人们的生活产生切实的影响。

examples.en: The project was cancelled [because] funding was withdrawn at the last minute by the sponsoring organisation.
examples.cn: 该项目被取消了，[因为]赞助机构在最后一刻撤回了资金。

examples.en: Just [because] something is popular does not mean it is necessarily correct or beneficial.
examples.cn: 仅仅[因为]某件事受欢迎并不意味着它一定是正确或有益的。

examples.en: Climate change is accelerating [because] greenhouse gas emissions have not been sufficiently reduced.
examples.cn: 气候变化正在加速，[因为]温室气体排放没有得到充分减少。

words.translation: vi. 变成, 变得\nvt. 适合
words.definition:
v. enter or assume a certain state or condition
v. undergo a change or development
v. come into existence
v. enhance the appearance of

examples.en: She worked tirelessly to [become] the first female president of the student union in the university's history.
examples.cn: 她不懈努力，[成为]了大学历史上第一位女性学生会主席。

examples.en: The small coastal village has [become] a major tourist destination over the past two decades.
examples.cn: 这个小渔村在过去二十年里[成为]了主要旅游目的地。

examples.en: Renewable energy has [become] increasingly cost-competitive with fossil fuels in many markets.
examples.cn: 可再生能源在许多市场上与化石燃料的成本竞争力[已变得]越来越强。

examples.en: Habits that we form in youth often [become] the foundation of our character as adults.
examples.cn: 我们年轻时养成的习惯往往[成为]成年后性格的基础。

examples.en: The discovery has [become] a landmark moment in the history of molecular biology research.
examples.cn: 这一发现[已成为]分子生物学研究史上的里程碑时刻。

words.translation: n. 床, 睡眠处, 河床, 底座, 路基, 一层\nvt. 提供宿处, 栽种, 安装\nvi. 睡, 形成坚实的一层
words.definition:
n. a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep
n. a plot of ground in which plants are growing
n. a depression forming the ground under a body of water
n. (geology) a stratum of rock (especially sedimentary rock)

examples.en: She sat up in [bed] and opened her textbook before the rest of the dormitory had even woken up.
examples.cn: 她坐在[床]上打开教科书，此时宿舍其他人甚至还没醒来。

examples.en: The gardener planted a colourful [bed] of tulips and daffodils along the path to the entrance.
examples.cn: 园丁沿着入口小道种了一块色彩缤纷的郁金香和水仙花[花圃]。

examples.en: The river [bed] was exposed during the severe drought, revealing rocks and fossils preserved for centuries.
examples.cn: 严重旱灾期间[河床]裸露，露出了保存数百年的岩石和化石。

examples.en: Going to [bed] at a consistent time each night improves sleep quality and daytime concentration.
examples.cn: 每晚固定时间上[床]睡觉能改善睡眠质量和白天的专注度。

examples.en: The hospital introduced new protocols to prevent [bed] sores in patients with limited mobility.
examples.cn: 医院引入了新规程，防止行动不便患者出现[褥疮]。

words.translation: n. 铺盖, 床上用品\n[医] 铺盖, 被褥
words.definition: n. coverings that are used on a bed

examples.en: She stripped the [bedclothes] and put them in the washing machine before airing out the mattress.
examples.cn: 她撤下[床上用品]放入洗衣机，然后给床垫通风。

examples.en: Clean [bedclothes] are changed weekly in the dormitory as part of the hygiene policy.
examples.cn: 宿舍每周更换干净的[床上用品]，这是卫生政策的一部分。

examples.en: The charity collected donations of [bedclothes] and warm clothing for families affected by the flooding.
examples.cn: 慈善机构为受洪水影响的家庭收集了[床上用品]和保暖衣物捐赠。

examples.en: High-quality [bedclothes] made from natural fibres can significantly improve comfort during sleep.
examples.cn: 由天然纤维制成的高质量[床上用品]能显著改善睡眠舒适度。

examples.en: The child pulled the [bedclothes] over her head to shut out the light from the hallway.
examples.cn: 孩子把[被褥]拉过头顶，遮住走廊透进来的光线。

words.meaning: 寝具；（建筑）[建] 基床；（家畜）草垫
words.translation:
n. 寝具；（建筑）[建] 基床；（家畜）草垫
a. 适于花坛种植的
vt. 把…栽入苗床（bed的ing形式）
vi. 睡（bed的ing形式）
words.definition: n coverings that are used on a bed\nn material used to provide a bed for animals

examples.sense: n. 床上铺垫物；寝具（总称）
examples.en: The hostel provided basic [beddings] including a pillow, sheet, and blanket for each guest.
examples.cn: 旅舍为每位客人提供基本[寝具]，包括枕头、床单和毯子。

examples.sense: n. 床上铺垫物；寝具（总称）
examples.en: She chose hypoallergenic [beddings] to reduce allergic reactions during the spring pollen season.
examples.cn: 她选择了低致敏性[寝具]，以减少春季花粉季节的过敏反应。

examples.sense: n. 床上铺垫物；寝具（总称）
examples.en: Washing [beddings] regularly at high temperatures helps eliminate dust mites and allergens.
examples.cn: 定期用高温清洗[寝具]有助于消灭尘螨和过敏原。

examples.sense: n. 床上铺垫物；寝具（总称）
examples.en: The refugee camp distributed emergency [beddings] to ensure displaced families could sleep in warmth.
examples.cn: 难民营分发紧急[床上铺垫物]，确保流离失所的家庭能温暖入睡。

examples.sense: n. 床上铺垫物；寝具（总称）
examples.en: Straw [beddings] were traditionally used in rural homes before synthetic materials became widely available.
examples.cn: 在合成材料普及之前，农村家庭传统上使用稻草作为[床铺垫料]。

words.translation: n. 卧室
words.definition: n. a room used primarily for sleeping

examples.en: She converted the spare [bedroom] into a home office to accommodate remote working arrangements.
examples.cn: 她将空余[卧室]改造成家庭办公室，以适应远程工作安排。

examples.en: The architect designed a [bedroom] with floor-to-ceiling windows that offered panoramic views of the mountains.
examples.cn: 建筑师设计了一间有落地窗的[卧室]，可以全景欣赏山景。

examples.en: Research suggests that keeping the [bedroom] cool and dark promotes better quality sleep.
examples.cn: 研究表明，保持[卧室]凉爽和黑暗有助于提高睡眠质量。

examples.en: A three-[bedroom] apartment in the city centre costs significantly more than one in the suburbs.
examples.cn: 市中心的三[卧室]公寓价格远高于郊区的同类公寓。

examples.en: She hung motivational quotes on the [bedroom] wall to inspire herself every morning before school.
examples.cn: 她在[卧室]墙上贴了励志语录，每天早晨上学前激励自己。

words.translation: n. 蜜蜂, 聚会
words.definition: n. any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species\nn. a social gathering to carry out some communal task or to hold competitions

examples.en: The [bee] plays a vital role in pollinating crops that form the basis of global food supplies.
examples.cn: [蜜蜂]在给构成全球粮食供应基础的农作物授粉方面起着至关重要的作用。

examples.en: Declining [bee] populations worldwide have raised serious concerns among scientists and farmers alike.
examples.cn: 全球[蜜蜂]数量下降引起了科学家和农民的严重担忧。

examples.en: She was stung by a [bee] while gardening but recovered quickly after applying a cold compress.
examples.cn: 她在园艺时被[蜜蜂]蜇了，但敷了冷敷后很快恢复。

examples.en: The documentary explored the complex social structure of a [bee] colony, led by a single queen.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片探索了由单一蜂后领导的[蜜蜂]群落的复杂社会结构。

examples.en: Scientists are studying how [bees] communicate the location of flowers through their waggle dance.
examples.cn: 科学家正在研究[蜜蜂]如何通过摇摆舞传达花朵的位置信息。

words.translation: n. 牛肉, 肌肉\nvt. 养(牛), 宰(牛)\nvi. 抱怨, 告发
words.definition: n. cattle that are reared for their meat\nn. meat from an adult domestic bovine

examples.en: Grass-fed [beef] contains higher levels of omega-3 fatty acids compared to grain-fed varieties.
examples.cn: 草饲[牛肉]与谷物饲养的品种相比，含有更高水平的omega-3脂肪酸。

examples.en: The restaurant was renowned for its slow-roasted [beef] served with seasonal vegetables and gravy.
examples.cn: 这家餐厅以搭配时令蔬菜和肉汁的慢烤[牛肉]而闻名。

examples.en: Global [beef] production has significant environmental implications, contributing to deforestation and methane emissions.
examples.cn: 全球[牛肉]生产具有重大环境影响，助长了森林砍伐和甲烷排放。

examples.en: She marinated the [beef] for twelve hours to tenderise it before slow-cooking it with herbs.
examples.cn: 她将[牛肉]腌制十二小时使其软化，然后与香草一起慢炖。

examples.en: His main [beef] with the policy was that it disproportionately affected lower-income households.
examples.cn: 他对该政策的主要[抱怨]是它对低收入家庭的影响不成比例。

words.translation: n. 蜂窝, 蜂箱\n[机] 集气架, 蜂巢
words.definition: n. any workplace where people are very busy\nn. a structure that provides a natural habitation for bees; as in a hollow tree\nn. a hairdo resembling a beehive

examples.en: The beekeeper carefully opened the [beehive] wearing protective gear to collect the honeycomb.
examples.cn: 养蜂人穿戴防护装备，小心翼翼地打开[蜂箱]采集蜂巢。

examples.en: A single [beehive] can house up to 80,000 bees, all working collaboratively under the queen's direction.
examples.cn: 一个[蜂巢]可以容纳多达8万只蜜蜂，全部在蜂后的指挥下协作工作。

examples.en: The architect drew inspiration from the hexagonal structure of the [beehive] for the building's façade design.
examples.cn: 建筑师从[蜂巢]的六边形结构中汲取灵感，设计建筑外立面。

examples.en: When a [beehive] becomes overcrowded, a swarm will leave with a new queen to establish a colony elsewhere.
examples.cn: 当[蜂巢]过于拥挤时，一群蜜蜂会跟随新蜂后离开，在别处建立蜂群。

examples.en: Schools are setting up classroom [beehives] to teach students about the ecology and importance of pollinators.
examples.cn: 学校正在设置课堂[蜂箱]，向学生传授授粉者的生态和重要性。

words.translation: n. 啤酒\n[化] 啤酒
words.definition: n. a general name for alcoholic beverages made by fermenting a cereal (or mixture of cereals) flavored with hops

examples.en: The microbrewery produced a range of craft [beers] using locally sourced hops and barley.
examples.cn: 这家精酿啤酒厂使用本地采购的啤酒花和大麦，生产了一系列精酿[啤酒]。

examples.en: In many European countries, [beer] production is considered a cultural heritage industry.
examples.cn: 在许多欧洲国家，[啤酒]生产被视为文化遗产产业。

examples.en: Public health campaigns have highlighted the risks of excessive [beer] consumption among young people.
examples.cn: 公共卫生活动强调了年轻人过量饮用[啤酒]的风险。

examples.en: The ancient Egyptians are believed to have brewed [beer] as early as 3000 BCE for both nutrition and ritual.
examples.cn: 据信古埃及人早在公元前3000年就开始酿造[啤酒]，用于营养和仪式。

examples.en: The annual [beer] festival attracted thousands of visitors from across the region to sample local brews.
examples.cn: 年度[啤酒]节吸引了来自该地区各地的数千名游客品尝本地酿造。

words.translation: prep. 在...之前\nconj. 在...之前\nadv. 在前
words.definition: r earlier in time; previously\nr at or in the front

examples.en: Students must complete all required reading [before] the seminar to contribute meaningfully to the discussion.
examples.cn: 学生必须在研讨会[之前]完成所有规定的阅读，才能对讨论做出有意义的贡献。

examples.en: Never [before] had the committee faced such a complex ethical dilemma in its twenty-year history.
examples.cn: 在二十年的历史中，委员会从未[以前]面临过如此复杂的伦理困境。

examples.en: She reviewed her notes one final time [before] walking into the examination room with confidence.
examples.cn: 她最后一次复习笔记，然后自信地走进考场。

examples.en: The director insisted that all scenes be shot [before] dawn to capture the perfect morning light.
examples.cn: 导演坚持所有场景必须在[日出之前]拍摄，以捕捉完美的晨光。

examples.en: Scientists warn that action must be taken [before] the damage to the ecosystem becomes irreversible.
examples.cn: 科学家警告说，必须在对生态系统的破坏变得不可逆转[之前]采取行动。

words.translation: v. 乞求, 乞讨, 请求
words.definition: v. call upon in supplication; entreat\nv. ask to obtain free\nv. dodge, avoid answering, or take for granted

examples.en: She [begged] her professor for an extension on the assignment due to a family emergency.
examples.cn: 她因家庭紧急情况[恳求]教授延长作业截止日期。

examples.en: The charity helped homeless individuals [begging] on the streets by connecting them to shelter and support services.
examples.cn: 慈善机构通过将街头[乞讨]的无家可归者与庇护所和支持服务联系起来，帮助他们。

examples.en: He [begged] the committee to reconsider its decision before the deadline for appeal had passed.
examples.cn: 他[恳求]委员会在上诉截止日期前重新考虑其决定。

examples.en: The climbers [begged] for mercy from the storm, sheltering in a narrow crevice overnight.
examples.cn: 登山者在一道狭窄的裂缝中过夜，向暴风雨[祈求]怜悯。

examples.en: The situation [begs] the question of whether economic growth can be sustained without environmental cost.
examples.cn: 这种情况[引出了]一个问题：经济增长能否在没有环境代价的情况下持续。

words.translation: v. 开始\n[计] 开始
words.definition:
n. Israeli statesman (born in Russia) who (as prime minister of Israel) negotiated a peace treaty with Anwar Sadat (then the president of Egypt) (1913-1992)
v. have a beginning, in a temporal, spatial, or evaluative sense
v. set in motion, cause to start
v. begin to speak or say

examples.en: The ceremony will [begin] with a traditional musical performance before the speeches commence.
examples.cn: 典礼将以传统音乐表演[开始]，然后再进行演讲。

examples.en: She decided to [begin] learning a third language after mastering English to an advanced level.
examples.cn: 她在将英语掌握到高级水平后，决定[开始]学习第三门语言。

examples.en: Negotiations [began] in earnest after both parties agreed on the basic framework for discussion.
examples.cn: 双方就讨论的基本框架达成一致后，谈判[开始]认真进行。

examples.en: Climate change [began] accelerating rapidly in the second half of the twentieth century due to industrialisation.
examples.cn: 由于工业化，气候变化在二十世纪下半叶[开始]迅速加速。

examples.en: Every long journey [begins] with a single step, as the ancient philosopher observed.
examples.cn: 如古代哲学家所言，每一段漫长的旅程都从一步[开始]。

words.translation: n. 开始
words.definition:
n. the event consisting of the start of something
n. the time at which something is supposed to begin
n. the first part or section of something
n. the place where something begins, where it springs into being

examples.en: The [beginning] of each academic year presents an opportunity to set new goals and refine study habits.
examples.cn: 每个学年的[开始]都提供了设定新目标和完善学习习惯的机会。

examples.en: In the [beginning], the start-up operated from a single room with a team of just five people.
examples.cn: [起初]，这家初创公司在一个房间里运营，团队只有五人。

examples.en: The [beginning] of the novel establishes the political context that shapes the characters' fates.
examples.cn: 小说的[开头]建立了塑造人物命运的政治背景。

examples.en: Scientists trace the [beginning] of the universe to the Big Bang approximately 13.8 billion years ago.
examples.cn: 科学家将宇宙的[起源]追溯到大约138亿年前的大爆炸。

examples.en: Every expert was once a beginner; mastery is simply a [beginning] extended over years of deliberate practice.
examples.cn: 每位专家曾经都是初学者；精通只是[开始]在多年刻意练习中延伸的结果。

words.translation: n. 利益, 方面
words.definition: n. as the agent of or on someone's part (usually expressed as "on behalf of" rather than "in behalf of"); \nn. for someone's benefit (usually expressed as `in behalf' rather than `on behalf' and usually with a possessive)

examples.sense: n. 代表；利益（on behalf of）
examples.en: The lawyer submitted the appeal on [behalf] of the client who was unable to attend the hearing.
examples.cn: 律师代表无法出席听证会的客户提交了上诉。

examples.sense: n. 代表；利益（on behalf of）
examples.en: She accepted the award on [behalf] of the entire research team that had contributed to the project.
examples.cn: 她代表为该项目做出贡献的整个研究团队领取了奖项。

examples.sense: n. 代表；利益（on behalf of）
examples.en: The ambassador spoke on [behalf] of his government at the emergency session of the United Nations.
examples.cn: 大使在联合国紧急会议上代表其政府发言。

examples.sense: n. 代表；利益（on behalf of）
examples.en: Non-governmental organisations often advocate on [behalf] of marginalised communities that lack political representation.
examples.cn: 非政府组织经常为缺乏政治代表权的边缘化社区代言。

examples.sense: n. 代表；利益（on behalf of）
examples.en: The school principal wrote a reference letter on [behalf] of the student applying for the scholarship.
examples.cn: 校长为申请奖学金的学生写了一封推荐信。

words.translation: vi. 举止端正, 行为规矩\nvt. 检点(自己的)行为, 使表现好
words.definition: v. behave in a certain manner\nv. behave well or properly

examples.en: Children who are taught to [behave] respectfully towards others tend to develop stronger social relationships.
examples.cn: 被教导[表现得]尊重他人的孩子往往会建立更强的社会关系。

examples.en: The experimental compound [behaved] differently under high pressure, producing unexpected chemical reactions.
examples.cn: 该实验化合物在高压下[表现]不同，产生了意想不到的化学反应。

examples.en: Professionals are expected to [behave] with integrity and transparency in all business dealings.
examples.cn: 专业人员在所有商业交易中都被期望以诚信和透明的方式[行事]。

examples.en: The way leaders [behave] under pressure often determines whether a team can maintain its morale.
examples.cn: 领导者在压力下的[表现]往往决定了团队是否能维持士气。

examples.en: Students were reminded to [behave] appropriately during the ceremony in front of distinguished guests.
examples.cn: 学生被提醒在杰出嘉宾面前的典礼上要[举止]得体。

words.translation: n. 行为, 举止\n[计] 特性, 性能, 特点, 行为, 动作, 状态
words.definition:
n the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances
n (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people
n (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation
n manner of acting or controlling yourself

examples.en: The psychologist studied the [behaviour] of individuals under social pressure in a controlled experimental setting.
examples.cn: 心理学家在受控实验环境中研究了个体在社会压力下的[行为]。

examples.en: Aggressive [behaviour] in the workplace undermines team cohesion and reduces overall productivity.
examples.cn: 工作场所的攻击性[行为]破坏团队凝聚力，降低整体生产效率。

examples.en: Environmental factors such as diet and sleep significantly influence a child's [behaviour] at school.
examples.cn: 饮食和睡眠等环境因素显著影响孩子在学校的[行为]。

examples.en: The [behaviour] of the algorithm changed dramatically when trained on a different dataset.
examples.cn: 该算法在不同数据集上训练时，[性能]发生了显著变化。

examples.en: Understanding consumer [behaviour] is essential for companies designing effective marketing strategies.
examples.cn: 了解消费者[行为]对设计有效营销策略的公司至关重要。

words.translation: adv. 在后地\nprep. 在...背后
words.definition:
s. having the lower score or lagging position in a contest
r. in or to or toward the rear
r. remaining in a place or condition that has been left or departed from
r. of timepieces

examples.en: The forces driving climate change are largely [behind] policy decisions made in the twentieth century.
examples.cn: 推动气候变化的力量在很大程度上[源于]二十世纪做出的政策决定。

examples.en: She stayed [behind] after the lecture to ask the professor about the research methodology.
examples.cn: 她在讲座结束后[留下来]向教授询问研究方法。

examples.en: He fell [behind] in his studies during the illness but caught up quickly once he recovered.
examples.cn: 他生病期间学业[落后]了，但康复后很快就追了上来。

examples.en: The motive [behind] the policy change was to attract international investors to the technology sector.
examples.cn: 政策改变[背后的]动机是吸引国际投资者进入技术行业。

examples.en: The real data [behind] the headlines revealed a more nuanced and complex picture of economic performance.
examples.cn: 标题[背后]的真实数据揭示了经济表现更为细致复杂的图景。

words.translation: n. 存在, 性质, 生命, 人, 生物, be的现在分词
words.definition: n. the state or fact of existing

examples.en: Every human [being] has the right to education, healthcare, and a life free from persecution.
examples.cn: 每个人类[个体]都有受教育、获得医疗保健和免受迫害生活的权利。

examples.en: The philosopher explored what it means to [be] a conscious [being] in an indifferent universe.
examples.cn: 哲学家探讨了在一个漠然宇宙中作为有意识[存在]意味着什么。

examples.en: Science fiction often imagines how contact with alien [beings] might transform human civilisation.
examples.cn: 科幻小说常常设想与外星[生命体]接触可能如何改变人类文明。

examples.en: The novel raises philosophical questions about the nature of artificial [beings] and their moral status.
examples.cn: 这部小说提出了关于人工[存在]的本质及其道德地位的哲学问题。

examples.en: The meditation retreat encouraged participants to explore their inner [being] through silence and reflection.
examples.cn: 冥想静修鼓励参与者通过静默和反思探索内在[自我]。

words.translation: n. 比利时
words.definition: n. a monarchy in northwestern Europe; headquarters for the European Union and for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization

examples.en: [Belgium] is renowned for its world-class chocolate, waffles, and a diverse range of craft beers.
examples.cn: [比利时]以其世界级的巧克力、华夫饼和多样的精酿啤酒而闻名。

examples.en: As the home of NATO and major EU institutions, [Belgium] holds considerable geopolitical significance.
examples.cn: 作为北约和欧盟主要机构的所在地，[比利时]具有相当重要的地缘政治意义。

examples.en: The First World War battlefields of [Belgium] have become sites of remembrance visited by millions annually.
examples.cn: [比利时]的第一次世界大战战场已成为每年数百万人参观的纪念地。

examples.en: [Belgium] is a multilingual nation where French, Dutch, and German are all official languages.
examples.cn: [比利时]是一个多语言国家，法语、荷兰语和德语都是官方语言。

examples.en: The capital of [Belgium], Brussels, hosts the headquarters of several major international organisations.
examples.cn: [比利时]首都布鲁塞尔是几个主要国际组织的总部所在地。

words.translation: n. 信念, 相信, 信仰
words.definition: n. any cognitive content held as true

examples.en: Her unshakeable [belief] in the importance of education motivated her to establish schools in remote villages.
examples.cn: 她对教育重要性的坚定[信念]激励她在偏远村庄建立学校。

examples.en: Scientific progress depends on the willingness to challenge established [beliefs] with evidence and experiment.
examples.cn: 科学进步有赖于用证据和实验挑战既有[信念]的意愿。

examples.en: Cultural [beliefs] about gender roles vary significantly across different societies and historical periods.
examples.cn: 不同社会和历史时期的文化[观念]在性别角色方面差异显著。

examples.en: Beyond [belief], the rescue team found survivors after twelve days buried beneath the rubble.
examples.cn: 令人难以[置信的]是，救援队在废墟下埋压十二天后发现了幸存者。

examples.en: Religious [belief] has shaped the laws, arts, and social institutions of civilisations throughout history.
examples.cn: 宗教[信仰]在历史上塑造了各文明的法律、艺术和社会制度。

words.translation: v. 相信
words.definition:
v. accept as true; take to be true
v. be confident about something
v. follow a credo; have a faith; be a believer
v. credit with veracity

examples.en: Researchers [believe] that the newly discovered compound could revolutionise cancer treatment within a decade.
examples.cn: 研究人员[认为]，新发现的化合物可能在十年内彻底改变癌症治疗。

examples.en: She [believed] strongly that every student deserved access to quality education regardless of background.
examples.cn: 她坚定地[相信]，每个学生都应该获得优质教育，无论背景如何。

examples.en: It is hard to [believe] that just fifty years ago, space exploration was considered an impossible dream.
examples.cn: 很难[相信]，就在五十年前，太空探索还被认为是不可能的梦想。

examples.en: The citizens [believed] the government's promises of reform, only to be disappointed by inaction.
examples.cn: 公民们[相信]了政府的改革承诺，却因不作为而感到失望。

examples.en: To truly [believe] in yourself means persisting when others doubt your potential.
examples.cn: 真正[相信]自己意味着在他人质疑你的潜力时坚持下去。

words.translation: n. 铃, 钟\n[计] 响铃命令
words.definition:
n. a hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck
n. the sound of a bell being struck
n. (nautical) each of the eight half-hour units of nautical time signaled by strokes of a ship's bell; eight bells signals 4:00, 8:00, or 12:00 o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.
n. the shape of a bell

examples.en: The church [bell] rang twelve times at noon, marking the midpoint of the working day.
examples.cn: 正午时分，教堂[钟声]敲响了十二下，标志着工作日的中间点。

examples.en: The school [bell] signalled the end of examinations, and a wave of relief swept through the hall.
examples.cn: 学校[铃声]宣告考试结束，一股如释重负的感觉席卷了整个大厅。

examples.en: In ancient times, temple [bells] were rung to mark significant ceremonies and summon worshippers.
examples.cn: 古代，寺庙[钟声]被敲响以标志重要仪式并召唤信徒。

examples.en: The fire alarm [bell] forced the evacuation of all students and staff within minutes.
examples.cn: 火警[铃声]迫使所有学生和教职人员在数分钟内疏散。

examples.en: The name rang a [bell] but she could not immediately place where she had heard it before.
examples.cn: 这个名字让她[有些印象]，但她一时想不起来以前在哪里听说过。

words.translation: n. 腹部, 食欲\nvt. 使鼓起\nvi. 鼓起, 匍匐前进
words.definition:
n. a protruding abdomen
n. a part that bulges deeply
n. the hollow inside of something
n. the underpart of the body of certain vertebrates such as snakes or fish

examples.en: The lion rolled onto its [belly] and stretched out lazily in the afternoon sun.
examples.cn: 狮子翻过身来，[肚子]朝下，懒洋洋地在午后阳光中伸展。

examples.en: A well-nourished [belly] full of nutritious food helps children concentrate better during lessons.
examples.cn: 营养充足、吃饱饭的孩子在课堂上能更好地集中注意力。

examples.en: Butterflies in her [belly] before the performance were a sign of healthy nerves and preparation.
examples.cn: 演出前[肚子]里的紧张感是良性紧张和充分准备的标志。

examples.en: The old sailor had a weather-beaten face and a rounded [belly] from years at sea.
examples.cn: 这位老水手有张饱经风霜的脸，还有多年海上生涯留下的圆滚滚的[肚子]。

examples.en: The aircraft's cargo [belly] was packed with relief supplies destined for the disaster zone.
examples.cn: 飞机的货舱[腹部]装满了运往灾区的救援物资。

words.translation: vi. 属于, 合适
words.definition:
v. be owned by; be in the possession of
v. be suitable or acceptable
v. be in the right place or situation
v. be rightly classified in a class or category

examples.en: The disputed artefacts [belong] to the indigenous community and should be repatriated immediately.
examples.cn: 这些有争议的文物[属于]土著社区，应立即归还。

examples.en: A sense of [belonging] to a community is essential for individuals' psychological wellbeing.
examples.cn: 归[属于]一个社区的感觉对个人的心理健康至关重要。

examples.en: She never felt she fully [belonged] in the competitive corporate environment and eventually moved to academia.
examples.cn: 她从未感觉完全[融入]竞争激烈的企业环境，最终转向学术界。

examples.en: This document [belongs] in the classified section of the archive and must not be publicly disclosed.
examples.cn: 这份文件[应归入]档案的机密部分，不得公开披露。

examples.en: The theory [belongs] to a tradition of structural linguistics that dominated the field for decades.
examples.cn: 该理论[属于]主导该领域数十年的结构语言学传统。

words.translation: prep. 在下面\nadv. 在下面
words.definition: r. in or to a place that is lower\nr. at a later place\nr. (in writing) see below

examples.en: Temperatures fell [below] freezing overnight, causing hazardous ice to form on the roads.
examples.cn: 气温在夜间降至冰点[以下]，导致路面结成危险的冰层。

examples.en: The research station was built [below] the ice sheet to protect it from extreme surface conditions.
examples.cn: 研究站建在冰盖[之下]，以保护其免受极端地表条件的影响。

examples.en: Her test score was [below] the national average but she was determined to improve significantly.
examples.cn: 她的考试成绩[低于]全国平均水平，但她决心大幅提高。

examples.en: The living standards of the poorest households fell [below] an acceptable threshold during the economic crisis.
examples.cn: 在经济危机期间，最贫困家庭的生活水平跌至可接受标准[以下]。

examples.en: The submarine descended two hundred metres [below] the surface to observe the deep-sea ecosystem.
examples.cn: 潜水艇下潜到水面[以下]两百米处，观察深海生态系统。

words.translation: n. 带子, 地带\n[医] 带, 腰带, 束带, 地带, 区
words.definition:
n. endless loop of flexible material between two rotating shafts or pulleys
n. a band to tie or buckle around the body (usually at the waist)
n. an elongated region where a specific condition or characteristic is found
n. ammunition (usually of small caliber) loaded in flexible linked strips for use in a machine gun

examples.sense: n. 腰带；地带；v. 用力打；快速移动
examples.en: She fastened her safety [belt] before the car pulled out into the busy motorway.
examples.cn: 她在汽车驶入繁忙的高速公路之前系好了安全[带]。

examples.sense: n. 腰带；地带；v. 用力打；快速移动
examples.en: The industrial [belt] running through the northern cities was once the engine of the national economy.
examples.cn: 穿越北部城市的工业[地带]曾经是国家经济的引擎。

examples.sense: n. 腰带；地带；v. 用力打；快速移动
examples.en: He [belted] out the national anthem with such power that the entire stadium fell silent in awe.
examples.cn: 他以如此有力的声音[高唱]国歌，以至于整个体育场在敬畏中鸦雀无声。

examples.sense: n. 腰带；地带；v. 用力打；快速移动
examples.en: The boxer took a [belt] to the chin but managed to stay on his feet until the final round.
examples.cn: 拳击手下巴被[重击]，但设法坚持到最后一轮。

examples.sense: n. 腰带；地带；v. 用力打；快速移动
examples.en: She [belted] through her revision in the final week, covering months of material in just days.
examples.cn: 她在最后一周[飞速]复习，几天内就覆盖了几个月的内容。

words.translation: n. 长椅子\n[机] 台
words.definition:
n. a long seat for more than one person
n. the magistrate or judge or judges sitting in court in judicial capacity to compose the court collectively
n. the reserve players on a team
n. (law) the seat for judges in a courtroom

examples.sense: n. 长凳；工作台；法官席
examples.en: The elderly couple sat on a park [bench] feeding pigeons in the quiet afternoon sunshine.
examples.cn: 老夫妇坐在公园[长凳]上，在宁静的午后阳光中喂鸽子。

examples.sense: n. 长凳；工作台；法官席
examples.en: The engineer worked at a laboratory [bench] calibrating instruments for the upcoming experiment.
examples.cn: 工程师在实验室[工作台]校准即将进行实验所用的仪器。

examples.sense: n. 长凳；工作台；法官席
examples.en: The case was brought before the full [bench] of the Supreme Court for a definitive ruling.
examples.cn: 此案被提交最高法院全体[法官席]作出最终裁决。

examples.sense: n. 长凳；工作台；法官席
examples.en: Talented young players often spend time on the substitutes' [bench] before earning a regular starting position.
examples.cn: 有才华的年轻球员通常要在替补[席]上待一段时间，才能赢得常规首发位置。

examples.sense: n. 长凳；工作台；法官席
examples.en: She sat on the cold stone [bench] outside the examination hall, calming her nerves before entering.
examples.cn: 她坐在考场外冰冷的石[凳]上，在进去之前平复情绪。

words.translation: vi. 变弯曲, 屈服\nvt. 使弯曲, 使屈服\nn. 弯曲
words.definition:
n. a circular segment of a curve
n. curved segment (of a road or river or railroad track etc.)
n. a town in central Oregon at the eastern foot of the Cascade Range
n. diagonal line traversing a shield from the upper right corner to the lower left

examples.en: The river [bends] sharply at this point, creating a natural pool that is popular with fishermen.
examples.cn: 河流在此处急剧[弯曲]，形成一个受垂钓者欢迎的天然水潭。

examples.en: She had to [bend] the rules slightly to accommodate the unusual circumstances of the case.
examples.cn: 她不得不稍微[变通]规则，以适应案件的特殊情况。

examples.en: Steel rods can [bend] under extreme heat without breaking, making them useful in construction.
examples.cn: 钢筋在极高温度下可以[弯曲]而不断裂，使其在建筑中非常有用。

examples.en: The gymnast performed a deep [bend] that demonstrated extraordinary flexibility of the spine.
examples.cn: 体操运动员完成了一个深度[弯曲]，展示了脊柱非同寻常的柔韧性。

examples.en: The accident occurred on a dangerous [bend] in the mountain road where visibility was limited.
examples.cn: 事故发生在山路上一个能见度有限的危险[弯道]处。

words.translation: prep. 在...下方\nadv. 在...下方
words.definition: r in or to a place that is lower

examples.sense: prep./adv. 在…下方；低于（地位、价值）
examples.en: The ancient city lay [beneath] layers of volcanic ash, preserved for thousands of years.
examples.cn: 这座古城沉睡在火山灰层[之下]，历经数千年得以保存。

examples.sense: prep./adv. 在…下方；低于（地位、价值）
examples.en: [Beneath] the polished surface of corporate success lay years of sacrifice and hard work.
examples.cn: 企业成功光鲜表面的[之下]是多年的牺牲和努力。

examples.sense: prep./adv. 在…下方；低于（地位、价值）
examples.en: The submarine explored the seabed [beneath] the Arctic ice, discovering previously unknown species.
examples.cn: 潜水艇探索了北极冰层[之下]的海床，发现了以前未知的物种。

examples.sense: prep./adv. 在…下方；低于（地位、价值）
examples.en: She considered the offer [beneath] her professional qualifications and declined without hesitation.
examples.cn: 她认为这个提议[低于]她的专业资质，毫不犹豫地拒绝了。

examples.sense: prep./adv. 在…下方；低于（地位、价值）
examples.en: Scientists drilled deep [beneath] the permafrost to extract ice cores containing ancient climate data.
examples.cn: 科学家在冻土[之下]深钻，提取含有古代气候数据的冰芯。

words.translation: a. 有益的, 受益的\n[经] 有使用权的, 可享利益的
words.definition: s. promoting or enhancing well-being

examples.en: Regular physical exercise has [beneficial] effects on both mental and physical health throughout life.
examples.cn: 定期锻炼对整个生命周期的心理和身体健康都有[有益的]影响。

examples.en: The trade agreement proved mutually [beneficial], stimulating economic growth in both partner countries.
examples.cn: 这项贸易协议被证明是互利的，刺激了两个伙伴国的经济增长。

examples.en: Certain bacteria in the gut are [beneficial] and play a critical role in digestion and immune function.
examples.cn: 肠道中某些细菌是[有益的]，在消化和免疫功能中发挥关键作用。

examples.en: Studying abroad can be enormously [beneficial] in developing linguistic, cultural, and professional competencies.
examples.cn: 出国留学在发展语言、文化和职业能力方面可以大有[裨益]。

examples.en: The mentorship programme has had a [beneficial] impact on the career trajectories of young graduates.
examples.cn: 导师计划对年轻毕业生的职业发展轨迹产生了[有益的]影响。

words.translation: n. 利益\nvt. 有益于\nvi. 受益
words.definition:
n. financial assistance in time of need
n. something that aids or promotes well-being
n. a performance to raise money for a charitable cause
v. be beneficial for

examples.sense: n. 利益；好处；v. 有益于
examples.en: One major [benefit] of bilingualism is an enhanced ability to switch between tasks efficiently.
examples.cn: 双语能力的一个主要[好处]是在任务之间高效切换的能力增强。

examples.sense: n. 利益；好处；v. 有益于
examples.en: The investment in renewable energy will [benefit] future generations by reducing environmental degradation.
examples.cn: 对可再生能源的投资将通过减少环境退化使后代[受益]。

examples.sense: n. 利益；好处；v. 有益于
examples.en: The new legislation was designed for the [benefit] of workers in precarious employment conditions.
examples.cn: 新立法的目的是为处于不稳定就业条件下的工人的[利益]服务。

examples.sense: n. 利益；好处；v. 有益于
examples.en: She gave the council the [benefit] of the doubt before forming a final judgement on their proposal.
examples.cn: 她在对委员会的提案形成最终判断之前，给予其[从宽考虑的余地]。

examples.sense: n. 利益；好处；v. 有益于
examples.en: Students who participate in extracurricular activities [benefit] from developing leadership and teamwork skills.
examples.cn: 参加课外活动的学生通过培养领导力和团队合作技能而[获益]。

words.translation: a. 弯曲的, 决心的\nn. 爱好\nbend的过去式和过去分词
words.definition:
n. a relatively permanent inclination to react in a particular way
n. grass for pastures and lawns especially bowling and putting greens
n. an area of grassland unbounded by fences or hedges
n. a special way of doing something

examples.sense: adj. 弯曲的；决心的；n./v. bend的过去式
examples.en: The [bent] nail had to be removed carefully to avoid splitting the wooden beam it was lodged in.
examples.cn: 必须小心取出[弯曲的]钉子，以免劈开它所嵌入的木梁。

examples.sense: adj. 弯曲的；决心的；n./v. bend的过去式
examples.en: She was [bent] on completing the research proposal despite the numerous setbacks she encountered.
examples.cn: 尽管遇到了无数挫折，她[决心]完成研究提案。

examples.sense: adj. 弯曲的；决心的；n./v. bend的过去式
examples.en: His natural [bent] for mathematics led his teachers to encourage him to pursue a career in engineering.
examples.cn: 他在数学方面的天然[倾向]促使老师鼓励他从事工程事业。

examples.sense: adj. 弯曲的；决心的；n./v. bend的过去式
examples.en: The old man walked slowly with a [bent] back that spoke of decades of physical labour.
examples.cn: 老人缓慢地走着，[弯曲的]背部诉说着数十年的体力劳动。

examples.sense: adj. 弯曲的；决心的；n./v. bend的过去式
examples.en: The iron bar was [bent] out of shape by the intense heat of the industrial furnace.
examples.cn: 铁棒被工业熔炉的高温[弯曲]变形。

words.translation: prep. 在旁边
words.definition:
n. At the side of; on one side of.
n. Aside from; out of the regular course or order of; in a
   state of deviation from; out of.
n. Over and above; distinct from; in addition to.
adv. On one side.
adv. More than that; over and above; not included in the
   number, or in what has been mentioned; moreover; in addition.

examples.en: She sat [beside] her professor during the conference to assist with presentations and translation.
examples.cn: 她在会议期间坐在教授[旁边]，协助演示和翻译。

examples.en: [Beside] the grand achievements of the pioneers, his own contributions seemed modest.
examples.cn: 与先驱者的伟大成就相比，他自己的贡献显得渺小。

examples.en: The witness stood [beside] the judge and took the oath before delivering testimony.
examples.cn: 证人站在法官[旁边]，在作证前宣誓。

examples.en: His anxiety about the exam was [beside] the point once he realised he had studied the wrong chapter.
examples.cn: 当他意识到复习了错误的章节后，对考试的焦虑已经[无关紧要]了。

examples.en: The small cottage sat peacefully [beside] a mountain stream that murmured through the valley.
examples.cn: 小屋静静地坐落在穿越山谷潺潺流淌的山溪[旁边]。

words.translation: prep. 除...之外\nadv. 而且, 此外
words.definition: r. making an additional point; anyway; besides, we can't afford it"\nr. in addition

examples.en: [Besides] academic qualifications, employers increasingly value practical skills and work experience.
examples.cn: [除了]学术资格之外，雇主越来越重视实践技能和工作经验。

examples.en: She speaks three languages [besides] her mother tongue, which makes her invaluable to the international team.
examples.cn: 她[除]母语之外还会说三门语言，这使她对国际团队来说不可或缺。

examples.en: The project was poorly planned; [besides], the team lacked the necessary technical expertise to execute it.
examples.cn: 该项目规划不善；[而且]，团队缺乏执行所需的技术专业知识。

examples.en: [Besides] the economic benefits, the policy also delivers significant environmental and social advantages.
examples.cn: [除了]经济利益之外，该政策还带来了显著的环境和社会效益。

examples.en: There are many other factors to consider [besides] the financial cost when evaluating the project's viability.
examples.cn: 在评估项目可行性时，[除了]财务成本之外，还有许多其他因素需要考虑。

words.translation: vt. 出卖, 背叛, 辜负, 暴露\n[法] 出卖, 背叛, 泄漏
words.definition: v. reveal unintentionally\nv. deliver to an enemy by treachery

examples.en: He refused to [betray] his principles even when pressured by colleagues to compromise his integrity.
examples.cn: 即使同事施压要他妥协诚信，他也拒绝[背叛]自己的原则。

examples.en: The spy was ultimately discovered when a minor error [betrayed] his carefully constructed cover identity.
examples.cn: 这名间谍最终因一个小错误[暴露]了他精心构建的掩护身份而被发现。

examples.en: Her trembling voice [betrayed] the anxiety she was trying hard to conceal from the audience.
examples.cn: 她颤抖的声音[流露]出她努力向观众隐藏的焦虑。

examples.en: Historians debate whether the general [betrayed] his country or acted to prevent a greater catastrophe.
examples.cn: 历史学家争论这位将军是[背叛]了国家，还是为了防止更大灾难而采取行动。

examples.en: The leak of classified documents [betrayed] the trust placed in every member of the intelligence community.
examples.cn: 机密文件的泄露[背叛]了对情报界每位成员的信任。

words.translation: a. 较好的\nadv. 比较好
words.definition:
n. something superior in quality or condition or effect
n. a superior person having claim to precedence
n. the superior one of two alternatives
v. surpass in excellence

examples.sense: adj./adv. 更好的（地）；v. 改善
examples.en: Consistent revision is always [better] than last-minute cramming when preparing for important examinations.
examples.cn: 备考重要考试时，持续复习总是[好于]临时抱佛脚。

examples.sense: adj./adv. 更好的（地）；v. 改善
examples.en: She is determined to [better] her previous score and has been training twice as hard this semester.
examples.cn: 她决心[超越]自己之前的成绩，这学期训练的努力程度翻了一倍。

examples.sense: adj./adv. 更好的（地）；v. 改善
examples.en: Education is widely regarded as the single most effective way to [better] one's life prospects.
examples.cn: 教育被普遍认为是[改善]个人生活前景的最有效途径。

examples.sense: adj./adv. 更好的（地）；v. 改善
examples.en: The revised draft was considerably [better] than the first, incorporating feedback from three reviewers.
examples.cn: 修订稿纳入了三位审阅者的反馈，比初稿[好]得多。

examples.sense: adj./adv. 更好的（地）；v. 改善
examples.en: It is [better] to ask a question and seem uninformed than to remain silent and stay ignorant.
examples.cn: [好过]沉默不知，不耻发问是更明智的选择。

words.translation: prep. 在...之间
words.definition: r. in the interval\nr. in between

examples.sense: prep. 在…之间；在（两者）中间
examples.en: The peace negotiations [between] the two rival factions lasted for several months before a settlement was reached.
examples.cn: 两个对立派系[之间]的和平谈判持续了数月，才达成协议。

examples.sense: prep. 在…之间；在（两者）中间
examples.en: There is a fundamental difference [between] having knowledge and being able to apply it effectively.
examples.cn: 拥有知识和能够有效应用知识[之间]存在本质区别。

examples.sense: prep. 在…之间；在（两者）中间
examples.en: She divided her time [between] her responsibilities as a researcher and her role as a teacher.
examples.cn: 她将时间分配在研究人员职责和教师角色[之间]。

examples.sense: prep. 在…之间；在（两者）中间
examples.en: The relationship [between] language and thought has fascinated philosophers and linguists for centuries.
examples.cn: 语言与思维[之间]的关系数百年来一直令哲学家和语言学家着迷。

examples.sense: prep. 在…之间；在（两者）中间
examples.en: Just [between] us, the project was far more challenging than the official reports suggested.
examples.cn: [在我们之间]说，这个项目远比官方报告所显示的更具挑战性。

words.translation: prep. 超过, 在那一边, 迟于\nadv. 在远处\nn. 更远处
words.definition: r. farther along in space or time or degree\nr. on the farther side from the observer\nr. in addition

examples.en: The implications of this research extend [beyond] the field of biology into medicine and ethics.
examples.cn: 这项研究的影响[超出]了生物学领域，延伸到医学和伦理学。

examples.en: The mountain range [beyond] the valley formed a natural barrier that protected the ancient settlement.
examples.cn: 山谷[那边]的山脉形成了保护古代定居点的天然屏障。

examples.en: Her academic achievements went far [beyond] what anyone had predicted when she first enrolled.
examples.cn: 她的学术成就远[超出]了她初次入学时任何人的预测。

examples.en: The damage caused by the flood was [beyond] repair and the entire neighbourhood had to be rebuilt.
examples.cn: 洪水造成的破坏[无法]修复，整个社区不得不重建。

examples.en: True leadership [beyond] authority involves inspiring people to act out of genuine commitment and shared purpose.
examples.cn: 真正的领导力[超越]权威，在于激励人们出于真诚承诺和共同目标而行动。

words.translation: n. 自行车
words.definition: n. a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals\nv. ride a bicycle

examples.en: She commuted to university by [bicycle] every day, covering five kilometres each way in under twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 她每天骑[自行车]上大学，单程五公里不到二十分钟。

examples.en: The city's [bicycle]-sharing scheme has significantly reduced traffic congestion during rush hours.
examples.cn: 城市[自行车]共享计划大大减少了高峰时段的交通拥堵。

examples.en: Learning to ride a [bicycle] without training wheels is considered a milestone in childhood development.
examples.cn: 学会不带辅助轮骑[自行车]被认为是儿童发展的一个里程碑。

examples.en: He repaired the punctured tyre of his [bicycle] with a kit he always kept in his backpack.
examples.cn: 他用背包里随身携带的工具修好了[自行车]的爆胎。

examples.en: In the Netherlands, [bicycle] lanes are integrated into urban planning as a fundamental transport network.
examples.cn: 在荷兰，[自行车]道作为基本交通网络被纳入城市规划。

words.translation: n. 出价\nv. 命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标
words.definition:
n. an attempt to get something
n. a formal proposal to buy at a specified price
n. (bridge) the number of tricks a bridge player is willing to contract to make
v. ask for or request earnestly

examples.sense: n./v. 出价；投标；努力争取
examples.en: The company submitted a competitive [bid] to secure the contract for constructing the new railway line.
examples.cn: 公司提交了一份有竞争力的[投标]，以争取建设新铁路线的合同。

examples.sense: n./v. 出价；投标；努力争取
examples.en: Several cities have placed [bids] to host the next international cultural exposition.
examples.cn: 几个城市已提交[申办]下届国际文化博览会的[申请]。

examples.sense: n./v. 出价；投标；努力争取
examples.en: She [bid] farewell to her colleagues at the retirement party after thirty years of dedicated service.
examples.cn: 在退休派对上，她向同事们[告别]，结束了三十年的忠诚服务。

examples.sense: n./v. 出价；投标；努力争取
examples.en: The painting attracted an opening [bid] of one million yuan at the prestigious auction house.
examples.cn: 这幅画在这家知名拍卖行以一百万元的起始[出价]开始竞拍。

examples.sense: n./v. 出价；投标；努力争取
examples.en: His [bid] for the chairmanship was unsuccessful but earned him significant respect among peers.
examples.cn: 他争夺主席职位的[努力]未能成功，但为他赢得了同行的高度尊重。

words.translation: a. 大的, 重要的\nadv. 大量地
words.definition:
s. significant
s. loud and firm
s. conspicuous in position or importance
s. prodigious

examples.sense: adj. 大的；重要的；成功的
examples.en: The discovery of penicillin was a [big] turning point in the history of modern medicine.
examples.cn: 青霉素的发现是现代医学史上的一个[重大]转折点。

examples.sense: adj. 大的；重要的；成功的
examples.en: She made a [big] impression at the interview by demonstrating both expertise and genuine enthusiasm.
examples.cn: 她在面试中展示出专业知识和真诚热情，给人留下了[深刻的]印象。

examples.sense: adj. 大的；重要的；成功的
examples.en: Thinking [big] is essential for entrepreneurs who want to transform industries and solve global problems.
examples.cn: [大胆]思考对于希望改变行业和解决全球问题的企业家至关重要。

examples.sense: adj. 大的；重要的；成功的
examples.en: The novel became a [big] success, selling over five million copies within its first year of publication.
examples.cn: 这部小说大获成功，出版第一年内销量超过五百万册。

examples.sense: adj. 大的；重要的；成功的
examples.en: She took a [big] risk by leaving a secure job to pursue her passion for environmental research.
examples.cn: 她冒了很[大的]风险，放弃稳定的工作去追求她对环境研究的热情。

words.translation: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据\nvt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布
words.definition:
n. a statute in draft before it becomes law
n. an itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
n. a piece of paper money (especially one issued by a central bank)
n. the entertainment offered at a public presentation

examples.sense: n. 账单；钞票；法案；鸟喙
examples.en: The electricity [bill] was significantly higher than expected after the cold snap in January.
examples.cn: 一月份寒潮过后，电费[账单]大大高于预期。

examples.sense: n. 账单；钞票；法案；鸟喙
examples.en: Parliament debated the new education [bill] for several weeks before it was passed into law.
examples.cn: 议会就新教育[法案]辩论了数周后，才将其通过成为法律。

examples.sense: n. 账单；钞票；法案；鸟喙
examples.en: The tourist paid for the meal with a hundred-dollar [bill] and waited for her change.
examples.cn: 游客用一张百元[钞票]付了餐费，等待找零。

examples.sense: n. 账单；钞票；法案；鸟喙
examples.en: The pelican uses its large [bill] to scoop fish out of the water with remarkable efficiency.
examples.cn: 鹈鹕利用其巨大的[喙]以惊人的效率从水中舀起鱼。

examples.sense: n. 账单；钞票；法案；鸟喙
examples.en: The government promised to foot the [bill] for the reconstruction of homes destroyed by the earthquake.
examples.cn: 政府承诺支付地震摧毁房屋重建的[费用]。

words.translation: num. 十亿, 十亿个
words.definition:
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 12 zeros; in the United Kingdom the usage followed in the United States is frequently seen
n. the number that is represented as a one followed by 9 zeros
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one thousand million items or units in the United States
s. denoting a quantity consisting of one million million items or units in Great Britain

examples.en: The global population surpassed eight [billion] in 2022, posing significant challenges for resource management.
examples.cn: 全球人口在2022年超过了八十[亿]，对资源管理提出了重大挑战。

examples.en: The technology company became worth over a trillion dollars after starting with just a few [billion] in investment.
examples.cn: 这家科技公司仅凭几十[亿]的初始投资，最终市值超过一万亿美元。

examples.en: Scientists estimate that our galaxy contains [billions] of stars, many potentially hosting planetary systems.
examples.cn: 科学家估计，我们的银河系包含[数十亿]颗恒星，其中许多可能拥有行星系统。

examples.en: The relief fund raised [billions] of dollars within days to support victims of the natural disaster.
examples.cn: 救济基金在数天内筹集了[数十亿]美元，以支持自然灾害受害者。

examples.en: Data centres around the world process [billions] of transactions every single second of every day.
examples.cn: 全球数据中心每天每一秒都在处理[数十亿]次交易。

words.translation: n. 宾戈(一种赌博游戏), 烈酒
words.definition: n a game in which numbered balls are drawn at random and players cover the corresponding numbers on their cards

examples.sense: n. 宾果（游戏）；int. 恰好
examples.en: The elderly residents enjoyed a weekly game of [bingo] at the community centre as a social activity.
examples.cn: 老年居民每周在社区中心玩一次[宾果]游戏，作为社交活动。

examples.sense: n. 宾果（游戏）；int. 恰好
examples.en: The teacher used a [bingo] card format to make vocabulary review more engaging for the class.
examples.cn: 老师使用[宾果]卡格式，使课堂词汇复习更具吸引力。

examples.sense: n. 宾果（游戏）；int. 恰好
examples.en: When the final piece of evidence was found, the detective exclaimed [bingo] and the case was solved.
examples.cn: 当最后一块证据被找到时，侦探高呼[宾果]，案件由此告破。

examples.sense: n. 宾果（游戏）；int. 恰好
examples.en: Online [bingo] platforms have grown rapidly in popularity as a form of social entertainment.
examples.cn: 网络[宾果]平台作为一种社交娱乐形式，人气迅速攀升。

examples.sense: n. 宾果（游戏）；int. 恰好
examples.en: The charity organised a fundraising [bingo] night that attracted over two hundred participants.
examples.cn: 慈善机构组织了一个募款[宾果]之夜，吸引了超过两百名参与者。

words.translation: n. 生物化学\n[化] 生物化学; 生化
